class DropItRuleImporter(BaseRuleImporter):
    """Importer strategy for DropIt XML and JSON profile export packages."""

    def can_import(self, file_path: Union[str, Path]) -> bool:
        """Return True if file extension or content matches DropIt export formats."""
        p = Path(file_path)
        ext = p.suffix.lower()
        if ext in (".xml", ".json", ".dropit"):
            return True
        return False

    def parse_file(self, file_path: Union[str, Path]) -> ImportResult:
        """Parse DropIt XML or JSON profile export file into Sortify rules."""
        result = ImportResult(source_format="DropIt Export")
        p = Path(file_path)

        if not p.exists():
            result.warnings.append(f"File not found: '{file_path}'")
            return result

        content = ""
        try:
            with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8-sig", errors="replace") as f:
                content = f.read()
        except OSError as exc:
            logger.warning(f"Failed to read file '{file_path}': {exc}")
            result.warnings.append(f"Failed to read file '{p.name}': {exc}")
            return result

        content_strip = content.strip()
        if not content_strip:
            result.warnings.append(f"DropIt export file '{p.name}' is empty.")
            return result

        if content_strip.startswith("<") or p.suffix.lower() == ".xml":
            return self._parse_xml(content_strip, p.name, result)
        else:
            return self._parse_json(content_strip, p.name, result)

    def _parse_xml(
        self, xml_content: str, file_name: str, result: ImportResult
    ) -> ImportResult:
        """Parse DropIt XML profile representation."""
        result.source_format = "DropIt XML Profile"
        try:
            root = ET.fromstring(xml_content)
        except (ET.ParseError, ValueError) as exc:
            logger.warning(f"Failed to parse XML in '{file_name}': {exc}")
            result.warnings.append(
                f"Failed to parse XML in DropIt profile '{file_name}': {exc}"
            )
            return result

        items = []
        # Support various DropIt XML tags: Association, Rule, Profile, Item
        for elem in root.iter():
            tag_lower = elem.tag.lower()
            if tag_lower in ("association", "rule", "item", "profileitem"):
                items.append(elem)

        if not items and root.tag.lower() in ("association", "rule", "item"):
            items = [root]

        for idx, item in enumerate(items):
            rule_name = ""
            pattern = ""
            dest = ""
            action = ""

            for child in item:
                ctag = child.tag.lower()
                cval = (child.text or "").strip()
                if ctag in ("name", "title"):
                    rule_name = cval
                elif ctag in ("rules", "pattern", "filter", "mask"):
                    pattern = cval
                elif ctag in ("destination", "directory", "folder", "target"):
                    dest = cval
                elif ctag in ("action", "type"):
                    action = cval

            if not rule_name:
                rule_name = f"DropIt Rule #{idx + 1}"

            if self._is_script_action(action):
                result.unsupported.append(
                    {
                        "rule": rule_name,
                        "reason": f"External script/command action '{action}' omitted.",
                    }
                )
                result.warnings.append(
                    f"DropIt rule '{rule_name}' contains command/script execution action which was omitted for security."
                )

            target_dir = self._sanitize_path(dest)
            if not target_dir:
                result.warnings.append(
                    f"DropIt rule '{rule_name}' has no target directory; omitted auto-routing."
                )
                result.unsupported.append(
                    {"rule": rule_name, "reason": "Missing target destination path"}
                )
                continue

            self._process_pattern_and_dest(rule_name, pattern, target_dir, result)

        return result

    def _parse_json(
        self, json_content: str, file_name: str, result: ImportResult
    ) -> ImportResult:
        """Parse DropIt JSON profile representation."""
        result.source_format = "DropIt JSON Profile"
        try:
            data = json.loads(json_content)
        except ValueError as exc:
            logger.warning(f"Failed to parse JSON in '{file_name}': {exc}")
            result.warnings.append(
                f"Failed to parse JSON in DropIt profile '{file_name}': {exc}"
            )
            return result

        rules_list = []
        if isinstance(data, list):
            rules_list = data
        elif isinstance(data, dict):
            rules_list = (
                data.get("rules")
                or data.get("associations")
                or data.get("profile")
                or data.get("items")
                or []
            )
            if not rules_list and (
                "Pattern" in data or "Rules" in data or "Name" in data
            ):
                rules_list = [data]

        if not isinstance(rules_list, list):
            result.warnings.append(
                f"Unrecognized DropIt JSON profile structure in '{file_name}'."
            )
            return result

        for idx, rule in enumerate(rules_list):
            if not isinstance(rule, dict):
                continue

            rule_name = (
                rule.get("Name")
                or rule.get("title")
                or rule.get("name")
                or f"DropIt Rule #{idx + 1}"
            )

            pattern = (
                rule.get("Pattern")
                or rule.get("Rules")
                or rule.get("pattern")
                or rule.get("filter")
                or ""
            )

            dest = (
                rule.get("Destination")
                or rule.get("Directory")
                or rule.get("folder")
                or rule.get("target")
                or rule.get("destination")
                or ""
            )

            action = rule.get("Action") or rule.get("action") or ""

            if self._is_script_action(action):
                result.unsupported.append(
                    {
                        "rule": rule_name,
                        "reason": f"External script/command action '{action}' omitted.",
                    }
                )
                result.warnings.append(
                    f"DropIt rule '{rule_name}' contains command/script execution action which was omitted for security."
                )

            target_dir = self._sanitize_path(dest)
            if not target_dir:
                result.warnings.append(
                    f"DropIt rule '{rule_name}' has no target directory; omitted auto-routing."
                )
                result.unsupported.append(
                    {"rule": rule_name, "reason": "Missing target destination path"}
                )
                continue

            self._process_pattern_and_dest(rule_name, str(pattern), target_dir, result)

        return result

    def _process_pattern_and_dest(
        self,
        rule_name: str,
        pattern: str,
        target_dir: str,
        result: ImportResult,
    ) -> None:
        """Convert DropIt pattern mask string into keyword rules or policy rules."""
        if not pattern:
            # Fallback to rule name
            pattern = rule_name

        # DropIt pattern masks use ';' or '|' or ',' as mask separators
        masks = [m.strip() for m in re.split(r"[;|,]", pattern) if m.strip()]

        for mask in masks:
            if "*" in mask or "?" in mask or mask.startswith("."):
                result.policies.append(
                    {
                        "type": "pattern",
                        "expression": mask,
                        "target_path": target_dir,
                        "priority": 75,
                        "halting": False,
                    }
                )
            else:
                if len(mask.split()) == 1 and all(
                    c.isalnum() or c in "_-" for c in mask
                ):
                    result.keyword_rules[mask.lower()] = target_dir
                else:
                    result.policies.append(
                        {
                            "type": "keyword",
                            "expression": mask,
                            "target_path": target_dir,
                            "priority": 75,
                            "halting": False,
                        }
                    )

class HazelRuleImporter(BaseRuleImporter):
    """Importer strategy for Hazel .hazelrules XML/plist packages."""

    def can_import(self, file_path: Union[str, Path]) -> bool:
        """Return True if file extension is .hazelrules/.plist or header resembles plist."""
        p = Path(file_path)
        if p.suffix.lower() in (".hazelrules", ".plist"):
            return True
        try:
            with open(p, "rb") as f:
                header = f.read(100)
                return b"plist" in header or b"bplist" in header
        except OSError:
            return False

    def parse_file(self, file_path: Union[str, Path]) -> ImportResult:
        """Parse Hazel .hazelrules plist file into Sortify rules."""
        result = ImportResult(source_format="Hazel (.hazelrules)")
        p = Path(file_path)

        if not p.exists():
            result.warnings.append(f"File not found: '{file_path}'")
            return result

        plist_data = None
        try:
            with open(p, "rb") as f:
                plist_data = plistlib.load(f)
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.warning(
                f"Failed to parse plist file '{file_path}': {exc}", exc_info=True
            )
            result.warnings.append(
                f"Failed to parse Hazel plist file '{p.name}': {exc}"
            )
            return result

        if not plist_data:
            result.warnings.append(f"Hazel rule package '{p.name}' is empty.")
            return result

        rules_list: List[Any] = []
        if isinstance(plist_data, dict):
            rules_list = (
                plist_data.get("Rules")
                or plist_data.get("HazelRules")
                or plist_data.get("rules")
                or []
            )
            if not rules_list and ("NSRuleName" in plist_data or "Name" in plist_data):
                rules_list = [plist_data]
        elif isinstance(plist_data, list):
            rules_list = plist_data

        if not isinstance(rules_list, list):
            result.warnings.append(
                f"Unrecognized Hazel rule package structure in '{p.name}'."
            )

        for idx, rule in enumerate(rules_list):

            rule_name = (
                rule.get("NSRuleName")
                or rule.get("Name")
                or rule.get("title")
                or f"Rule #{idx + 1}"
            )

            # Check for script actions in NSRuleActions / Actions
            actions = (
                rule.get("NSRuleActions")
                or rule.get("Actions")
                or rule.get("NSActions")
                or []
            )

            target_dir = ""
            has_script_action = False

            if isinstance(actions, list):
                for act in actions:
                    if self._is_script_action(act):
                        has_script_action = True
                        result.unsupported.append(
                            {
                                "rule": rule_name,
                                "reason": "Embedded script action omitted for security.",
                            }
                        )
                        result.warnings.append(
                            f"Hazel rule '{rule_name}' contains embedded script action which was omitted for security."
                        )

                    if isinstance(act, dict):
                        act_target = (
                            act.get("DestinationPath")
                            or act.get("Destination")
                            or act.get("target")
                            or act.get("folder")
                            or act.get("path")
                            or act.get("TargetFolder")
                        )
                        if act_target and isinstance(act_target, str):
                            target_dir = self._sanitize_path(act_target)
                    elif isinstance(act, str) and not has_script_action:
                        if "/" in act or "\\" in act:
                            target_dir = self._sanitize_path(act)

            if not target_dir:
                # Top level destination fallback
                top_target = (
                    rule.get("DestinationPath")
                    or rule.get("Destination")
                    or rule.get("TargetFolder")
                )
                if top_target and isinstance(top_target, str):
                    target_dir = self._sanitize_path(top_target)

            if not target_dir:
                result.warnings.append(
                    f"Hazel rule '{rule_name}' has no target destination folder; omitted auto-routing."
                )
                result.unsupported.append(
                    {"rule": rule_name, "reason": "Missing target destination path"}
                )
                continue

            conditions = (
                rule.get("NSRuleConditions")
                or rule.get("Conditions")
                or rule.get("NSConditions")
                or []
            )

            if not isinstance(conditions, list) or not conditions:
                # If no explicit conditions, map rule name as keyword if valid
                if rule_name and len(rule_name.split()) == 1:
                    result.keyword_rules[rule_name.lower()] = target_dir
                else:
                    result.policies.append(
                        {
                            "type": "keyword",
                            "expression": rule_name,
                            "target_path": target_dir,
                            "priority": 75,
                            "halting": False,
                        }
                    )
                continue

            for cond in conditions:
                if not isinstance(cond, dict):
                    continue

                attribute = str(
                    cond.get("target")
                    or cond.get("attribute")
                    or cond.get("NSRuleConditionTarget")
                    or ""
                ).lower()

                _operator = str(
                    cond.get("operator")
                    or cond.get("qualifier")
                    or cond.get("NSRuleConditionOperator")
                    or ""
                ).lower()

                val = (
                    cond.get("value")
                    or cond.get("pattern")
                    or cond.get("NSRuleConditionValue")
                    or cond.get("string")
                )

                if val is None:
                    continue

                val_str = str(val).strip()
                if not val_str:
                    continue

                if "extension" in attribute or "pattern" in attribute or "*" in val_str:
                    # Pattern policy rule
                    expr = (
                        val_str
                        if val_str.startswith("*") or "." in val_str
                        else f"*.{val_str}"
                    )
                    result.policies.append(
                        {
                            "type": "pattern",
                            "expression": expr,
                            "target_path": target_dir,
                            "priority": 75,
                            "halting": False,
                        }
                    )
                else:
                    # Simple single-word keyword vs phrase policy
                    if len(val_str.split()) == 1 and all(
                        c.isalnum() or c in "_-" for c in val_str
                    ):
                        result.keyword_rules[val_str.lower()] = target_dir
                    else:
                        result.policies.append(
                            {
                                "type": "keyword",
                                "expression": val_str,
                                "target_path": target_dir,
                                "priority": 75,
                                "halting": False,
                            }
                        )

        return result

@dataclass
class ImportResult:
    """Data container holding extracted keyword rules, policies, and warnings."""

    keyword_rules: Dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    policies: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    warnings: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    unsupported: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    source_format: str = "Unknown"

    def merge_into_settings(
        self, settings: Any
    ) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], List[Dict[str, Any]]]:
        """Safely merge extracted rules into settings without overwriting custom rules.

        Args:
            settings: The AppSettings configuration object.

        Returns
        -------
            Tuple of updated (KEYWORD_RULES dict, POLICIES list).
        """
        existing_keywords = dict(getattr(settings, "KEYWORD_RULES", {}) or {})
        existing_policies = list(getattr(settings, "POLICIES", []) or [])

        new_keywords = dict(existing_keywords)
        new_policies = [dict(p) for p in existing_policies]

        # Map existing lower-case keywords to preserve existing custom rules
        existing_kw_lower = {k.lower(): k for k in existing_keywords.keys()}

        for kw, target_path in self.keyword_rules.items():
            kw_clean = str(kw).strip()
            if not kw_clean:
                continue
            kw_lower = kw_clean.lower()
            if kw_lower not in existing_kw_lower and kw_clean not in new_keywords:
                new_keywords[kw_clean] = target_path

        for policy in self.policies:
            p_type = str(policy.get("type", "")).strip().lower()
            p_expr = str(policy.get("expression", "")).strip().lower()

            if not p_expr:
                continue

            is_duplicate = False
            for existing_p in new_policies:
                ex_type = str(existing_p.get("type", "")).strip().lower()
                ex_expr = str(existing_p.get("expression", "")).strip().lower()
                if ex_type == p_type and ex_expr == p_expr:
                    is_duplicate = True
                    break

            if not is_duplicate:
                new_policies.append(dict(policy))

        setattr(settings, "KEYWORD_RULES", new_keywords)
        setattr(settings, "POLICIES", new_policies)

        if hasattr(settings, "_save"):
            try:
                settings._save()
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(
                    f"Save trigger post rule import failed: {e}", exc_info=True
                )

        return new_keywords, new_policies

class TagSpacesRuleImporter(BaseRuleImporter):
    """Importer strategy for TagSpaces taggroup.json taxonomy files and smart rules."""

    def can_import(self, file_path: Union[str, Path]) -> bool:
        """Return True if file is a valid TagSpaces taggroup.json export or tag taxonomy JSON file."""
        p = Path(file_path)
        name_lower = p.name.lower()

        if (
            name_lower in ("taggroup.json", "taggroups.json")
            or "taggroup" in name_lower
            or "tagspaces" in name_lower
        ):
            return True

        if p.suffix.lower() != ".json":
            return False

        if not p.exists():
            return False

        try:
            with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                data = json.load(f)
        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError):
            return False

        return self._is_tagspaces_data(data)

    def _is_tagspaces_data(self, data: Any) -> bool:
        """Check if parsed JSON data matches TagSpaces structure."""
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            for key in (
                "tagGroups",
                "taggroups",
                "tagGroup",
                "taggroup",
                "taggroupVersion",
                "tagspaces",
                "smartRules",
                "smart_rules",
            ):
                if key in data:
                    return True

            if any(
                k in data for k in ("Pattern", "Destination", "Association", "Profile")
            ):
                return False

            if ("title" in data or "name" in data) and (
                "children" in data or "tags" in data or "subgroups" in data
            ):
                return True

        elif isinstance(data, list):
            if not data:
                return False
            first = data[0]
            if isinstance(first, dict):
                if any(
                    k in first
                    for k in ("Pattern", "Destination", "Association", "Profile")
                ):
                    return False
                if ("title" in first or "name" in first) and (
                    "children" in first
                    or "tags" in first
                    or "color" in first
                    or "textcolor" in first
                    or "icon" in first
                    or "isSmart" in first
                ):
                    return True
                if ("name" in first or "title" in first) and (
                    "conditions" in first or "matchers" in first
                ):
                    return True

        return False

    def parse_file(self, file_path: Union[str, Path]) -> ImportResult:
        """Parse TagSpaces taggroup.json or smart rule JSON file into Sortify rules."""
        result = ImportResult(source_format="TagSpaces (taggroup.json)")
        p = Path(file_path)

        if not p.exists():
            result.warnings.append(f"File not found: '{file_path}'")
            return result

        try:
            with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                data = json.load(f)
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.warning(
                f"Failed to parse TagSpaces JSON file '{file_path}': {exc}",
                exc_info=True,
            )
            result.warnings.append(
                f"Failed to parse TagSpaces JSON file '{p.name}': {exc}"
            )
            return result

        if not data:
            result.warnings.append(f"TagSpaces rule package '{p.name}' is empty.")
            return result

        # 1. Process Tag Groups / Taxonomy Hierarchy
        tag_groups: List[Any] = []
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            tag_groups = (
                data.get("tagGroups")
                or data.get("taggroups")
                or data.get("tagGroup")
                or data.get("taggroup")
                or data.get("groups")
                or []
            )
            if not tag_groups and (
                "children" in data
                or "tags" in data
                or "title" in data
                or "name" in data
            ):
                tag_groups = [data]
        elif isinstance(data, list):
            tag_groups = [
                item
                for item in data
                if isinstance(item, dict)
                and (
                    "children" in item
                    or "tags" in item
                    or "color" in item
                    or "textcolor" in item
                )
            ]
            if (
                not tag_groups
                and data
                and all(
                    isinstance(item, dict) and ("title" in item or "name" in item)
                    for item in data
                )
            ):
                tag_groups = data

        for group in tag_groups:
            if isinstance(group, dict):
                self._traverse_tag_group(group, [], result)

        # 2. Process Smart Rules
        smart_rules: List[Any] = []
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            smart_rules = (
                data.get("smartRules")
                or data.get("smart_rules")
                or data.get("rules")
                or []
            )
        elif isinstance(data, list):
            smart_rules = [
                item
                for item in data
                if isinstance(item, dict)
                and (
                    "conditions" in item
                    or "matchers" in item
                    or "actions" in item
                    or "destination" in item
                    or "target" in item
                )
            ]

        for idx, rule in enumerate(smart_rules):
            if isinstance(rule, dict):
                self._process_smart_rule(rule, idx, result)

        if not result.keyword_rules and not result.policies and not result.warnings:
            result.warnings.append(
                f"No convertible TagSpaces tag groups or smart rules found in '{p.name}'."
            )

        return result

    def _traverse_tag_group(
        self,
        node: Dict[str, Any],
        parent_path: List[str],
        result: ImportResult,
    ) -> None:
        """Recursively traverse nested tag group node and map tags to path hierarchies."""
        node_title = str(
            node.get("title")
            or node.get("name")
            or node.get("text")
            or node.get("label")
            or ""
        ).strip()

        current_path = list(parent_path)
        if node_title and node_title.lower() not in (
            "taggroups",
            "tag_groups",
            "root",
        ):
            current_path.append(node_title)

        target_dir = self._sanitize_path("/".join(current_path))

        raw_tags = node.get("tags") or []
        if isinstance(raw_tags, (str, dict)):
            raw_tags = [raw_tags]

        raw_children = (
            node.get("children")
            or node.get("subgroups")
            or node.get("groups")
            or node.get("items")
            or []
        )
        if isinstance(raw_children, (str, dict)):
            raw_children = [raw_children]

        for tag_item in raw_tags:
            if isinstance(tag_item, str):
                self._add_tag_rule(tag_item, target_dir, result)
            elif isinstance(tag_item, dict):
                if any(
                    k in tag_item for k in ("children", "subgroups", "groups", "tags")
                ):
                    self._traverse_tag_group(tag_item, current_path, result)
                else:
                    tag_name = (
                        tag_item.get("title")
                        or tag_item.get("name")
                        or tag_item.get("text")
                        or tag_item.get("tag")
                        or tag_item.get("label")
                        or ""
                    )
                    if tag_name:
                        self._add_tag_rule(str(tag_name), target_dir, result)

        for child in raw_children:
            if isinstance(child, str):
                self._add_tag_rule(child, target_dir, result)
            elif isinstance(child, dict):
                if (
                    any(k in child for k in ("children", "subgroups", "groups", "tags"))
                    or "color" in child
                    or "textcolor" in child
                ):
                    self._traverse_tag_group(child, current_path, result)
                else:
                    tag_name = (
                        child.get("title")
                        or child.get("name")
                        or child.get("text")
                        or child.get("tag")
                        or child.get("label")
                        or ""
                    )
                    if tag_name:
                        self._add_tag_rule(str(tag_name), target_dir, result)

    def _add_tag_rule(
        self, tag_str: str, target_dir: str, result: ImportResult
    ) -> None:
        """Map a tag string to a keyword rule or policy based on single-word vs multi-word/pattern."""
        tag_clean = tag_str.strip()
        if not tag_clean:
            return

        if not target_dir:
            result.warnings.append(
                f"Tag '{tag_clean}' in group has no target directory; omitted auto-routing."
            )
            result.unsupported.append(
                {"tag": tag_clean, "reason": "Missing target destination path"}
            )
            return

        if "*" in tag_clean or "?" in tag_clean or tag_clean.startswith("."):
            result.policies.append(
                {
                    "type": "pattern",
                    "expression": tag_clean,
                    "target_path": target_dir,
                    "priority": 75,
                    "halting": False,
                }
            )
        else:
            if len(tag_clean.split()) == 1 and all(
                c.isalnum() or c in "_-" for c in tag_clean
            ):
                result.keyword_rules[tag_clean.lower()] = target_dir
            else:
                result.policies.append(
                    {
                        "type": "keyword",
                        "expression": tag_clean,
                        "target_path": target_dir,
                        "priority": 75,
                        "halting": False,
                    }
                )

    def _process_smart_rule(
        self, rule: Dict[str, Any], idx: int, result: ImportResult
    ) -> None:
        """Process a TagSpaces smart rule entry, detecting condition matchers and filtering script actions."""
        rule_name = (
            rule.get("name")
            or rule.get("title")
            or rule.get("ruleName")
            or f"TagSpaces Smart Rule #{idx + 1}"
        )

        actions = rule.get("actions") or rule.get("action") or []
        if isinstance(actions, (str, dict)):
            actions = [actions]

        has_script = False
        for act in actions:
            if self._is_script_action(act):
                has_script = True
                break
        if not has_script:
            has_script = self._is_script_action(rule)

        if has_script:
            result.unsupported.append(
                {
                    "rule": rule_name,
                    "reason": "External script/command action omitted.",
                }
            )
            result.warnings.append(
                f"TagSpaces rule '{rule_name}' contains command/script execution action which was omitted for security."
            )

        dest = (
            rule.get("destination")
            or rule.get("target")
            or rule.get("folder")
            or rule.get("directory")
            or rule.get("targetPath")
            or ""
        )
        if not dest and actions:
            for act in actions:
                if isinstance(act, dict):
                    dest = (
                        act.get("target")
                        or act.get("destination")
                        or act.get("folder")
                        or act.get("path")
                        or ""
                    )
                    if dest:
                        break

        target_dir = self._sanitize_path(str(dest))
        if not target_dir:
            result.warnings.append(
                f"TagSpaces rule '{rule_name}' has no target directory; omitted auto-routing."
            )
            result.unsupported.append(
                {"rule": rule_name, "reason": "Missing target destination path"}
            )
            return

        conditions = (
            rule.get("conditions")
            or rule.get("condition")
            or rule.get("matchers")
            or rule.get("pattern")
            or []
        )
        if isinstance(conditions, (str, dict)):
            conditions = [conditions]

        for cond in conditions:
            if isinstance(cond, str):
                self._add_smart_rule_condition(cond, target_dir, result)
            elif isinstance(cond, dict):
                cond_type = str(
                    cond.get("field")
                    or cond.get("type")
                    or cond.get("attribute")
                    or cond.get("target")
                    or ""
                ).lower()
                val = str(
                    cond.get("value")
                    or cond.get("pattern")
                    or cond.get("expression")
                    or cond.get("val")
                    or ""
                ).strip()

                if not val:
                    continue

                if "ext" in cond_type or "extension" in cond_type:
                    expr = val if val.startswith("*.") else f"*.{val.lstrip('.')}"
                    result.policies.append(
                        {
                            "type": "pattern",
                            "expression": expr,
                            "target_path": target_dir,
                            "priority": 85,
                            "halting": False,
                        }
                    )
                else:
                    self._add_smart_rule_condition(val, target_dir, result, priority=85)

    def _add_smart_rule_condition(
        self,
        val_str: str,
        target_dir: str,
        result: ImportResult,
        priority: int = 85,
    ) -> None:
        """Add smart rule condition matcher to keyword rules or policy list."""
        val_clean = val_str.strip()
        if not val_clean:
            return

        if "*" in val_clean or "?" in val_clean or val_clean.startswith("."):
            result.policies.append(
                {
                    "type": "pattern",
                    "expression": val_clean,
                    "target_path": target_dir,
                    "priority": priority,
                    "halting": False,
                }
            )
        elif len(val_clean.split()) == 1 and all(
            c.isalnum() or c in "_-" for c in val_clean
        ):
            result.keyword_rules[val_clean.lower()] = target_dir
        else:
            result.policies.append(
                {
                    "type": "keyword",
                    "expression": val_clean,
                    "target_path": target_dir,
                    "priority": priority,
                    "halting": False,
                }
            )

def can_import(self, file_path: Union[str, Path]) -> bool:
    """Return True if file is a valid TagSpaces taggroup.json export or tag taxonomy JSON file."""
    p = Path(file_path)
    name_lower = p.name.lower()

    if (
        name_lower in ("taggroup.json", "taggroups.json")
        or "taggroup" in name_lower
        or "tagspaces" in name_lower
    ):
        return True

    if p.suffix.lower() != ".json":
        return False

    if not p.exists():
        return False

    try:
        with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            data = json.load(f)
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError):
        return False

    return self._is_tagspaces_data(data)

def parse_file(self, file_path: Union[str, Path]) -> ImportResult:
    """Parse TagSpaces taggroup.json or smart rule JSON file into Sortify rules."""
    result = ImportResult(source_format="TagSpaces (taggroup.json)")
    p = Path(file_path)

    if not p.exists():
        result.warnings.append(f"File not found: '{file_path}'")
        return result

    try:
        with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            data = json.load(f)
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning(
            f"Failed to parse TagSpaces JSON file '{file_path}': {exc}",
            exc_info=True,
        )
        result.warnings.append(
            f"Failed to parse TagSpaces JSON file '{p.name}': {exc}"
        )
        return result

    if not data:
        result.warnings.append(f"TagSpaces rule package '{p.name}' is empty.")
        return result

    # 1. Process Tag Groups / Taxonomy Hierarchy
    tag_groups: List[Any] = []
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        tag_groups = (
            data.get("tagGroups")
            or data.get("taggroups")
            or data.get("tagGroup")
            or data.get("taggroup")
            or data.get("groups")
            or []
        )
        if not tag_groups and (
            "children" in data
            or "tags" in data
            or "title" in data
            or "name" in data
        ):
            tag_groups = [data]
    elif isinstance(data, list):
        tag_groups = [
            item
            for item in data
            if isinstance(item, dict)
            and (
                "children" in item
                or "tags" in item
                or "color" in item
                or "textcolor" in item
            )
        ]
        if (
            not tag_groups
            and data
            and all(
                isinstance(item, dict) and ("title" in item or "name" in item)
                for item in data
            )
        ):
            tag_groups = data

    for group in tag_groups:
        if isinstance(group, dict):
            self._traverse_tag_group(group, [], result)

    # 2. Process Smart Rules
    smart_rules: List[Any] = []
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        smart_rules = (
            data.get("smartRules")
            or data.get("smart_rules")
            or data.get("rules")
            or []
        )
    elif isinstance(data, list):
        smart_rules = [
            item
            for item in data
            if isinstance(item, dict)
            and (
                "conditions" in item
                or "matchers" in item
                or "actions" in item
                or "destination" in item
                or "target" in item
            )
        ]

    for idx, rule in enumerate(smart_rules):
        if isinstance(rule, dict):
            self._process_smart_rule(rule, idx, result)

    if not result.keyword_rules and not result.policies and not result.warnings:
        result.warnings.append(
            f"No convertible TagSpaces tag groups or smart rules found in '{p.name}'."
        )

    return result

def get_rule_importer(file_path: Union[str, Path]) -> BaseRuleImporter:
    """Return auto-detected rule importer strategy for the given file path.

    Args:
        file_path: Path to rule package file.

    Returns
    -------
        An instance of BaseRuleImporter strategy class.

    Raises
    ------
        ValueError: If file format is not supported.
    """
    p = Path(file_path)
    tagspaces_importer = TagSpacesRuleImporter()
    hazel_importer = HazelRuleImporter()
    dropit_importer = DropItRuleImporter()

    if tagspaces_importer.can_import(p):
        return tagspaces_importer

    if hazel_importer.can_import(p):
        return hazel_importer

    if dropit_importer.can_import(p):
        return dropit_importer

    # Fallback extension detection
    ext = p.suffix.lower()
    if (
        p.name.lower() in ("taggroup.json", "taggroups.json")
        or "taggroup" in p.name.lower()
    ):
        return tagspaces_importer
    elif ext in (".hazelrules", ".plist"):
        return hazel_importer
    elif ext in (".xml", ".json", ".dropit"):
        return dropit_importer

    raise ValueError(
        f"Unsupported rule file format for '{p.name}'. Expected .hazelrules, .plist, .xml, or .json."
    )

def apply_starter_templates(
    settings: Any, pack_ids: List[str]
) -> tuple[Dict[str, str], List[Dict[str, Any]]]:
    """Merge selected starter template packs into settings without overwriting existing custom rules.

    Args:
        settings: Application settings object (`AppSettings`).
        pack_ids: List of template pack IDs to apply.

    Returns
    -------
        Tuple of updated (KEYWORD_RULES dict, POLICIES list).
    """
    existing_keywords = dict(getattr(settings, "KEYWORD_RULES", {}) or {})
    existing_policies = list(getattr(settings, "POLICIES", []) or [])

    new_keywords = dict(existing_keywords)
    new_policies = [dict(p) for p in existing_policies]

    # Map existing keyword keys (lowercase) to ensure custom rule preservation
    existing_kw_keys_lower = {k.lower(): k for k in existing_keywords.keys()}

    for pack_id in pack_ids:
        pack = get_starter_template_by_id(pack_id)
        if not pack:
            continue

        # Merge keyword rules safely (do NOT overwrite existing keywords)
        for kw, target_path in pack.keyword_rules.items():
            kw_lower = kw.lower()
            if kw_lower not in existing_kw_keys_lower and kw not in new_keywords:
                new_keywords[kw] = target_path

        # Merge policies safely (do NOT add duplicate type + expression)
        for policy in pack.policies:
            p_type = str(policy.get("type", "")).lower()
            p_expr = str(policy.get("expression", "")).lower()

            is_duplicate = False
            for existing_p in new_policies:
                ex_type = str(existing_p.get("type", "")).lower()
                ex_expr = str(existing_p.get("expression", "")).lower()
                if ex_type == p_type and ex_expr == p_expr:
                    is_duplicate = True
                    break

            if not is_duplicate:
                new_policies.append(dict(policy))

    # Apply to settings
    setattr(settings, "KEYWORD_RULES", new_keywords)
    setattr(settings, "POLICIES", new_policies)

    if hasattr(settings, "_save"):
        try:
            settings._save()
        except Exception:
            # The rules still apply for this session; only persisting them failed.
            logger.warning("Could not save the applied rule template.", exc_info=True)

    return new_keywords, new_policies

def generate_sample_corpus(base_dir: str, overwrite: bool = False) -> List[str]:
    """Generate a sample corpus with categorized text documents (finance, tech, health, empty).

    Args:
        base_dir: Target directory path where sample documents will be created.
        overwrite: If False and any sample files exist in base_dir, raises FileExistsError.

    Returns
    -------
        List of created relative file names.
    """
    os.makedirs(base_dir, exist_ok=True)

    sample_files = {
        "demo_finance.txt": (
            "This is a detailed report on finance, money, investment, and banking strategies. "
            "The economy is growing."
        ),
        "demo_tech.txt": (
            "Notes on software engineering, computer science, algorithms, and technology. "
            "Python is great."
        ),
        "demo_health.txt": (
            "Medical science, healthcare, doctor, patient, clinical trials, medicine, and health."
        ),
        "empty.txt": "",
    }

    if not overwrite:
        existing = [
            f for f in sample_files if os.path.exists(os.path.join(base_dir, f))
        ]
        if existing:
            raise FileExistsError(
                f"Sample files already exist in {base_dir}: {', '.join(existing)}"
            )

    for filename, content in sample_files.items():
        filepath = os.path.join(base_dir, filename)
        with open(filepath, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(content)

    return list(sample_files.keys())

def get_files_from_sources(
    source_dirs: list[str], include_hidden: bool = False
) -> list[str]:
    """Scan all configured source roots and produce namespaced relative path identifiers."""
    norm_sources = []
    for d in source_dirs:
        if d:
            abs_d = os.path.normpath(os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(d)))
            if abs_d not in norm_sources and os.path.isdir(abs_d):
                norm_sources.append(abs_d)

    if not norm_sources:
        return []

    if len(norm_sources) == 1:
        return get_files_recursively(norm_sources[0], include_hidden=include_hidden)

    all_files = []
    for src_root in norm_sources:
        scanned = get_files_recursively(src_root, include_hidden=include_hidden)
        for rel_path in scanned:
            all_files.append(f"{src_root}::{rel_path}")

    return sorted(all_files)

def get_files_recursively(
    base: str, rel_path: str = "", include_hidden: bool = False
) -> list:
    """Recursively list all files in a directory deterministically."""
    files = []
    if rel_path == "":
        LinkManager.clear()

    try:
        # Sorting the scanned entries ensures deterministic file discovery
        with os.scandir(os.path.join(base, rel_path)) as entries:
            sorted_entries = sorted(entries, key=lambda e: e.name)
            for entry in sorted_entries:
                if not include_hidden and entry.name.startswith("."):
                    continue
                # Quarantine isolation: unreleased files in _Quarantine_Staging must remain inaccessible to standard scans
                if entry.name == "_Quarantine_Staging" or entry.name.startswith(
                    "_Quarantine_Staging"
                ):
                    continue
                entry_rel_path = (
                    os.path.join(rel_path, entry.name) if rel_path else entry.name
                )

                # Check for junction, symlink, or .lnk file
                if (
                    is_junction_entry(entry)
                    or entry.is_symlink()
                    or entry.name.lower().endswith(".lnk")
                ):
                    LinkManager.register_link(base, entry_rel_path)
                    files.append(entry_rel_path)
                elif entry.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False):
                    files.extend(
                        get_files_recursively(
                            base, entry_rel_path, include_hidden=include_hidden
                        )
                    )
                else:
                    files.append(entry_rel_path)
    except Exception as e:
        logging.error(
            f"Failed to scan directory {os.path.join(base, rel_path)}: {e}",
            exc_info=True,
        )

    if rel_path == "":
        return sorted(files)
    return files

def parse_item_identifier(item: str, default_base_dir: str = "") -> tuple[str, str]:

class SecurityAdvisoryClient:
    """Thread-safe client to query remote security advisory endpoints with in-memory caching."""

    _instance: Optional["SecurityAdvisoryClient"] = None
    _lock = threading.RLock()

    @classmethod
    def get_instance(cls) -> "SecurityAdvisoryClient":
        """Retrieve the singleton instance of SecurityAdvisoryClient."""
        with cls._lock:
            if cls._instance is None:
                cls._instance = cls()
            return cls._instance

    @classmethod
    def reset_instance(cls) -> None:
        """Reset the singleton instance of SecurityAdvisoryClient."""
        with cls._lock:
            if cls._instance is not None:
                cls._instance.clear_cache()
                cls._instance = None

    def __init__(
        self,
        settings=None,
        endpoint: Optional[str] = None,
        ttl: Optional[float] = None,
        fallback_policy: Optional[str] = None,
    ):
        """Initialize SecurityAdvisoryClient with configurable endpoint, TTL, and fallback policy."""
        self._cache: dict[
            Tuple[Optional[str], Optional[str]], Tuple[SecurityAdvisoryResult, float]
        ] = {}
        self._cache_lock = threading.RLock()
        self._settings = settings
        self._endpoint = endpoint
        self._ttl = ttl
        self._fallback_policy = fallback_policy

    @property
    def endpoint(self) -> str:
        """Get effective security advisory API endpoint."""
        if self._endpoint:
            return self._endpoint
        if self._settings is None:
            try:
                from app.config import AppSettings

                self._settings = AppSettings()
            except Exception:
                logger.warning(
                    "Could not load AppSettings; using advisory defaults", exc_info=True
                )
        if self._settings:
            return getattr(
                self._settings, "SECURITY_ADVISORY_ENDPOINT", DEFAULT_ADVISORY_ENDPOINT
            )
        return DEFAULT_ADVISORY_ENDPOINT

    @property
    def ttl(self) -> float:
        """Get effective cache TTL in seconds."""
        if self._ttl is not None:
            return float(self._ttl)
        if self._settings is None:
            try:
                from app.config import AppSettings

                self._settings = AppSettings()
            except Exception:
                logger.warning(
                    "Could not load AppSettings; using advisory defaults", exc_info=True
                )
        if self._settings:
            return float(
                getattr(
                    self._settings, "SECURITY_ADVISORY_CACHE_TTL", DEFAULT_CACHE_TTL
                )
            )
        return float(DEFAULT_CACHE_TTL)

    @property
    def fallback_policy(self) -> str:
        """Get effective fallback policy ('strict' or 'permissive')."""
        if self._fallback_policy:
            return self._fallback_policy.strip().lower()
        if self._settings is None:
            try:
                from app.config import AppSettings

                self._settings = AppSettings()
            except Exception:
                logger.warning(
                    "Could not load AppSettings; using advisory defaults", exc_info=True
                )
        if self._settings:
            pol = getattr(self._settings, "SECURITY_ADVISORY_FALLBACK_POLICY", "strict")
            return str(pol).strip().lower()
        return "strict"

    @classmethod
    def extract_repo_id(cls, url_or_id: str) -> str:
        """Extract standardized Hugging Face repository identifier from URL or model ID string."""
        if not url_or_id:
            return ""
        s = url_or_id.strip()
        match = _HF_URL_PATTERN.match(s)
        if match:
            return match.group(1)
        # If it's already a repo string or model name (e.g., 'sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2')
        if s.startswith("http://") or s.startswith("https://"):
            # Parse path fallback
            parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(s)
            path_parts = [p for p in parsed.path.split("/") if p]
            if len(path_parts) >= 2:
                return f"{path_parts[0]}/{path_parts[1]}"
            elif len(path_parts) == 1:
                return path_parts[0]
        return s

    def cache_advisory(
        self,
        repo_id: Optional[str],
        file_hash: Optional[str],
        result: SecurityAdvisoryResult,
    ) -> None:
        """Manually store or update a security advisory result in the in-memory cache."""
        norm_repo = self.extract_repo_id(repo_id) if repo_id else None
        norm_hash = file_hash.strip().lower() if file_hash else None
        key = (norm_repo, norm_hash)
        with self._cache_lock:
            self._cache[key] = (result, time.time())

    def clear_cache(self) -> None:
        """Clear all entries from the in-memory advisory cache."""
        with self._cache_lock:
            self._cache.clear()

    def get_cached_advisory(
        self, repo_id: Optional[str], file_hash: Optional[str]
    ) -> Optional[SecurityAdvisoryResult]:
        """Retrieve cached advisory result if present and within TTL."""
        norm_repo = self.extract_repo_id(repo_id) if repo_id else None
        norm_hash = file_hash.strip().lower() if file_hash else None
        key = (norm_repo, norm_hash)
        now = time.time()
        with self._cache_lock:
            # 1. Exact key match
            if key in self._cache:
                res, ts = self._cache[key]
                if now - ts <= self.ttl:
                    return res
                else:
                    del self._cache[key]

            # 2. Check repo-level cached entry (norm_repo, None)
            if norm_repo and (norm_repo, None) in self._cache:
                res, ts = self._cache[(norm_repo, None)]
                if now - ts <= self.ttl:
                    return res
                else:
                    del self._cache[(norm_repo, None)]

            # 3. Check hash-level cached entry (None, norm_hash)
            if norm_hash and (None, norm_hash) in self._cache:
                res, ts = self._cache[(None, norm_hash)]
                if now - ts <= self.ttl:
                    return res
                else:
                    del self._cache[(None, norm_hash)]

            # 4. Fallback search across all active entries
            for k, (res, ts) in list(self._cache.items()):
                if now - ts > self.ttl:
                    del self._cache[k]
                    continue
                if (norm_repo and k[0] == norm_repo) or (
                    norm_hash and k[1] == norm_hash
                ):
                    return res

        return None

    def check_advisory(
        self,
        repo_id: Optional[str] = None,
        file_hash: Optional[str] = None,
        timeout: float = MAX_API_TIMEOUT,
        fallback_policy: Optional[str] = None,
        raise_on_advisory: bool = True,
    ) -> SecurityAdvisoryResult:
        """Verify remote security advisories for repository identifier and/or file SHA-256 hash.

        Parameters
        ----------
        repo_id : str, optional
            Model repository identifier or remote URL.
        file_hash : str, optional
            SHA-256 hash of target model file.
        timeout : float
            Lookup API timeout limit (capped at 5.0s).
        fallback_policy : str, optional
            Override policy on network timeout/failure ('strict' or 'permissive').
        raise_on_advisory : bool
            If True, raises ModelVerificationError when an active advisory is detected.

        Returns
        -------
        SecurityAdvisoryResult
            The verification result object.

        Raises
        ------
        ModelVerificationError
            If an active advisory is detected or if lookup fails under strict policy.
        """
        if not repo_id and not file_hash:
            raise ValueError(
                "Either repo_id or file_hash must be provided to check_advisory."
            )

        norm_repo = self.extract_repo_id(repo_id) if repo_id else None
        norm_hash = file_hash.strip().lower() if file_hash else None
        eff_timeout = min(float(timeout), MAX_API_TIMEOUT)

        # 1. Fast In-Memory Cache Lookup (< 50ms)
        cached_result = self.get_cached_advisory(norm_repo, norm_hash)
        if cached_result is not None:
            if cached_result.has_advisory and raise_on_advisory:
                details_msg = (
                    f"Active security advisory '{cached_result.advisory_id or 'FLAGGED'}' "
                    f"detected for asset '{norm_repo or norm_hash}' (severity: {cached_result.severity or 'CRITICAL'}): "
                    f"{cached_result.details or 'Security alert issued.'}"
                )
                raise ModelVerificationError(details_msg)
            return cached_result

        # Resolved only on a cache miss: the default policy loads AppSettings
        # from disk, which a cached lookup has no use for.
        eff_fallback = (
            fallback_policy.strip().lower() if fallback_policy else self.fallback_policy
        )

        # 2. Remote Security Advisory API Query
        # Bypassing thread-local socket sandboxing safely during advisory lookup
        from app.core.shared_registry import _thread_local

        was_sandboxed = getattr(_thread_local, "sandboxed", False)
        old_reason = getattr(_thread_local, "reason", "worker execution")
        _thread_local.sandboxed = False
        _thread_local.reason = "security advisory query execution"

        try:
            params = {}
            if norm_repo:
                params["repo_id"] = norm_repo
            if norm_hash:
                params["file_hash"] = norm_hash

            query_str = urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
            endpoint_url = (
                f"{self.endpoint}?{query_str}" if query_str else self.endpoint
            )

            req = urllib.request.Request(
                endpoint_url,
                headers={
                    "User-Agent": "Smart-AutoSorter-SecurityClient/1.0",
                    "Accept": "application/json",
                },
            )

            try:
                from app.core.downloader import DownloadManager

                opener = DownloadManager.get_instance().get_opener()
            except Exception:
                logger.warning(
                    "DownloadManager opener unavailable; using default urllib opener",
                    exc_info=True,
                )
                opener = urllib.request.build_opener()

            with opener.open(req, timeout=eff_timeout) as resp:
                resp_data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))

            has_adv = False
            adv_id = None
            sev = None
            det = None

            if isinstance(resp_data, dict):
                has_adv = bool(
                    resp_data.get("has_advisory")
                    or resp_data.get("vulnerable")
                    or resp_data.get("advisories")
                )
                adv_id = resp_data.get("advisory_id") or resp_data.get("id")
                sev = resp_data.get("severity") or resp_data.get("rating")
                det = resp_data.get("details") or resp_data.get("message")

                if (
                    not adv_id
                    and isinstance(resp_data.get("advisories"), list)
                    and resp_data["advisories"]
                ):
                    first_adv = resp_data["advisories"][0]
                    if isinstance(first_adv, dict):
                        adv_id = first_adv.get("id")
                        sev = first_adv.get("severity")
                        det = first_adv.get("details") or first_adv.get("summary")

            result = SecurityAdvisoryResult(
                has_advisory=has_adv,
                advisory_id=adv_id,
                severity=sev,
                details=det,
                timestamp=time.time(),
            )
            self.cache_advisory(norm_repo, norm_hash, result)

            if has_adv and raise_on_advisory:
                details_msg = (
                    f"Active security advisory '{adv_id or 'FLAGGED'}' "
                    f"detected for asset '{norm_repo or norm_hash}' (severity: {sev or 'CRITICAL'}): "
                    f"{det or 'Security alert issued.'}"
                )
                raise ModelVerificationError(details_msg)

            return result

        except ModelVerificationError:
            raise
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(
                f"Security advisory query failed for '{norm_repo or norm_hash}': {e}"
            )
            if eff_fallback == "strict":
                raise ModelVerificationError(
                    f"Pre-download security advisory lookup failed for '{norm_repo or norm_hash}' "
                    f"under strict security policy: {e}"
                ) from e
            else:
                fallback_result = SecurityAdvisoryResult(
                    has_advisory=False,
                    details=f"Query failed ({e}), proceeding under permissive fallback policy.",
                    timestamp=time.time(),
                )
                return fallback_result

        finally:
            _thread_local.sandboxed = was_sandboxed
            _thread_local.reason = old_reason

@classmethod
def extract_repo_id(cls, url_or_id: str) -> str:
    """Extract standardized Hugging Face repository identifier from URL or model ID string."""
    if not url_or_id:
        return ""
    s = url_or_id.strip()
    match = _HF_URL_PATTERN.match(s)
    if match:
        return match.group(1)
    # If it's already a repo string or model name (e.g., 'sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2')
    if s.startswith("http://") or s.startswith("https://"):
        # Parse path fallback
        parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(s)
        path_parts = [p for p in parsed.path.split("/") if p]
        if len(path_parts) >= 2:
            return f"{path_parts[0]}/{path_parts[1]}"
        elif len(path_parts) == 1:
            return path_parts[0]
    return s

docs.text:
Retrieve cached advisory result if present and within TTL.

def get_cached_advisory(
    self, repo_id: Optional[str], file_hash: Optional[str]
) -> Optional[SecurityAdvisoryResult]:
    """Retrieve cached advisory result if present and within TTL."""
    norm_repo = self.extract_repo_id(repo_id) if repo_id else None
    norm_hash = file_hash.strip().lower() if file_hash else None
    key = (norm_repo, norm_hash)
    now = time.time()
    with self._cache_lock:
        # 1. Exact key match
        if key in self._cache:
            res, ts = self._cache[key]
            if now - ts <= self.ttl:
                return res
            else:
                del self._cache[key]

        # 2. Check repo-level cached entry (norm_repo, None)
        if norm_repo and (norm_repo, None) in self._cache:
            res, ts = self._cache[(norm_repo, None)]
            if now - ts <= self.ttl:
                return res
            else:
                del self._cache[(norm_repo, None)]

        # 3. Check hash-level cached entry (None, norm_hash)
        if norm_hash and (None, norm_hash) in self._cache:
            res, ts = self._cache[(None, norm_hash)]
            if now - ts <= self.ttl:
                return res
            else:
                del self._cache[(None, norm_hash)]

        # 4. Fallback search across all active entries
        for k, (res, ts) in list(self._cache.items()):
            if now - ts > self.ttl:
                del self._cache[k]
                continue
            if (norm_repo and k[0] == norm_repo) or (
                norm_hash and k[1] == norm_hash
            ):
                return res

    return None
