class DropPlanConfirmModal(A11yMixin, ModalScreen[bool]):
    """Show the DropZone plan and ask before any file is moved."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    DropPlanConfirmModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 100;
        min-width: 30;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    #drop-plan-tree {
        height: auto;
        max-height: 20;
        overflow-y: auto;
        border: solid $secondary;
        padding: 0 1;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, summary: str, plan_lines: List[str]):
        super().__init__()
        self.summary = summary
        self.plan_lines = plan_lines

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose the plan preview with Move and Cancel buttons."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading("Review DropZone Plan", level=1, classes="modal-title")
            yield Label(self.summary, id="lbl-drop-plan-summary")
            yield Static("\n".join(self.plan_lines), id="drop-plan-tree", markup=False)
            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_cancel = Button("Cancel", id="btn-cancel-drop-plan")
                btn_cancel.tooltip = "Close without moving any files"
                yield btn_cancel
                btn_move = Button(
                    "Move Files", id="btn-confirm-drop-plan", variant="success"
                )
                btn_move.tooltip = (
                    "Move the files as shown. You can undo it from History (Ctrl+Y)."
                )
                yield btn_move

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus Cancel so Enter never moves files by accident."""
        self.query_one("#btn-cancel-drop-plan", Button).focus()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-confirm-drop-plan")
    def action_confirm(self) -> None:
        """Confirm the moves."""
        self.dismiss(True)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel-drop-plan")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel without moving anything."""
        self.dismiss(False)

class DropZoneModal(
    ResponsiveLayoutMixin, A11yMixin, ModalScreen[Optional[Dict[str, Any]]]
):
    """Floating overlay modal dialog for quick drag-and-drop or paste file triage."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS = {".txt", ".docx", ".csv", ".xlsx", ".xls", ".pdf"}

    CSS = """
    DropZoneModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: double $accent;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 100;
        min-width: 50;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 95%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow .modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 95%;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
    .dropzone-target {
        border: dashed $primary;
        background: $surface;
        padding: 0 1;
        margin-top: 0;
        margin-bottom: 0;
        align: center middle;
        height: auto;
    }
    .dropzone-instructions {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $primary;
        text-align: center;
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
    .dropzone-subinstructions {
        color: $text-muted;
        text-align: center;
    }
    #input-queue-filter {
        margin-top: 0;
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
    .dropzone-split-container {
        height: auto;
        min-height: 8;
        layout: horizontal;
        margin-top: 0;
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
    .narrow .dropzone-split-container {
        layout: vertical;
    }
    #dropzone-staging-table {
        width: 60%;
        height: 7;
        min-height: 5;
        margin-top: 0;
        margin-bottom: 0;
        border: solid $accent;
    }
    .narrow #dropzone-staging-table {
        width: 100%;
        height: 6;
    }
    #dropzone-metadata-preview {
        width: 40%;
        height: 7;
        min-height: 5;
        border: solid $primary;
        background: $surface;
        padding: 0 1;
        margin-left: 1;
        overflow-x: hidden;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow #dropzone-metadata-preview {
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        min-height: 4;
        margin-left: 0;
        margin-top: 1;
    }
    .preview-header {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
    .preview-field {
        color: $text;
    }
    .status-text {
        color: $accent;
        margin-top: 0;
        margin-bottom: 0;
        text-style: italic;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 0;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    .queue-row {
        margin-top: 0;
        height: 3;
        align: center middle;
    }
    Button:focus, Input:focus, DataTable:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    Button.hidden {
        display: none;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, settings: Any = None, base_dir: Optional[str] = None):
        super().__init__()
        self.settings = settings
        self.base_dir = base_dir
        self.processed_result: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
        self.staged_items: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose floating dropzone modal overlay controls."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Floating DropZone - Quick File Triage",
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            with Vertical(classes="dropzone-target"):
                yield Label(
                    "📥 Drop or Paste File / Folder Paths Here",
                    classes="dropzone-instructions",
                )
                yield Label(
                    "Drag items onto terminal or paste absolute file paths to organize automatically",
                    classes="dropzone-subinstructions",
                )
            inp = Input(
                placeholder="Paste or drop file / directory paths here...",
                id="input-drop-paths",
            )
            inp.tooltip = (
                "Enter or drop target file or folder paths to trigger automated sorting"
            )
            yield inp

            filter_inp = Input(
                placeholder="Filter staged queue...",
                id="input-queue-filter",
            )
            filter_inp.tooltip = "Filter staged queue items by typing keywords (filename, path, status, extension)"
            yield filter_inp

            with Container(classes="dropzone-split-container"):
                table = DataTable(id="dropzone-staging-table")
                table.cursor_type = "row"
                table.tooltip = (
                    "Interactive staging queue displaying file status and details"
                )
                yield table

                with Vertical(id="dropzone-metadata-preview"):
                    yield Label("📋 Metadata Preview", classes="preview-header")
                    yield Label("Path: N/A", id="preview-path", classes="preview-field")
                    yield Label("Size: N/A", id="preview-size", classes="preview-field")
                    yield Label(
                        "Modified: N/A", id="preview-mtime", classes="preview-field"
                    )
                    yield Label(
                        "Status: N/A", id="preview-status", classes="preview-field"
                    )

            with Horizontal(classes="queue-row"):
                btn_filter = Button(
                    "Filter Unsupported", id="btn-filter-unsupported", variant="warning"
                )
                btn_filter.tooltip = "Remove unsupported file formats from the queue"
                yield btn_filter

                btn_remove = Button(
                    "Remove Item", id="btn-remove-item", variant="error"
                )
                btn_remove.tooltip = "Remove the selected row from the staging table"
                yield btn_remove

                btn_up = Button("Move Up", id="btn-move-up", variant="default")
                btn_up.tooltip = "Move selected item up in queue priority"
                yield btn_up

                btn_down = Button("Move Down", id="btn-move-down", variant="default")
                btn_down.tooltip = "Move selected item down in queue priority"
                yield btn_down

                btn_clear = Button(
                    "Clear Queue", id="btn-clear-queue", variant="default"
                )
                btn_clear.tooltip = "Clear all staged items from the modal"
                yield btn_clear

            status_lbl = Label(
                "Ready. Drop or enter paths above.",
                id="dropzone-status",
                classes="status-text",
            )
            status_lbl.tooltip = (
                "Live visual progress indicators and classification status messages"
            )
            yield status_lbl

            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_cancel = Button("Cancel", id="btn-cancel", variant="default")
                btn_cancel.tooltip = "Cancel dropzone triage operation and close dialog"
                yield btn_cancel

                btn_help = Button(
                    "Help", id="btn-help", variant="warning", classes="hidden"
                )
                btn_help.tooltip = (
                    "Open troubleshooting documentation for dropzone errors"
                )
                yield btn_help

                btn_process = Button("Sort Items", id="btn-process", variant="primary")
                btn_process.tooltip = (
                    "Start automated classification and relocation on dropped paths"
                )
                yield btn_process

    def _format_size(self, size_bytes: int) -> str:
        """Format size in bytes to human readable string."""
        if size_bytes <= 0:
            return "0 B"
        units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"]
        size = float(size_bytes)
        idx = 0
        while size >= 1024.0 and idx < len(units) - 1:
            size /= 1024.0
            idx += 1
        if idx == 0:
            return f"{int(size)} B"
        return f"{size:.1f} {units[idx]}"

    def get_filter_query(self) -> str:
        """Get lowercase trimmed search query from input-queue-filter field."""
        try:
            inp = self.query_one("#input-queue-filter", Input)
            return inp.value.strip().lower()
        except Exception:
            return ""

    def get_filtered_items(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Return list of staged items filtered by search query."""
        query = self.get_filter_query()
        if not query:
            return list(self.staged_items)
        return [
            item
            for item in self.staged_items
            if query in item["filename"].lower()
            or query in item["path"].lower()
            or query in item["extension"].lower()
            or query in item["status"].lower()
        ]

    def _refresh_table(self) -> None:
        """Re-render staging table with items matching active search filter."""
        try:
            table = self.query_one("#dropzone-staging-table", DataTable)
        except Exception:
            return
        table.clear(columns=True)
        table.add_columns("Status", "Filename", "Extension", "Size", "Full Path")
        filtered = self.get_filtered_items()
        for item in filtered:
            table.add_row(
                item["status"],
                item["filename"],
                item["extension"],
                item["size_str"],
                item["path"],
            )
        self.update_active_metadata_preview()

    def update_metadata_preview(self, item: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> None:
        """Update metadata preview card panel for given staged item."""
        if item is None:
            path_str = "N/A"
            size_str = "N/A"
            mtime_str = "N/A"
            status_str = "N/A"
        else:
            path_str = item.get("path", "N/A")
            size_str = item.get("size_str", "N/A")
            status_str = item.get("status", "N/A")
            if path_str and path_str != "N/A" and os.path.exists(path_str):
                try:
                    mtime = os.path.getmtime(path_str)
                    mtime_str = datetime.fromtimestamp(mtime).strftime(
                        "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"
                    )
                except Exception:
                    mtime_str = "Error reading timestamp"
            else:
                mtime_str = "N/A"

        try:
            self.query_one("#preview-path", Label).update(f"Path: {path_str}")
            self.query_one("#preview-size", Label).update(f"Size: {size_str}")
            self.query_one("#preview-mtime", Label).update(f"Modified: {mtime_str}")
            self.query_one("#preview-status", Label).update(f"Status: {status_str}")
        except Exception:
            pass

    def update_active_metadata_preview(self) -> None:
        """Fetch item corresponding to current table cursor row and update metadata preview."""
        try:
            table = self.query_one("#dropzone-staging-table", DataTable)
            row_idx = table.cursor_row
            filtered = self.get_filtered_items()
            if row_idx is not None and 0 <= row_idx < len(filtered):
                self.update_metadata_preview(filtered[row_idx])
            else:
                self.update_metadata_preview(None)
        except Exception:
            self.update_metadata_preview(None)

    @on(Input.Changed, "#input-queue-filter")
    def on_queue_filter_changed(self, event: Input.Changed) -> None:
        """Handle search filter text changes to dynamically update visible table rows."""
        self._refresh_table()

    @on(DataTable.RowHighlighted)
    def _on_table_row_highlighted(self, event: DataTable.RowHighlighted) -> None:
        """Update metadata preview panel on table row focus/highlight."""
        self.update_active_metadata_preview()

    @on(DataTable.RowSelected)
    def _on_table_row_selected(self, event: DataTable.RowSelected) -> None:
        """Update metadata preview panel on table row selection."""

    def _on_table_cell_highlighted(self, event: DataTable.CellHighlighted) -> None:

    def stage_paths(self, raw_text: str) -> None:
        """Parse raw input string, expand directories, validate, and stage items."""
        raw_items = [
            p.strip().strip("'\"")
            for p in raw_text.replace("\r", "\n").split("\n")
            if p.strip()
        ]
        if not raw_items:
            return

        from app.core.scanner import get_files_recursively

        protected = (
            getattr(self.settings, "PROTECTED_PATHS", []) if self.settings else []
        )
        new_count = 0

        for item in raw_items:
            abs_p = os.path.abspath(item)
            if os.path.isdir(abs_p):
                # The scanner returns paths relative to the folder it walked.
                files = get_files_recursively(abs_p)
                for f_path in files:
                    self._add_single_file_to_staging(
                        os.path.join(abs_p, f_path), protected
                    )
                    new_count += 1
            else:
                self._add_single_file_to_staging(abs_p, protected)
                new_count += 1

        self._refresh_table()
        try:
            inp = self.query_one("#input-drop-paths", Input)
            inp.value = ""
        except Exception:
            pass

        ready_cnt = sum(1 for item in self.staged_items if item["status"] == "Ready")
        msg = f"Staged {new_count} item(s). Queue total: {len(self.staged_items)} ({ready_cnt} ready)."
        self.update_status_msg(msg)

    def _add_single_file_to_staging(self, abs_p: str, protected: List[str]) -> None:
        """Validate and append a single file path to staged_items."""
        from app.core.mover import is_subpath_or_equal

        is_prot = False
        for prot in protected:
            if prot and is_subpath_or_equal(abs_p, prot):
                is_prot = True
                break

        filename = os.path.basename(abs_p) or abs_p
        ext = os.path.splitext(abs_p)[1].lower()

        if is_prot:
            status = "BLOCKED"
            size_bytes = os.path.getsize(abs_p) if os.path.exists(abs_p) else 0
        elif not os.path.exists(abs_p):
            status = "Not Found"
            size_bytes = 0
        elif ext not in self.SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS:
            status = "Unsupported"
            size_bytes = os.path.getsize(abs_p) if os.path.exists(abs_p) else 0
        else:
            status = "Ready"
            size_bytes = os.path.getsize(abs_p)

        size_str = self._format_size(size_bytes)

        if not any(item["path"] == abs_p for item in self.staged_items):
            self.staged_items.append(
                {
                    "path": abs_p,
                    "filename": filename,
                    "extension": ext,
                    "size": size_bytes,
                    "size_str": size_str,
                    "status": status,
                }
            )

    def filter_unsupported_items(self) -> None:
        """Remove items with 'Unsupported' status from the queue."""
        before = len(self.staged_items)
        self.staged_items = [
            item for item in self.staged_items if item["status"] != "Unsupported"
        ]
        removed = before - len(self.staged_items)
        self._refresh_table()
        msg = f"Filtered {removed} unsupported item(s) from queue. {len(self.staged_items)} item(s) remaining."
        self.update_status_msg(msg)

    def remove_selected_item(self) -> None:
        """Remove currently selected row from the staging table."""
        try:
            table = self.query_one("#dropzone-staging-table", DataTable)
            row_idx = table.cursor_row
        except Exception:
            row_idx = None

        filtered = self.get_filtered_items()
        if row_idx is not None and 0 <= row_idx < len(filtered):
            removed_item = filtered[row_idx]
            if removed_item in self.staged_items:
                self.staged_items.remove(removed_item)
            self._refresh_table()
            msg = f"Removed '{removed_item['filename']}' from queue. {len(self.staged_items)} item(s) remaining."
            self.update_status_msg(msg)
            new_filtered = self.get_filtered_items()
            if new_filtered:
                new_idx = min(row_idx, len(new_filtered) - 1)
                try:
                    table.move_cursor(row=new_idx)
                except Exception:
                    pass
            self.update_active_metadata_preview()
        else:
            self.update_status_msg("No item selected to remove.")

    def move_selected_item_up(self) -> None:
        """Move selected queue item up in priority."""
        try:
            table = self.query_one("#dropzone-staging-table", DataTable)
            row_idx = table.cursor_row
        except Exception:
            row_idx = None

        filtered = self.get_filtered_items()
        if row_idx is not None and 0 < row_idx < len(filtered):
            item_curr = filtered[row_idx]
            item_prev = filtered[row_idx - 1]
            idx_curr = self.staged_items.index(item_curr)
            idx_prev = self.staged_items.index(item_prev)
            self.staged_items[idx_curr], self.staged_items[idx_prev] = (
                self.staged_items[idx_prev],
                self.staged_items[idx_curr],
            )
            self._refresh_table()
            try:
                table.move_cursor(row=row_idx - 1)
            except Exception:
                pass
            self.update_active_metadata_preview()
            self.update_status_msg(
                f"Moved '{item_curr['filename']}' up in queue priority."
            )

    def move_selected_item_down(self) -> None:
        """Move selected queue item down in priority."""
        try:
            table = self.query_one("#dropzone-staging-table", DataTable)
            row_idx = table.cursor_row
        except Exception:
            row_idx = None

        filtered = self.get_filtered_items()
        if row_idx is not None and 0 <= row_idx < len(filtered) - 1:
            item_curr = filtered[row_idx]
            item_next = filtered[row_idx + 1]
            idx_curr = self.staged_items.index(item_curr)
            idx_next = self.staged_items.index(item_next)
            self.staged_items[idx_curr], self.staged_items[idx_next] = (
                self.staged_items[idx_next],
                self.staged_items[idx_curr],
            )
            self._refresh_table()
            try:
                table.move_cursor(row=row_idx + 1)
            except Exception:
                pass
            self.update_active_metadata_preview()
            self.update_status_msg(
                f"Moved '{item_curr['filename']}' down in queue priority."
            )

    def clear_queue(self) -> None:
        """Clear all staged items from modal queue."""
        self.staged_items.clear()
        self._refresh_table()
        self.update_status_msg("Cleared all staged items from the queue.")

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus input on mount, render staging table, and announce modal opening."""
        self._app_ref = self.app
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        self._refresh_table()
        try:
            self.query_one("#input-drop-paths", Input).focus()
        except Exception:

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-help")
    def action_help(self) -> None:
        """Open troubleshooting documentation link for dropzone."""
        url = getattr(
            self,
            "help_url",
            f"{TROUBLESHOOTING_URL}#dropzone-errors",

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Dismiss dropzone modal."""
        self._close_pending_drop()
        self.announce("Cancelled dropzone modal dialog.")
        self.dismiss(None)

    def trigger_drop_triage(self) -> None:
        """Parse input paths if any, validate active queue, and trigger worker."""
        try:
            inp = self.query_one("#input-drop-paths", Input)
            raw_text = inp.value.strip()
        except Exception:
            raw_text = ""

        if raw_text:
            self.stage_paths(raw_text)

        help_url = f"{TROUBLESHOOTING_URL}#dropzone-errors"

        filtered = self.get_filtered_items()
        ready_paths = [item["path"] for item in filtered if item["status"] == "Ready"]

        if not ready_paths:
            blocked_items = [
                item for item in filtered if item["status"] == "BLOCKED"
            ] or [item for item in self.staged_items if item["status"] == "BLOCKED"]
            if blocked_items:
                err_text = f"Protected path blocked: {blocked_items[0]['filename']}"
            elif self.staged_items:
                err_text = "No ready files to sort in queue."
            else:
                err_text = "No file or folder paths provided."

            self._show_help_button(help_url)
            from app.ui.notifications import notify

            notify(f"DropZone error: {err_text}", type="error", help_url=help_url)
            self.update_status_msg(
                f"Protected path blocked: {blocked_items[0]['path']}"
                if blocked_items
                else f"Error: {err_text}",
                help_url=help_url,
            )
            return

        self.update_status_msg(f"Processing {len(ready_paths)} dropped item(s)...")
        self.run_drop_worker(ready_paths)

    def update_status_msg(self, msg: str, help_url: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
        """Update live status message region and screen reader announcement."""
        display_msg = f"{msg} [Help: {help_url}]" if help_url else msg
        try:
            lbl = self.query_one("#dropzone-status", Label)
            lbl.update(display_msg)
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.announce(msg, help_url=help_url)

    def _close_pending_drop(self) -> None:
        """Close the sessions of a planned but unexecuted drop."""
        for item in getattr(self, "_pending_drop", []):
            try:
                item["session"].close()
            except Exception:
                pass
        self._pending_drop = []

    @work(exclusive=True, thread=True)
    def run_drop_worker(self, target_paths: List[str]) -> None:
        """Plan the dropped items in a worker thread, then ask before moving."""
        app_ref = getattr(self, "_app_ref", None)
        self._close_pending_drop()
        pending: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        try:
            from app.core.pipeline import SortPipeline
            from app.core.scanner import get_files_recursively
            from app.core.session import AppSession

            # Plan every staged file in a folder together, so a dropped folder
            # is clustered as a whole instead of one file at a time.
            groups: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
            for path in target_paths:
                if os.path.isdir(path):
                    groups.setdefault(path, []).extend(get_files_recursively(path))
                else:
                    groups.setdefault(os.path.dirname(path), []).append(
                        os.path.basename(path)
                    )

            for base_dir, files in groups.items():
                if app_ref:
                    app_ref.call_from_thread(
                        self.update_status_msg,
                        f"Classifying {len(files)} file(s) in '{os.path.basename(base_dir)}'...",
                    )

                session = AppSession(self.settings, base_dir=base_dir)
                pending.append(
                    {
                        "path": base_dir,
                        "session": session,
                        "plan": None,
                        "file_count": len(files),
                    }
                )
                pending[-1]["plan"] = SortPipeline(session).plan(files)

            self._pending_drop = pending
            if app_ref:
                app_ref.call_from_thread(self._confirm_pending_drop)
            else:
                self._confirm_pending_drop()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Error during dropzone classification: {e}")
            self._pending_drop = pending
            self._close_pending_drop()
            if app_ref:
                app_ref.call_from_thread(
                    self.update_status_msg, f"Dropzone triage error: {e}"
                )

    def _confirm_pending_drop(self) -> None:
        """Show what the drop would do and wait for the user's go-ahead."""
        from app.core.domain_contracts import _make_json_serializable
        from app.core.plan_format import format_plan_tree

        lines: List[str] = []
        total_files = total_folders = 0
        for item in self._pending_drop:
            plan = _make_json_serializable(item["plan"])
            tree, n_files, n_folders = format_plan_tree(plan)
            if not n_files:
                continue
            total_files += n_files
            total_folders += n_folders
            lines.append(f"In {item['session'].base_dir}:")
            lines.extend(f"  {line}" for line in tree)

        if not total_files:
            self._close_pending_drop()
            self.update_status_msg("Nothing to sort: no files could be classified.")
            return

        summary = (
            f"Move {total_files} file(s) into {total_folders} folder(s)? "
            "Nothing has been moved yet."
        )
        self.update_status_msg(f"Review the plan: {summary}")

        def _on_answer(confirmed: Optional[bool]) -> None:
            if confirmed:
                self.update_status_msg(
                    "Relocating items according to generated sorting plan..."
                )
                self.run_drop_execute_worker()
            else:
                self._close_pending_drop()
                self.update_status_msg("Cancelled. No files were moved.")

        self.app.push_screen(DropPlanConfirmModal(summary, lines), _on_answer)

    @work(exclusive=True, thread=True)
    def run_drop_execute_worker(self) -> None:
        """Execute the confirmed drop plans in a worker thread."""
        app_ref = getattr(self, "_app_ref", None)
        pending = list(getattr(self, "_pending_drop", []))
        self._pending_drop = []
        processed_items = []
        failed_items = []
        outcomes = []
        try:
            from app.core.pipeline import SortPipeline

            for item in pending:
                try:
                    outcome = SortPipeline(item["session"]).execute(item["plan"])
                    outcomes.append(outcome)
                    processed_items.append(
                        {
                            "path": item["path"],
                            "summary": outcome.summary,
                            "file_count": item.get("file_count", 1),
                            "status": "success",
                        }
                    )
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.exception(
                        f"Error during dropzone relocation for {item.get('path')}: {e}"
                    )
                    failed_items.append(
                        {
                            "path": item.get("path"),
                            "error": str(e),
                            "file_count": item.get("file_count", 1),
                            "status": "failed",
                        }
                    )
                finally:
                    try:
                        item["session"].close()
                    except Exception:
                        pass

            succeeded_files = sum(i["file_count"] for i in processed_items)
            failed_files = sum(i["file_count"] for i in failed_items)
            total_items = len(pending)

            if not failed_items:
                status = "success"
                final_msg = (
                    f"Completed triage of {succeeded_files} dropped item(s): "
                    + " ".join(o.describe() for o in outcomes)
                )
            elif processed_items:
                status = "partial"
                err_summary = "; ".join(
                    f"{item['path']}: {item['error']}" for item in failed_items
                )
                descriptions = " ".join(o.describe() for o in outcomes)
                final_msg = (
                    f"Completed triage of {succeeded_files} item(s) "
                    f"({len(processed_items)} succeeded, {len(failed_items)} failed): "
                    f"{descriptions} Errors: {err_summary}"
                )
            else:
                status = "failed"
                err_summary = "; ".join(
                    f"{item['path']}: {item['error']}" for item in failed_items
                )
                final_msg = f"Dropzone triage failed for all {len(failed_items)} item(s): {err_summary}"

            if app_ref:
                app_ref.call_from_thread(self.update_status_msg, final_msg)

            result_dict = {
                "status": status,
                "processed_count": succeeded_files,
                "failed_files": failed_files,
                "items": processed_items,
                "failed_items": failed_items,
                "succeeded_count": len(processed_items),
                "failed_count": len(failed_items),
                "total_count": total_items,
            }
            self.processed_result = result_dict
            try:
                if app_ref:
                    app_ref.call_from_thread(self.dismiss, result_dict)
                else:
                    self.dismiss(result_dict)
            except Exception:
                pass
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Error during dropzone relocation: {e}")
            for item in pending:
                try:
                    item["session"].close()
                except Exception:
                    pass
            if app_ref:
                app_ref.call_from_thread(
                    self.update_status_msg, f"Dropzone triage error: {e}"
                )

def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
    """Compose floating dropzone modal overlay controls."""
    with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
        yield Heading(
            "Floating DropZone - Quick File Triage",
            level=1,
            classes="modal-title",
            id="modal-title",
        )
        with Vertical(classes="dropzone-target"):
            yield Label(
                "📥 Drop or Paste File / Folder Paths Here",
                classes="dropzone-instructions",
            )
            yield Label(
                "Drag items onto terminal or paste absolute file paths to organize automatically",
                classes="dropzone-subinstructions",
            )
        inp = Input(
            placeholder="Paste or drop file / directory paths here...",
            id="input-drop-paths",
        )
        inp.tooltip = (
            "Enter or drop target file or folder paths to trigger automated sorting"
        )
        yield inp

        filter_inp = Input(
            placeholder="Filter staged queue...",
            id="input-queue-filter",
        )
        filter_inp.tooltip = "Filter staged queue items by typing keywords (filename, path, status, extension)"
        yield filter_inp

        with Container(classes="dropzone-split-container"):
            table = DataTable(id="dropzone-staging-table")
            table.cursor_type = "row"
            table.tooltip = (
                "Interactive staging queue displaying file status and details"
            )
            yield table

            with Vertical(id="dropzone-metadata-preview"):
                yield Label("📋 Metadata Preview", classes="preview-header")
                yield Label("Path: N/A", id="preview-path", classes="preview-field")
                yield Label("Size: N/A", id="preview-size", classes="preview-field")
                yield Label(
                    "Modified: N/A", id="preview-mtime", classes="preview-field"
                )
                yield Label(
                    "Status: N/A", id="preview-status", classes="preview-field"
                )

        with Horizontal(classes="queue-row"):
            btn_filter = Button(
                "Filter Unsupported", id="btn-filter-unsupported", variant="warning"
            )
            btn_filter.tooltip = "Remove unsupported file formats from the queue"
            yield btn_filter

            btn_remove = Button(
                "Remove Item", id="btn-remove-item", variant="error"
            )
            btn_remove.tooltip = "Remove the selected row from the staging table"
            yield btn_remove

            btn_up = Button("Move Up", id="btn-move-up", variant="default")
            btn_up.tooltip = "Move selected item up in queue priority"
            yield btn_up

            btn_down = Button("Move Down", id="btn-move-down", variant="default")
            btn_down.tooltip = "Move selected item down in queue priority"
            yield btn_down

            btn_clear = Button(
                "Clear Queue", id="btn-clear-queue", variant="default"
            )
            btn_clear.tooltip = "Clear all staged items from the modal"
            yield btn_clear

        status_lbl = Label(
            "Ready. Drop or enter paths above.",
            id="dropzone-status",
            classes="status-text",
        )
        status_lbl.tooltip = (
            "Live visual progress indicators and classification status messages"
        )
        yield status_lbl

        with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
            btn_cancel = Button("Cancel", id="btn-cancel", variant="default")
            btn_cancel.tooltip = "Cancel dropzone triage operation and close dialog"
            yield btn_cancel

            btn_help = Button(
                "Help", id="btn-help", variant="warning", classes="hidden"
            )
            btn_help.tooltip = (
                "Open troubleshooting documentation for dropzone errors"

@work(exclusive=True, thread=True)
def run_drop_execute_worker(self) -> None:
    """Execute the confirmed drop plans in a worker thread."""
    app_ref = getattr(self, "_app_ref", None)
    pending = list(getattr(self, "_pending_drop", []))
    self._pending_drop = []
    processed_items = []
    failed_items = []
    outcomes = []
    try:
        from app.core.pipeline import SortPipeline

        for item in pending:
            try:
                outcome = SortPipeline(item["session"]).execute(item["plan"])
                outcomes.append(outcome)
                processed_items.append(
                    {
                        "path": item["path"],
                        "summary": outcome.summary,
                        "file_count": item.get("file_count", 1),
                        "status": "success",
                    }
                )
            except Exception as e:
                logger.exception(
                    f"Error during dropzone relocation for {item.get('path')}: {e}"
                )
                failed_items.append(
                    {
                        "path": item.get("path"),
                        "error": str(e),
                        "file_count": item.get("file_count", 1),
                        "status": "failed",
                    }
                )
            finally:
                try:
                    item["session"].close()
                except Exception:
                    pass

        succeeded_files = sum(i["file_count"] for i in processed_items)
        failed_files = sum(i["file_count"] for i in failed_items)
        total_items = len(pending)

        if not failed_items:
            status = "success"
            final_msg = (
                f"Completed triage of {succeeded_files} dropped item(s): "
                + " ".join(o.describe() for o in outcomes)
            )
        elif processed_items:
            status = "partial"
            err_summary = "; ".join(
                f"{item['path']}: {item['error']}" for item in failed_items
            )
            descriptions = " ".join(o.describe() for o in outcomes)
            final_msg = (
                f"Completed triage of {succeeded_files} item(s) "
                f"({len(processed_items)} succeeded, {len(failed_items)} failed): "
                f"{descriptions} Errors: {err_summary}"
            )
        else:
            status = "failed"
            err_summary = "; ".join(
                f"{item['path']}: {item['error']}" for item in failed_items
            )
            final_msg = f"Dropzone triage failed for all {len(failed_items)} item(s): {err_summary}"

        if app_ref:
            app_ref.call_from_thread(self.update_status_msg, final_msg)

        result_dict = {
            "status": status,
            "processed_count": succeeded_files,
            "failed_files": failed_files,
            "items": processed_items,
            "failed_items": failed_items,
            "succeeded_count": len(processed_items),
            "failed_count": len(failed_items),
            "total_count": total_items,
        }
        self.processed_result = result_dict
        try:
            if app_ref:
                app_ref.call_from_thread(self.dismiss, result_dict)
            else:
                self.dismiss(result_dict)
        except Exception:
            pass
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception(f"Error during dropzone relocation: {e}")
        for item in pending:
            try:
                item["session"].close()
            except Exception:
                pass
        if app_ref:
            app_ref.call_from_thread(
                self.update_status_msg, f"Dropzone triage error: {e}"
            )

@work(exclusive=True, thread=True)
def run_drop_worker(self, target_paths: List[str]) -> None:
    """Plan the dropped items in a worker thread, then ask before moving."""
    app_ref = getattr(self, "_app_ref", None)
    self._close_pending_drop()
    pending: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    try:
        from app.core.pipeline import SortPipeline
        from app.core.scanner import get_files_recursively
        from app.core.session import AppSession

        # Plan every staged file in a folder together, so a dropped folder
        # is clustered as a whole instead of one file at a time.
        groups: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
        for path in target_paths:
            if os.path.isdir(path):
                groups.setdefault(path, []).extend(get_files_recursively(path))
            else:
                groups.setdefault(os.path.dirname(path), []).append(
                    os.path.basename(path)
                )

        for base_dir, files in groups.items():
            if app_ref:
                app_ref.call_from_thread(
                    self.update_status_msg,
                    f"Classifying {len(files)} file(s) in '{os.path.basename(base_dir)}'...",
                )

            session = AppSession(self.settings, base_dir=base_dir)
            pending.append(
                {
                    "path": base_dir,
                    "session": session,
                    "plan": None,
                    "file_count": len(files),
                }
            )
            pending[-1]["plan"] = SortPipeline(session).plan(files)

        self._pending_drop = pending
        if app_ref:
            app_ref.call_from_thread(self._confirm_pending_drop)
        else:
            self._confirm_pending_drop()
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception(f"Error during dropzone classification: {e}")
        self._pending_drop = pending
        self._close_pending_drop()
        if app_ref:
            app_ref.call_from_thread(
                self.update_status_msg, f"Dropzone triage error: {e}"
            )

def stage_paths(self, raw_text: str) -> None:
    """Parse raw input string, expand directories, validate, and stage items."""
    raw_items = [
        p.strip().strip("'\"")
        for p in raw_text.replace("\r", "\n").split("\n")
        if p.strip()
    ]
    if not raw_items:
        return

    from app.core.scanner import get_files_recursively

    protected = (
        getattr(self.settings, "PROTECTED_PATHS", []) if self.settings else []
    )
    new_count = 0

    for item in raw_items:
        abs_p = os.path.abspath(item)
        if os.path.isdir(abs_p):
            # The scanner returns paths relative to the folder it walked.
            files = get_files_recursively(abs_p)
            for f_path in files:
                self._add_single_file_to_staging(
                    os.path.join(abs_p, f_path), protected
                )
                new_count += 1
        else:
            self._add_single_file_to_staging(abs_p, protected)
            new_count += 1

    self._refresh_table()
    try:
        inp = self.query_one("#input-drop-paths", Input)
        inp.value = ""
    except Exception:
        pass

    ready_cnt = sum(1 for item in self.staged_items if item["status"] == "Ready")
    msg = f"Staged {new_count} item(s). Queue total: {len(self.staged_items)} ({ready_cnt} ready)."
    self.update_status_msg(msg)

def trigger_drop_triage(self) -> None:
    """Parse input paths if any, validate active queue, and trigger worker."""
    try:
        inp = self.query_one("#input-drop-paths", Input)
        raw_text = inp.value.strip()
    except Exception:
        raw_text = ""

    if raw_text:
        self.stage_paths(raw_text)

    help_url = f"{TROUBLESHOOTING_URL}#dropzone-errors"

    filtered = self.get_filtered_items()
    ready_paths = [item["path"] for item in filtered if item["status"] == "Ready"]

    if not ready_paths:
        blocked_items = [
            item for item in filtered if item["status"] == "BLOCKED"
        ] or [item for item in self.staged_items if item["status"] == "BLOCKED"]
        if blocked_items:
            err_text = f"Protected path blocked: {blocked_items[0]['filename']}"
        elif self.staged_items:
            err_text = "No ready files to sort in queue."
        else:
            err_text = "No file or folder paths provided."

        self._show_help_button(help_url)
        from app.ui.notifications import notify

        notify(f"DropZone error: {err_text}", type="error", help_url=help_url)
        self.update_status_msg(
            f"Protected path blocked: {blocked_items[0]['path']}"
            if blocked_items
            else f"Error: {err_text}",
            help_url=help_url,
        )
        return

    self.update_status_msg(f"Processing {len(ready_paths)} dropped item(s)...")
    self.run_drop_worker(ready_paths)

class DirectorySelectModal(
    ResponsiveLayoutMixin, A11yMixin, ModalScreen[Optional[Union[str, List[str]]]]
):
    """Modal dialog for choosing target base directory or presets."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    DirectorySelectModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 80;
        min-width: 30;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow .modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 95%;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .error-banner {
        color: $error;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    .preset-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        height: auto;
        min-height: 3;
    }
    .sources-list {
        margin-top: 1;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        color: $text;
        border: solid $primary;
        padding: 0 1;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    Button:focus, Input:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, current_dir: str = "", source_dirs: Optional[List[str]] = None):
        super().__init__()
        self.current_dir = current_dir
        self.added_via_btn = False
        if source_dirs:
            self.selected_sources = [
                d if str(d).startswith("/") else os.path.abspath(d)
                for d in source_dirs
                if d
            ]
        elif current_dir:
            self.selected_sources = [
                current_dir
                if str(current_dir).startswith("/")
                else os.path.abspath(current_dir)
            ]
        else:
            self.selected_sources = []

    @staticmethod
    def _validate_directory_path(path_str: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """Validate if path_str exists, is a directory, and allows read access.

        Returns error message string if invalid, or None if valid.
        """
        if not path_str or not path_str.strip():
            return "Directory path cannot be empty."

        clean_path = path_str.strip()
        expanded = os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(clean_path))

        try:
            if not os.path.exists(expanded):
                return f"Target directory does not exist: {clean_path}"

            if not os.path.isdir(expanded):
                return f"Path is not a directory: {clean_path}"

            if not os.access(expanded, os.R_OK):
                return f"Permission denied for directory: {clean_path}"
        except Exception as exc:
            return f"Invalid directory path: {exc}"

        return None

    def _show_error(self, message: str) -> None:
        """Display inline error banner, announce message, and focus input."""
        try:
            lbl = self.query_one("#lbl-error", Static)
            lbl.update(message)
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.announce(message, priority="assertive")
        try:
            self.query_one("#input-dir", Input).focus()
        except Exception:
            pass

    @on(Input.Changed, "#input-dir")
    def on_input_changed(self, event: Input.Changed) -> None:
        """Clear error banner when user changes input text."""
        try:
            lbl = self.query_one("#lbl-error", Static)
            lbl.update("")
        except Exception:
            pass

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose modal dialog children."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Select Target Directory",
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            inp = Input(
                value=self.current_dir,
                placeholder="Enter absolute directory path...",
                id="input-dir",
            )
            inp.tooltip = "Enter absolute target directory path to scan"
            yield inp
            yield Static("", id="lbl-error", classes="error-banner")
            yield Label("Selected Sources:", id="lbl-sources")
            yield Static(
                self._format_sources_display(),
                id="static-sources-list",
                classes="sources-list",
            )

    def _format_sources_display(self) -> str:
        if not self.selected_sources:
            return "(No source directories selected)"
        return "\n".join(f"• {d}" for d in self.selected_sources)

    def _update_sources_widget(self) -> None:
        try:
            st = self.query_one("#static-sources-list", Static)
            st.update(self._format_sources_display())
        except Exception:
            pass

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus input field on mount and emit screen reader announcement."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        self.query_one("#input-dir", Input).focus()
        self.announce("Opened target directory selection dialog.")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-add-dir")
    def action_add_dir(self) -> None:
        """Add input directory path to selected source list."""
        val = self.query_one("#input-dir", Input).value.strip()
        if not val:
            return
        err = self._validate_directory_path(val)
        if err:
            self._show_error(err)
            return

        abs_p = os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(val))
        if abs_p not in self.selected_sources:
            self.selected_sources.append(abs_p)
            self.announce(f"Added directory path: {abs_p}")
            self._update_sources_widget()
        self.added_via_btn = True
        try:
            self.query_one("#lbl-error", Static).update("")
        except Exception:
            pass

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#preset-demo")
    def action_demo(self) -> None:
        """Select sandbox demo workspace preset."""
        from app.core.sample_corpus import generate_sample_corpus
        from app.ui.notifications import notify

        path = os.path.abspath("sandbox/demo_workspace")
        if not os.path.exists(path):
            try:
                os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)
                created_msg = f"Created demo workspace directory: {path}"
                self.announce(created_msg)
                notify(created_msg, type="info")
            except Exception as exc:
                err_msg = f"Failed to create directory '{path}': {exc}"
                self.announce(err_msg, priority="assertive")
                notify(err_msg, type="error")
                return

        try:
            generate_sample_corpus(path, overwrite=True)
            sample_msg = f"Generated sample corpus documents in '{path}'."
            self.announce(sample_msg)
            notify(sample_msg, type="info")
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.error(f"Failed to generate sample corpus in '{path}': {exc}")
            err_msg = f"Failed to generate sample corpus: {exc}"
            self.announce(err_msg, priority="assertive")
            notify(err_msg, type="error")

        self.announce(f"Selected demo workspace preset: {path}")
        self.dismiss(path)

    def action_downloads(self) -> None:
        """Select user Downloads directory preset."""
        path = os.path.expanduser("~/Downloads")
        err = self._validate_directory_path(path)
        if err:
            self._show_error(err)
            return
        self.announce(f"Selected Downloads preset: {path}")
        self.dismiss(path)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#preset-documents")
    def action_documents(self) -> None:
        """Select user Documents directory preset."""
        path = os.path.expanduser("~/Documents")
        err = self._validate_directory_path(path)
        if err:
            self._show_error(err)
            return
        self.announce(f"Selected Documents preset: {path}")
        self.dismiss(path)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-confirm")
    def action_confirm(self) -> None:
        """Confirm directory selection."""
        val = self.query_one("#input-dir", Input).value.strip()
        if val:
            err = self._validate_directory_path(val)
            if err:
                self._show_error(err)
                return

            abs_p = os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(val))
            if not self.added_via_btn and len(self.selected_sources) <= 1:
                self.announce(f"Confirmed directory selection: '{abs_p}'")
                self.dismiss(abs_p)
                return

            if abs_p not in self.selected_sources:
                self.selected_sources.append(abs_p)

        if self.selected_sources:
            for source in self.selected_sources:
                err = self._validate_directory_path(source)
                if err:
                    self._show_error(err)
                    return

            self.announce(f"Confirmed directory selection: '{self.selected_sources}'")
            res = (
                self.selected_sources
                if len(self.selected_sources) > 1
                else self.selected_sources[0]
            )
            self.dismiss(res)
        else:
            self.announce("Cancelled directory selection.")
            self.dismiss(None)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel directory selection."""
        self.announce("Cancelled directory selection.")
        self.dismiss(None)

    @on(Input.Submitted)
    def action_submit(self) -> None:
        """Submit input on Enter key press."""
        self.action_confirm()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-browse")
    @work(thread=True)
    def action_native_browse(self) -> None:
        """Launch native OS directory browser dialog in background worker thread."""
        from app.core.native_dialog import NativeDialogError, select_native_directory

        curr_val = ""
        try:
            inp = self.query_one("#input-dir", Input)
            curr_val = inp.value.strip()
        except Exception:
            pass

        initial_dir = curr_val or self.current_dir

        try:
            chosen = select_native_directory(initial_dir)
            if chosen:
                self.app.call_from_thread(self._on_native_dir_selected, chosen)
        except NativeDialogError as exc:
            self.app.call_from_thread(self._on_native_dir_failed, str(exc))
        except Exception as exc:
            self.app.call_from_thread(self._on_native_dir_failed, str(exc))

    def _on_native_dir_selected(self, path: str) -> None:
        """Handle decoded UTF-8 path string from native folder browser."""
        abs_p = os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(path))
        try:
            inp = self.query_one("#input-dir", Input)
            inp.value = abs_p
        except Exception:
            pass
        if abs_p not in self.selected_sources:
            self.selected_sources.append(abs_p)
            self._update_sources_widget()
        self.announce(f"Selected native folder path: {abs_p}")

    def _on_native_dir_failed(self, reason: str) -> None:
        """Handle native folder dialog failure by falling back to manual path entry."""
        from app.ui.notifications import notify

        msg = "Native folder browser failed to launch. Please enter path manually."
        self.announce(msg, priority="assertive")
        notify(msg, type="warning")
        try:
            inp = self.query_one("#input-dir", Input)
            inp.focus()
        except Exception:
            pass

class DuplicateReviewModal(
    ResponsiveLayoutMixin, A11yMixin, ModalScreen[Optional[Dict[str, str]]]
):
    """Modal dialog for pre-move interactive duplicate cluster review and resolution."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    DuplicateReviewModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 90;
        min-width: 40;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow .modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 95%;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .modal-subtitle {
        color: $text-muted;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .duplicate-card {
        background: $surface;
        border: solid $accent;
        padding: 1;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .card-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
    }
    .card-subtitle {
        color: $text-muted;
    }
    .source-item {
        color: $text;
        margin-left: 2;
    }
    .action-select {
        margin-top: 1;
        width: 100%;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    Button:focus, Select:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        duplicate_groups: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.duplicate_groups = duplicate_groups or []
        self.user_selections: Dict[str, str] = {
            g["group_id"]: g.get("default_action", "rename")
            for g in self.duplicate_groups
        }

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose duplicate review dialog widgets."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Duplicate Cluster Review & Resolution",
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            yield Label(
                "Review duplicate destination target collisions before physical move execution:",
                classes="modal-subtitle",
            )

            with Vertical(id="duplicate-groups-list"):
                for group in self.duplicate_groups:
                    gid = group["group_id"]
                    tf_name = group.get("target_filename", "Collision")
                    t_dir = group.get("target_dir", "")
                    items = group.get("items", [])
                    default_action = group.get("default_action", "rename")

                    with Vertical(classes="duplicate-card", id=f"card-{gid}"):
                        yield Label(
                            f"Destination Target: {tf_name} ({t_dir})",
                            classes="card-title",
                        )
                        yield Label(
                            f"Colliding source files ({len(items)}):",
                            classes="card-subtitle",
                        )
                        for item in items:
                            rel_src = item.get("relative_source") or item.get(
                                "source_path", ""
                            )
                            yield Label(f"• {rel_src}", classes="source-item")

                        options = [
                            ("Rename (auto-number duplicates)", "rename"),
                            ("Keep Primary File Only", "keep"),
                            ("Skip Moving Duplicates", "skip"),
                        ]
                        sel = Select(
                            options,
                            value=default_action,
                            id=f"select-action-{gid}",
                            classes="action-select",
                            allow_blank=False,
                        )
                        sel.tooltip = (
                            f"Select deduplication resolution action for {tf_name}"
                        )
                        sel.aria_label = (
                            f"Resolution action for duplicate group {tf_name}"
                        )
                        yield sel

            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                yield Button(
                    "Apply & Execute Moves",
                    variant="primary",
                    id="btn-confirm-duplicates",
                )
                yield Button("Cancel", id="btn-cancel-duplicates")

    def _update_layout(self, width: int) -> None:
        """Update responsiveness based on modal container width."""
        if width < 60:
            self.add_class("narrow")
        else:
            self.remove_class("narrow")

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus initial widget on mount and announce to screen reader."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        if self.duplicate_groups:
            first_gid = self.duplicate_groups[0]["group_id"]
            try:
                self.query_one(f"#select-action-{first_gid}", Select).focus()
            except Exception:
                try:
                    self.query_one("#btn-confirm-duplicates", Button).focus()
                except Exception:
                    pass
        else:
            try:
                self.query_one("#btn-confirm-duplicates", Button).focus()
            except Exception:
                pass
        self.announce("Opened interactive duplicate review modal.")

    @on(Select.Changed)
    def on_select_changed(self, event: Select.Changed) -> None:
        """Record user selection updates for duplicate groups."""
        if event.select.id and event.select.id.startswith("select-action-"):
            gid = event.select.id.replace("select-action-", "")
            if event.value is not None:
                self.user_selections[gid] = str(event.value)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-confirm-duplicates")
    def action_confirm(self) -> None:
        """Confirm deduplication selections and dismiss dialog."""
        self.announce("Applied duplicate resolution selections.")
        self.dismiss(self.user_selections)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel-duplicates")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel duplicate review and abort execution."""
        self.announce("Cancelled duplicate review dialog.")
        self.dismiss(None)

class ManualPathFallbackModal(A11yMixin, ModalScreen[Optional[str]]):
    """Fallback modal dialog for manual directory path entry when native selection fails."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    ManualPathFallbackModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $warning;
        width: 80%;
        max-width: 70;
        height: auto;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, current_dir: str = "", reason: str = ""):
        super().__init__()
        self.current_dir = current_dir
        self.reason = reason

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose modal fallback UI children."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Label("Manual Directory Entry", classes="modal-title")
            if self.reason:
                yield Label(f"Native tool notice: {self.reason}", id="lbl-reason")
            yield Label("Please enter target directory path manually:")
            inp = Input(
                value=self.current_dir,
                placeholder="Enter absolute folder path...",
                id="input-fallback-dir",
            )
            yield inp
            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_cancel = Button(
                    "Cancel", id="btn-cancel-fallback", variant="default"
                )
                yield btn_cancel
                btn_confirm = Button(
                    "Confirm", id="btn-confirm-fallback", variant="primary"
                )
                yield btn_confirm

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus input field on mount and announce screen reader alert."""
        self.query_one("#input-fallback-dir", Input).focus()
        self.announce("Opened manual directory entry fallback dialog.")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-confirm-fallback")
    @on(Input.Submitted, "#input-fallback-dir")
    def action_confirm(self) -> None:
        """Confirm manual path entry."""
        val = self.query_one("#input-fallback-dir", Input).value.strip()
        if val:
            abs_p = os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(val))
            self.announce(f"Confirmed manual directory entry: '{abs_p}'")
            self.dismiss(abs_p)
        else:
            self.announce("Cancelled manual directory entry.")
            self.dismiss(None)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel-fallback")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel manual path entry."""
        self.announce("Cancelled manual directory entry.")
        self.dismiss(None)

class ReassignModal(ResponsiveLayoutMixin, A11yMixin, ModalScreen[Optional[str]]):
    """Modal dialog for reassigning checked file nodes to a target category folder."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    ReassignModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 80;
        min-width: 30;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow .modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 95%;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    Button:focus, Input:focus, Select:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, existing_folders: List[str], count: int = 1):
        super().__init__()
        self.existing_folders = [f for f in existing_folders if f]
        self.count = count

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose modal dialog children."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                f"Reassign {self.count} Selected File(s)",
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            yield Heading("Select Existing Target Folder:", level=2)
            options = [(f, f) for f in sorted(self.existing_folders)]
            if options:
                yield Select(options, prompt="Choose folder...", id="select-folder")
            yield Heading("Or Enter New Target Category Folder Name:", level=2)
            inp = Input(
                placeholder="e.g. Drafts, Financials, Archive",
                id="input-target-folder",
            )
            inp.tooltip = "Enter target folder category name"
            yield inp
            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_cancel = Button("Cancel", id="btn-cancel", variant="default")
                btn_cancel.tooltip = "Cancel reassign dialog"
                yield btn_cancel
                btn_confirm = Button("Reassign", id="btn-confirm", variant="primary")
                btn_confirm.tooltip = "Confirm bulk reassignment"
                yield btn_confirm

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus input field on mount and emit announcement."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        self.query_one("#input-target-folder", Input).focus()
        self.announce(f"Opened bulk reassign dialog for {self.count} items.")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-confirm")
    def action_confirm(self) -> None:
        """Confirm reassign action."""
        val = self.query_one("#input-target-folder", Input).value.strip()
        if not val:
            try:
                sel = self.query_one("#select-folder", Select)
                if sel.value is not Select.BLANK and sel.value:
                    val = str(sel.value)
            except Exception:
                pass
        if val:
            self.announce(f"Reassigning to target folder '{val}'.")
        else:
            self.announce("Cancelled bulk reassign.")
        self.dismiss(val if val else None)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel reassign action."""
        self.announce("Cancelled bulk reassign.")
        self.dismiss(None)

    @on(Input.Submitted)
    def action_submit(self) -> None:
        """Submit reassign on Enter key press."""
        self.action_confirm()

class RenameModal(ResponsiveLayoutMixin, A11yMixin, ModalScreen[Optional[str]]):
    """Modal dialog for renaming a file or folder node with pattern token formatting support."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    RenameModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 80;
        min-width: 30;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow .modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 95%;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .modal-subtitle {
        color: $text-muted;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .token-help {
        color: $text-muted;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .modal-preview {
        color: $accent;
        margin-top: 1;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    Button:focus, Input:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        title: str,
        current_name: str = "",
        extension: str = "",
        category: str = "",
        file_date: str = "",
        seq: int = 1,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.modal_title = title
        self.current_name = current_name
        self.extension = extension
        self.category = category
        self.file_date = file_date
        self.seq = seq

    def _evaluate_preview(self, pattern_str: str) -> str:
        """Evaluate formatted pattern string for live preview."""
        from app.core.pattern_formatter import PatternTokenFormatter

        metadata = {
            "original": self.current_name,
            "extension": self.extension,
            "category": self.category,
            "date": self.file_date,
            "seq": self.seq,
        }
        fallback = (
            f"{self.current_name}{self.extension}"
            if self.extension
            else self.current_name
        )
        return PatternTokenFormatter.format_pattern(
            pattern=pattern_str,
            metadata=metadata,
            seq=self.seq,
            fallback_original=fallback,
        )

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose modal dialog children."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                self.modal_title,
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            if self.extension:
                yield Label(
                    f"Extension '{self.extension}' is locked unless modified in template",
                    classes="modal-subtitle",
                )
            yield Label(
                "Tokens: {date}, {category}, {original}, {extension}, {seq}",
                classes="token-help",
            )
            inp = Input(
                value=self.current_name,
                placeholder="Enter new name or pattern (e.g. {date}_{category}_{original})...",
                id="input-name",
            )
            inp.tooltip = "Enter new file or folder name or pattern template"
            yield inp
            yield Label(
                f"Preview: {self._evaluate_preview(self.current_name)}",
                id="label-preview",
                classes="modal-preview",
            )
            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_cancel = Button("Cancel", id="btn-cancel", variant="default")
                btn_cancel.tooltip = "Cancel rename action and close dialog"
                yield btn_cancel
                btn_confirm = Button("Rename", id="btn-confirm", variant="primary")
                btn_confirm.tooltip = "Confirm renaming action"
                yield btn_confirm

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus input field on mount and emit screen reader announcement."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        self.query_one("#input-name", Input).focus()
        self.announce(
            f"Opened rename dialog for '{self.modal_title}'. Enter new name or pattern and press Enter or click Rename."
        )

    @on(Input.Changed, "#input-name")
    def on_input_changed(self, event: Input.Changed) -> None:
        """Update live preview on input value change."""
        try:
            preview_str = self._evaluate_preview(event.value)
            lbl = self.query_one("#label-preview", Label)
            lbl.update(f"Preview: {preview_str}")
        except Exception:
            pass

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-confirm")
    def action_confirm(self) -> None:
        """Confirm renaming action."""
        val = self.query_one("#input-name", Input).value.strip()
        formatted = self._evaluate_preview(val) if val else ""
        if formatted:
            self.announce(f"Confirmed rename to '{formatted}'.")
        else:
            self.announce("Cancelled rename action.")
        self.dismiss(formatted if formatted else None)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel renaming action."""
        self.announce("Cancelled rename action.")
        self.dismiss(None)

    @on(Input.Submitted)
    def action_submit(self) -> None:
        """Submit input on Enter key press."""
        self.action_confirm()
