class ModelManagerModal(ResponsiveLayoutMixin, A11yMixin, ModalScreen[None]):
    """Modal screen for interactive local ONNX model management."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Close dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    ModelManagerModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 80;
        min-width: 30;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow .modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 95%;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .field-label {
        margin-top: 1;
        color: $text;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    .info-label {
        margin-top: 0;
        color: $text;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    Button:focus, Input:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, settings=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.settings = settings
        self._prev_is_downloading = False
        self._prev_status_text = ""

    def _resolve_model_dir(self) -> str:
        """Resolve primary model directory path."""
        try:
            from app.config import get_app_dir

            return str(get_app_dir() / "model")
        except Exception:
            return os.path.expanduser("~/.smart-autosorter/model")

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose modal dialog children."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Interactive Model Management [Ctrl+K]",
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )

            yield Heading("Model Status:", level=2, classes="field-label")
            yield Label(
                "Status: Checking...", id="lbl-model-status", classes="info-label"
            )
            yield Label(
                "Location: Checking...", id="lbl-model-path", classes="info-label"
            )
            yield Label("Size on Disk: 0 MB", id="lbl-model-size", classes="info-label")
            yield Label(
                "Verification: Checking...", id="lbl-model-hash", classes="info-label"
            )

            yield Heading(
                "Download Progress & Throughput:", level=2, classes="field-label"
            )
            pb = ProgressBar(total=100, show_percentage=True, id="progress-bar")
            pb.tooltip = "Active model download percentage progress"
            yield pb

            lbl_progress = Label("Idle", id="lbl-progress-status", classes="info-label")
            lbl_progress.tooltip = "Current download stage and throughput metrics"
            yield lbl_progress

            yield Heading("Network Proxy Options:", level=2, classes="field-label")
            proxy_val = getattr(self.settings, "PROXY", "") if self.settings else ""
            inp_proxy = Input(
                value=proxy_val,
                placeholder="http://proxy.example.com:8080",
                id="input-proxy",
            )
            inp_proxy.tooltip = "HTTP/HTTPS proxy URL for model weight transfers"
            yield inp_proxy

            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_start = Button("Start Download", id="btn-start", variant="primary")
                btn_start.tooltip = "Start downloading local ONNX model weights"
                yield btn_start

                btn_cancel = Button("Cancel", id="btn-cancel-dl", variant="warning")
                btn_cancel.tooltip = "Cancel active model download thread"
                yield btn_cancel

                btn_retry = Button("Retry Download", id="btn-retry", variant="primary")
                btn_retry.tooltip = "Retry or restart model download"
                yield btn_retry

                btn_delete = Button("Delete Model", id="btn-delete", variant="error")
                btn_delete.tooltip = (
                    "Unload in-memory model instances and delete local files"
                )
                yield btn_delete

                btn_close = Button("Close", id="btn-close", variant="default")
                btn_close.tooltip = "Close Model Management dialog"
                yield btn_close

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus initial input, set polling timer, and announce modal launch."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        self.query_one("#input-proxy", Input).focus()
        self.announce("Opened Model Management dialog.")
        self._refresh_ui_state()
        self.set_interval(0.2, self._poll_download_status)

    def _apply_proxy(self) -> str:
        p_val = self.query_one("#input-proxy", Input).value.strip()
        if self.settings:
            setattr(self.settings, "PROXY", p_val)
        from app.core.downloader import DownloadManager

        dm = DownloadManager.get_instance()
        dm.update_proxy(p_val)
        return p_val

    def _refresh_ui_state(self) -> None:
        """Update model file info labels and control button states."""
        from app.core.downloader import DownloadManager, verify_downloaded_model

        dm = DownloadManager.get_instance()

        model_dir = self._resolve_model_dir()
        onnx_file = os.path.join(model_dir, "model.onnx")
        tmp_file = os.path.join(model_dir, "model.onnx.tmp")

        lbl_status = self.query_one("#lbl-model-status", Label)
        lbl_path = self.query_one("#lbl-model-path", Label)
        lbl_size = self.query_one("#lbl-model-size", Label)
        lbl_hash = self.query_one("#lbl-model-hash", Label)

        lbl_path.update(f"Location: {model_dir}")

        model_exists = os.path.exists(onnx_file) and os.path.getsize(onnx_file) > 0
        tmp_exists = os.path.exists(tmp_file)

        if model_exists:
            size_mb = os.path.getsize(onnx_file) / (1024 * 1024)
            lbl_size.update(f"Size on Disk: {size_mb:.2f} MB")
            lbl_status.update("Status: Downloaded & Present")
            if verify_downloaded_model(model_dir):
                lbl_hash.update("Verification: Valid (Cryptographically Verified)")
            else:
                lbl_hash.update("Verification: Unverified or Missing Configuration")
        elif tmp_exists:
            size_mb = os.path.getsize(tmp_file) / (1024 * 1024)
            lbl_size.update(f"Size on Disk: {size_mb:.2f} MB (Incomplete)")
            lbl_status.update("Status: Downloading / Incomplete")
            lbl_hash.update("Verification: Pending Finalization")
        else:
            lbl_size.update("Size on Disk: 0 MB")
            lbl_status.update("Status: Missing (Not Downloaded)")
            lbl_hash.update("Verification: N/A")

        is_dl = dm.state["is_downloading"]
        self.query_one("#btn-start", Button).disabled = is_dl
        self.query_one("#btn-cancel-dl", Button).disabled = not is_dl
        self.query_one("#btn-retry", Button).disabled = is_dl
        self.query_one("#btn-delete", Button).disabled = not (
            model_exists or tmp_exists or is_dl
        )

    def _poll_download_status(self) -> None:
        """Periodic non-blocking timer callback to poll download status."""
        from app.core.downloader import DownloadManager

        dm = DownloadManager.get_instance()

        is_dl = dm.state["is_downloading"]
        prog = float(dm.state["progress"])
        status_text = str(dm.state["status_text"] or "")
        err = dm.state["error"]
        succ = dm.state["success"]

        pb = self.query_one("#progress-bar", ProgressBar)
        pb.progress = min(100.0, max(0.0, prog * 100.0))

        lbl_prog = self.query_one("#lbl-progress-status", Label)
        if err:
            lbl_prog.update(f"Error: {err}")
        elif succ:
            lbl_prog.update("Download complete!")
        else:
            lbl_prog.update(
                status_text if status_text else ("Downloading..." if is_dl else "Idle")
            )

        if self._prev_is_downloading and not is_dl:
            if succ:
                self.announce(
                    "Model download completed successfully.", priority="polite"
                )
            elif err:
                self.announce(f"Model download failed: {err}", priority="assertive")
            elif "cancelled" in status_text.lower():
                self.announce("Model download cancelled.", priority="polite")

        self._prev_is_downloading = is_dl
        self._prev_status_text = status_text

        self._refresh_ui_state()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-start")
    def action_start_download(self) -> None:
        """Start background model weight download."""
        p_val = self._apply_proxy()
        from app.core.downloader import DEFAULT_MODEL_URL, DownloadManager

        dm = DownloadManager.get_instance()
        model_dir = self._resolve_model_dir()
        try:
            dm.start_download(DEFAULT_MODEL_URL, model_dir, proxy=p_val)
            self.announce("Started model download.", priority="polite")
        except Exception as e:
            from app.ui.notifications import notify

            notify(f"Download error: {e}", type="error")
            self.announce(f"Download error: {e}", priority="assertive")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel-dl")
    def action_cancel_download(self) -> None:
        """Cancel active model download thread."""
        from app.core.downloader import DownloadManager

        dm = DownloadManager.get_instance()
        dm.cancel_download()
        self.announce("Cancelled model download.", priority="polite")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-retry")
    def action_retry_download(self) -> None:
        """Retry model weight download operation."""
        p_val = self._apply_proxy()
        from app.core.downloader import DEFAULT_MODEL_URL, DownloadManager

        dm = DownloadManager.get_instance()
        if dm.state["is_downloading"]:
            dm.cancel_download()
        model_dir = self._resolve_model_dir()
        try:
            dm.start_download(DEFAULT_MODEL_URL, model_dir, proxy=p_val)
            self.announce("Retrying model download.", priority="polite")
        except Exception as e:
            from app.ui.notifications import notify

            notify(f"Download error: {e}", type="error")
            self.announce(f"Download error: {e}", priority="assertive")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-delete")
    def action_delete_model(self) -> None:
        """Asynchronously delete local model files."""
        from app.core.downloader import DownloadManager

        dm = DownloadManager.get_instance()
        model_dir = self._resolve_model_dir()

        def _on_done(success: bool, err: Optional[Exception]):
            if success:
                self.announce("Model deleted successfully.", priority="polite")
            else:
                self.announce(f"Model deletion failed: {err}", priority="assertive")

        dm.delete_model_async(model_dir, on_done=_on_done)
        self.announce("Deleting model weights...", priority="polite")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-close")
    def action_close(self) -> None:
        """Close model management dialog."""
        self.announce("Closed Model Management dialog.")
        self.dismiss(None)

    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel and close model management dialog."""
        self.announce("Closed Model Management dialog.")
        self.dismiss(None)

class QuarantineVaultModal(ResponsiveLayoutMixin, A11yMixin, ModalScreen[None]):
    """Interactive Modal Screen for Compliance Quarantine Vault & Audit Log Review."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Close quarantine vault", show=True),
        Binding("r", "release_selected", "Release file", show=True),
        Binding("d", "dismiss_selected", "Dismiss item", show=True),
        Binding("i", "reinspect_selected", "Re-inspect item", show=True),
        Binding("ctrl+r", "refresh_records", "Refresh vault", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    QuarantineVaultModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
    }
    .quarantine-modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $warning;
        width: 95%;
        max-width: 110;
        min-width: 60;
        height: 90%;
        min-height: 22;
        layout: vertical;
    }
    .narrow .quarantine-modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 98%;
    }
    .quarantine-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $warning;
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
    .quarantine-subtitle {
        color: $text-muted;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .quarantine-filter-row {
        height: 3;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        layout: horizontal;
    }
    #quarantine-search-input {
        width: 60%;
        margin-right: 1;
    }
    #quarantine-status-filter {
        width: 38%;
    }
    .quarantine-content-split {
        height: 1fr;
        layout: horizontal;
    }
    .narrow .quarantine-content-split {
        layout: vertical;
    }
    #quarantine-table-pane {
        width: 55%;
        height: 100%;
        border: solid $primary;
        margin-right: 1;
    }
    .narrow #quarantine-table-pane {
        width: 100%;
        height: 50%;
        margin-right: 0;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    #quarantine-detail-pane {
        width: 45%;
        height: 100%;
        border: solid $secondary;
        padding: 1;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow #quarantine-detail-pane {
        width: 100%;
        height: 50%;
    }
    .quarantine-detail-header {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .quarantine-detail-line {
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .quarantine-audit-header {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $primary;
        margin-top: 1;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .quarantine-button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        layout: horizontal;
        align: right middle;
    }
    .quarantine-button-row Button {
        margin-left: 1;
    }
    Button:focus, Input:focus, Select:focus, DataTable:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        db: Optional[Any] = None,
        base_dir: str = "",
        policies: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.db = db
        self.base_dir = base_dir
        self.policies = policies or []
        self.records: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        self.filtered_records: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        self.selected_job_id: Optional[str] = None

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose quarantine vault modal widgets."""
        with Vertical(classes="quarantine-modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Quarantine Vault & Compliance Audit Review [Ctrl+U]",
                level=1,
                classes="quarantine-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            yield Label(
                "Inspect staged files, view structured audit logs, release, or re-inspect compliance items:",
                classes="quarantine-subtitle",
            )

            with Horizontal(classes="quarantine-filter-row"):
                inp = Input(
                    placeholder="Search by job ID, filename, policy reason...",
                    id="quarantine-search-input",
                )
                inp.tooltip = (
                    "Filter quarantine records by job ID, filename, or policy reason"
                )
                yield inp

                sel = Select(
                    [
                        ("ALL Statuses", "ALL"),
                        ("STAGED", "STAGED"),
                        ("QUARANTINED", "QUARANTINED"),
                        ("IN_INSPECTION", "IN_INSPECTION"),
                        ("RELEASED", "RELEASED"),
                        ("DISMISSED", "DISMISSED"),
                        ("DEAD_LETTER_QUEUE", "DEAD_LETTER_QUEUE"),
                    ],
                    value="ALL",
                    id="quarantine-status-filter",
                    allow_blank=False,
                )
                sel.tooltip = "Filter quarantine records by status"
                yield sel

            with Horizontal(classes="quarantine-content-split"):
                dt = DataTable(id="quarantine-table")
                dt.tooltip = "Table of staged quarantine compliance records"
                dt.cursor_type = "row"
                with Vertical(id="quarantine-table-pane"):
                    yield dt

                with Vertical(id="quarantine-detail-pane"):
                    lbl = Heading(
                        "Select an item to view audit log & details",
                        level=2,
                        classes="quarantine-detail-header",
                        id="quarantine-detail-title",
                    )
                    lbl.tooltip = "Audit log and metadata details panel"
                    yield lbl
                    st = Static(
                        "No quarantine item selected.", id="quarantine-detail-content"
                    )
                    st.tooltip = "Structured audit log timeline view"
                    yield st

            with Horizontal(classes="quarantine-button-row"):
                btn_rel = Button(
                    "Release (r)", id="btn-quarantine-release", variant="success"
                )
                btn_rel.tooltip = (
                    "Release selected quarantined item to destination directory"
                )
                yield btn_rel

                btn_dis = Button(
                    "Dismiss (d)", id="btn-quarantine-dismiss", variant="warning"
                )
                btn_dis.tooltip = (
                    "Dismiss selected quarantine item without relocating file"
                )
                yield btn_dis

                btn_insp = Button(
                    "Re-inspect (i)", id="btn-quarantine-reinspect", variant="primary"
                )
                btn_insp.tooltip = (
                    "Trigger background forensic scan and policy evaluation"
                )
                yield btn_insp

                btn_ref = Button("Refresh", id="btn-quarantine-refresh")
                btn_ref.tooltip = "Refresh quarantine vault records from database"
                yield btn_ref

                btn_close = Button("Close (Esc)", id="btn-quarantine-close")
                btn_close.tooltip = "Close quarantine vault dialog"
                yield btn_close

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Initialize data table columns and trigger initial record fetch on mount."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        dt = self.query_one("#quarantine-table", DataTable)
        dt.add_columns("Job ID", "Filename", "Status", "Policy Action", "Created")
        self.announce("Opened Quarantine Vault modal.")
        self.action_refresh_records()

    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Close quarantine vault modal on Escape key press."""
        self.dismiss(None)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-quarantine-close")
    def action_close_button(self) -> None:
        """Close quarantine vault modal via close button."""
        self.dismiss(None)

    def _get_db(self) -> Any:
        if self.db is not None:
            return self.db
        from app.core.db_worker import DBWorker
        from app.core.store import open_store

        return open_store().database(DBWorker())

    def _call_ui(self, func, *args, **kwargs) -> None:
        try:
            app_obj = self.app
        except Exception:
            app_obj = None

        if app_obj and hasattr(app_obj, "call_from_thread"):
            try:
                app_obj.call_from_thread(func, *args, **kwargs)
                return
            except Exception:
                pass
        try:
            func(*args, **kwargs)
        except Exception:
            pass

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-quarantine-refresh")
    def action_refresh_records(self) -> None:
        """Refresh quarantine records from database."""
        self.fetch_records_async()

    @work(thread=True)
    def fetch_records_async(self) -> None:
        """Fetch quarantine records asynchronously on background worker thread."""
        try:
            db_inst = self._get_db()

            if self.base_dir:
                recs = db_inst.get_quarantine_records_by_base_dir(self.base_dir)
            else:
                recs = db_inst.get_all_quarantine_records()
            self._call_ui(self._on_records_loaded, recs)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Failed to fetch quarantine records: {e}")
            self._call_ui(self._on_records_loaded, [])
            self._call_ui(self.announce, f"Error loading quarantine records: {e}")

    def _on_records_loaded(self, records: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
        self.records = records
        self._apply_filters()
        self.announce(f"Loaded {len(records)} quarantine record(s).")

    @on(Input.Changed, "#quarantine-search-input")
    @on(Select.Changed, "#quarantine-status-filter")
    def _on_filter_changed(self) -> None:
        self._apply_filters()

    def _apply_filters(self) -> None:
        search_term = ""
        status_term = "ALL"
        try:
            search_term = (
                self.query_one("#quarantine-search-input", Input).value.strip().lower()
            )
            status_term = str(
                self.query_one("#quarantine-status-filter", Select).value or "ALL"
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

        filtered = []
        for r in self.records:
            st = r.get("status", "")
            if status_term != "ALL" and st != status_term:
                continue

            if search_term:
                job_id = (r.get("job_id") or "").lower()
                orig_file = (r.get("original_filepath") or "").lower()
                staged_file = (r.get("staged_filepath") or "").lower()
                action = (r.get("policy_action") or "").lower()
                if (
                    search_term not in job_id
                    and search_term not in orig_file
                    and search_term not in staged_file
                    and search_term not in action
                    and search_term not in st.lower()
                ):
                    continue
            filtered.append(r)

        self.filtered_records = filtered
        dt = self.query_one("#quarantine-table", DataTable)
        dt.clear()

        for r in filtered:
            job_id = r.get("job_id", "")
            orig_path = r.get("original_filepath", "")
            fname = os.path.basename(orig_path) if orig_path else job_id
            st = r.get("status", "")
            act = r.get("policy_action") or "-"
            created_ts = r.get("created_at", 0)
            created_str = (
                time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", time.localtime(created_ts))
                if created_ts
                else "-"
            )
            dt.add_row(job_id, fname, st, act, created_str, key=job_id)

        if filtered:
            if not self.selected_job_id or not any(
                x.get("job_id") == self.selected_job_id for x in filtered
            ):
                self.selected_job_id = filtered[0].get("job_id")
            self._render_detail_pane(self.selected_job_id)
        else:
            self.selected_job_id = None
            self._render_detail_pane(None)

    @on(DataTable.RowSelected)
    def _on_row_selected(self, event: DataTable.RowSelected) -> None:
        if event.row_key and event.row_key.value:
            self.selected_job_id = event.row_key.value
            self._render_detail_pane(self.selected_job_id)

    @on(DataTable.CellHighlighted)
    def _on_cell_highlighted(self, event: DataTable.CellHighlighted) -> None:
        if event.coordinate and (dt := self.query_one("#quarantine-table", DataTable)):
            try:
                row_key = dt.coordinate_to_cell_key(event.coordinate).row_key
                if row_key and row_key.value:
                    self.selected_job_id = row_key.value
                    self._render_detail_pane(self.selected_job_id)
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _get_selected_record(self, job_id: Optional[str]) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        if not job_id:
            return None
        for r in self.records:
            if r.get("job_id") == job_id:
                return r
        return None

    def _render_detail_pane(self, job_id: Optional[str]) -> None:
        try:
            title_lbl = self.query_one("#quarantine-detail-title", Label)
            content_st = self.query_one("#quarantine-detail-content", Static)
        except Exception:
            return

        record = self._get_selected_record(job_id)
        if not record:
            title_lbl.update("No item selected")
            content_st.update(
                "Select a row in the quarantine table to view its detailed structured audit log."
            )
            return

        title_lbl.update(f"Job Details: {record.get('job_id')}")

        lines = [
            f"[bold]Original Path:[/bold] {record.get('original_filepath', '-')}",
            f"[bold]Staged Path:[/bold] {record.get('staged_filepath', '-')}",
            f"[bold]Status:[/bold] {record.get('status', '-')}",
            f"[bold]Policy Action:[/bold] {record.get('policy_action') or '-'}",
            f"[bold]File Hash:[/bold] {record.get('file_hash') or '-'}",
            f"[bold]Base Directory:[/bold] {record.get('base_dir', '-')}",
        ]
        if err := record.get("error_message"):
            lines.append(f"[bold red]Error:[/bold red] {err}")

        lines.append("")
        lines.append("[bold cyan]Structured Audit Log Timeline:[/bold cyan]")
        audit_log = record.get("audit_log", [])
        if audit_log:
            for entry in audit_log:
                if isinstance(entry, dict):
                    ts = entry.get("timestamp", 0)
                    ts_str = (
                        time.strftime("%H:%M:%S", time.localtime(ts))
                        if ts
                        else "--:--:--"
                    )
                    st = entry.get("status", "")
                    det = entry.get("details", "")
                    lines.append(f"  [dim]{ts_str}[/dim] [bold]{st}[/bold]: {det}")
                else:
                    lines.append(f"  • {entry}")
        else:
            lines.append("  (No audit log entries recorded)")

        content_st.update("\n".join(lines))

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-quarantine-release")
    def action_release_selected(self) -> None:
        """Prompt destination directory and release selected quarantine item."""
        record = self._get_selected_record(self.selected_job_id)
        if not record:
            self.announce("No quarantine item selected for release.")
            return

        if record.get("status") == "RELEASED":
            self.announce(
                f"Quarantine item '{record.get('job_id')}' is already released."
            )
            return

        staged_path = record.get("staged_filepath")
        if not staged_path or not os.path.exists(staged_path):
            self.announce(
                f"Cannot release item '{record.get('job_id')}': Staged file missing at {staged_path}."
            )
            return

        orig_rel = record.get("original_filepath", "released_file")
        base_dir = record.get("base_dir") or self.base_dir or "."

        def _dir_selected_callback(target_dir: Optional[str]) -> None:
            if not target_dir:
                self.announce("Release operation cancelled.")
                return
            if not os.path.exists(target_dir) or not os.path.isdir(target_dir):
                from app.ui.notifications import notify

                err_msg = f"Target directory does not exist: {target_dir}"
                self.announce(err_msg, priority="assertive")
                notify(err_msg, type="error")
                return
            dest_file_path = os.path.join(target_dir, os.path.basename(orig_rel))
            self.execute_release_async(record, dest_file_path)

        self.app.push_screen(DirectorySelectModal(base_dir), _dir_selected_callback)

    @work(thread=True)
    def execute_release_async(self, record: dict, dest_file_path: str) -> None:
        """Asynchronously perform atomic quarantine relocation to destination path."""
        job_id = record["job_id"]
        staged_path = record["staged_filepath"]
        try:
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dest_file_path), exist_ok=True)
            from app.core.resilient_file_ops import atomic_quarantine_relocation

            with atomic_quarantine_relocation(staged_path, dest_file_path):
                db_inst = self._get_db()
                db_inst.update_quarantine_status(
                    job_id=job_id,
                    status="RELEASED",
                    audit_entry={
                        "timestamp": time.time(),
                        "status": "RELEASED",
                        "details": f"Released from quarantine modal to {dest_file_path}",
                    },
                )
            self._call_ui(self._on_release_success, job_id, dest_file_path)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to release quarantine job {job_id}: {e}")
            self._call_ui(self.announce, f"Release failed for {job_id}: {e}")

    def _on_release_success(self, job_id: str, dest_file_path: str) -> None:
        self.announce(
            f"Quarantine item '{job_id}' released successfully to {dest_file_path}."
        )
        self.fetch_records_async()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-quarantine-dismiss")
    def action_dismiss_selected(self) -> None:
        """Dismiss the selected quarantine item without restoring file."""
        record = self._get_selected_record(self.selected_job_id)
        if not record:
            self.announce("No quarantine item selected for dismissal.")
            return

        if record.get("status") == "DISMISSED":
            self.announce(
                f"Quarantine item '{record.get('job_id')}' is already dismissed."
            )
            return

        self.execute_dismiss_async(record["job_id"])

    @work(thread=True)
    def execute_dismiss_async(self, job_id: str) -> None:
        """Asynchronously mark quarantine item as dismissed in database."""
        try:
            db_inst = self._get_db()
            db_inst.update_quarantine_status(
                job_id=job_id,
                status="DISMISSED",
                audit_entry={
                    "timestamp": time.time(),
                    "status": "DISMISSED",
                    "details": "Dismissed manually via quarantine vault modal review",
                },
            )
            self._call_ui(self._on_dismiss_success, job_id)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to dismiss quarantine job {job_id}: {e}")
            self._call_ui(self.announce, f"Dismiss failed for {job_id}: {e}")

    def _on_dismiss_success(self, job_id: str) -> None:
        self.announce(f"Quarantine item '{job_id}' marked as DISMISSED.")
        self.fetch_records_async()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-quarantine-reinspect")
    def action_reinspect_selected(self) -> None:
        """Trigger background forensic re-inspection scan for selected item."""
        record = self._get_selected_record(self.selected_job_id)
        if not record:
            self.announce("No quarantine item selected for re-inspection.")
            return

        job_id = record["job_id"]
        self.announce(
            f"Initiating background forensic re-inspection for item '{job_id}'..."
        )
        self.execute_reinspect_async(job_id)

    @work(thread=True)
    def execute_reinspect_async(self, job_id: str) -> None:
        """Asynchronously execute policy re-inspection on worker thread."""
        try:
            db_inst = self._get_db()

            from app.core.quarantine_interceptor import QuarantineInterceptorService

            service = QuarantineInterceptorService(db=db_inst, policies=self.policies)
            res = service.process_quarantine_job(job_id)
            self._call_ui(self._on_reinspect_success, job_id, res)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to re-inspect quarantine job {job_id}: {e}")
            self._call_ui(self.announce, f"Re-inspection failed for {job_id}: {e}")

    def _on_reinspect_success(self, job_id: str, res: dict) -> None:
        new_st = res.get("status", "UPDATED")
        self.announce(
            f"Re-inspection completed for '{job_id}'. Resulting status: {new_st}."
        )
        self.fetch_records_async()

@on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-quarantine-release")
def action_release_selected(self) -> None:
    """Prompt destination directory and release selected quarantine item."""
    record = self._get_selected_record(self.selected_job_id)
    if not record:
        self.announce("No quarantine item selected for release.")
        return

    if record.get("status") == "RELEASED":
        self.announce(
            f"Quarantine item '{record.get('job_id')}' is already released."
        )
        return

    staged_path = record.get("staged_filepath")
    if not staged_path or not os.path.exists(staged_path):
        self.announce(
            f"Cannot release item '{record.get('job_id')}': Staged file missing at {staged_path}."
        )
        return

    orig_rel = record.get("original_filepath", "released_file")
    base_dir = record.get("base_dir") or self.base_dir or "."

    def _dir_selected_callback(target_dir: Optional[str]) -> None:
        if not target_dir:
            self.announce("Release operation cancelled.")
            return
        if not os.path.exists(target_dir) or not os.path.isdir(target_dir):
            from app.ui.notifications import notify

            err_msg = f"Target directory does not exist: {target_dir}"
            self.announce(err_msg, priority="assertive")
            notify(err_msg, type="error")
            return
        dest_file_path = os.path.join(target_dir, os.path.basename(orig_rel))
        self.execute_release_async(record, dest_file_path)

    self.app.push_screen(DirectorySelectModal(base_dir), _dir_selected_callback)

@work(thread=True)
def execute_release_async(self, record: dict, dest_file_path: str) -> None:
    """Asynchronously perform atomic quarantine relocation to destination path."""
    job_id = record["job_id"]
    staged_path = record["staged_filepath"]
    try:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dest_file_path), exist_ok=True)
        from app.core.resilient_file_ops import atomic_quarantine_relocation

        with atomic_quarantine_relocation(staged_path, dest_file_path):
            db_inst = self._get_db()
            db_inst.update_quarantine_status(
                job_id=job_id,
                status="RELEASED",
                audit_entry={
                    "timestamp": time.time(),
                    "status": "RELEASED",
                    "details": f"Released from quarantine modal to {dest_file_path}",
                },
            )
        self._call_ui(self._on_release_success, job_id, dest_file_path)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to release quarantine job {job_id}: {e}")

class AuditReportModal(A11yMixin, ModalScreen[None]):
    """Interactive Modal Screen for Tabular Verification Tree & Multi-Format Audit Export."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Close verification dialog", show=True),
        Binding("ctrl+r", "retry_selected", "Retry Selected Failed Item", show=True),
        Binding("ctrl+t", "retry_all", "Retry All Failed Items", show=True),
        Binding("ctrl+j", "export_json", "Export JSON Report", show=True),
        Binding("ctrl+c", "export_csv", "Export CSV Report", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    AuditReportModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
    }
    .audit-modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 95%;
        max-width: 105;
        min-width: 50;
        height: 85%;
        min-height: 20;
    }
    .narrow .audit-modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 98%;
    }
    .audit-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
    .audit-subtitle {
        color: $text-muted;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .audit-stats-row {
        height: 3;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        align: center middle;
    }
    .stat-card {
        padding: 0 1;
        margin-right: 1;
        border: solid $secondary;
        background: $surface;
        min-width: 15;
    }
    .stat-pass {
        color: $success;
        border: solid $success;
    }
    .stat-fail {
        color: $error;
        border: solid $error;
    }
    .stat-skipped {
        color: $warning;
        border: solid $warning;
    }
    .stat-unverified {
        color: $text-muted;
        border: solid $secondary;
    }
    .filter-row {
        height: 3;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    #audit-search-input {
        width: 60%;
        margin-right: 1;
    }
    #audit-status-filter {
        width: 38%;
    }
    #audit-table, #failed-items-table {
        height: 1fr;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        border: solid $accent;
    }
    #audit-tabs {
        height: 1fr;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .button-row {
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    Button:focus, Input:focus, Select:focus, DataTable:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, report_data: Dict[str, Any]):
        super().__init__()
        self.report_data = report_data or {}

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose verification audit report modal widgets."""
        with Vertical(classes="audit-modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Post-Sort File Integrity Verification Audit Report",
                level=1,
                classes="audit-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            base_dir_str = self.report_data.get("base_dir", "")
            yield Label(f"Target Directory: {base_dir_str}", classes="audit-subtitle")

            total = self.report_data.get("total_files", 0)
            pass_cnt = self.report_data.get("verified_pass_count", 0)
            fail_cnt = self.report_data.get("mismatch_fail_count", 0)
            skip_cnt = self.report_data.get("skipped_count", 0)
            unverified_cnt = self.report_data.get("unverified_count", 0)

            with Horizontal(classes="audit-stats-row"):
                yield Static(f"Total: {total}", classes="stat-card")
                yield Static(f"[PASS]: {pass_cnt}", classes="stat-card stat-pass")
                yield Static(f"[FAIL]: {fail_cnt}", classes="stat-card stat-fail")
                yield Static(f"[SKIPPED]: {skip_cnt}", classes="stat-card stat-skipped")
                yield Static(
                    f"[UNVERIFIED]: {unverified_cnt}",
                    classes="stat-card stat-unverified",
                )

            with TabbedContent(initial="tab-all-records", id="audit-tabs"):
                with TabPane("All Verification Records", id="tab-all-records"):
                    with Horizontal(classes="filter-row"):
                        inp = Input(
                            placeholder="Search by filename or path...",
                            id="audit-search-input",
                        )
                        inp.tooltip = "Filter verification results by filename or path"
                        yield inp

                        status_sel = Select(
                            [
                                ("All Statuses", "ALL"),
                                ("Verified Pass [PASS]", "VERIFIED_PASS"),
                                ("Mismatch Fail [FAIL]", "MISMATCH_FAIL"),
                                ("Skipped [SKIPPED]", "SKIPPED"),
                                ("Unverified [UNVERIFIED]", "UNVERIFIED"),
                            ],
                            value="ALL",
                            id="audit-status-filter",
                            allow_blank=False,
                        )
                        status_sel.tooltip = "Filter results by verification status"
                        yield status_sel

                    table = DataTable(id="audit-table")
                    table.cursor_type = "row"
                    table.tooltip = "Audit report tabular verification tree"
                    yield table

                with TabPane("Failed Items Queue", id="tab-failed-queue"):
                    failed_table = DataTable(id="failed-items-table")
                    failed_table.cursor_type = "row"
                    failed_table.tooltip = "Dedicated Failed Items queue table"
                    yield failed_table

            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_retry_sel = Button(
                    "Retry Selected", id="btn-retry-selected", variant="warning"
                )
                btn_retry_sel.tooltip = (
                    "Re-attempt file move operation for selected failed item"
                )
                yield btn_retry_sel

                btn_retry_all = Button("Retry All", id="btn-retry-all", variant="error")
                btn_retry_all.tooltip = (
                    "Re-attempt file move operations for all failed items in queue"
                )
                yield btn_retry_all

                btn_json = Button(
                    "Export JSON", id="btn-export-json", variant="primary"
                )
                btn_json.tooltip = (
                    "Export audit report to JSON file in target directory"
                )
                yield btn_json

                btn_csv = Button("Export CSV", id="btn-export-csv", variant="success")
                btn_csv.tooltip = "Export audit report to CSV file in target directory"
                yield btn_csv

                btn_close = Button("Close", id="btn-close", variant="default")
                btn_close.tooltip = "Close verification audit report dialog"
                yield btn_close

    def _update_layout(self, width: int, height: int = 24) -> None:
        """Update layout based on viewport width and height breakpoint."""
        if width < 80 or height < 24:
            self.add_class("narrow")
        else:
            self.remove_class("narrow")

    def on_resize(self, event: events.Resize) -> None:
        """Handle viewport resize event."""
        self._update_layout(event.size.width, event.size.height)

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Initialize table rows, accessibility announcement, and initial focus."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width, self.size.height)
        self._populate_table()
        total = self.report_data.get("total_files", 0)
        pass_cnt = self.report_data.get("verified_pass_count", 0)
        fail_cnt = self.report_data.get("mismatch_fail_count", 0)
        skip_cnt = self.report_data.get("skipped_count", 0)
        unverified_cnt = self.report_data.get("unverified_count", 0)
        self.query_one("#audit-search-input", Input).focus()
        self.announce(
            f"Opened Audit Verification Report dialog. {total} total files: "
            f"{pass_cnt} passed, {fail_cnt} failed, {skip_cnt} skipped, {unverified_cnt} unverified."
        )

    def _populate_table(
        self, search_query: str = "", status_filter: str = "ALL"
    ) -> None:
        """Populate DataTable with verification records matching filter criteria."""
        table = self.query_one("#audit-table", DataTable)
        table.clear(columns=True)
        table.add_columns(
            "Status",
            "Filename",
            "Pre-Sort SHA-256",
            "Post-Sort SHA-256",
            "Destination Path",
        )

        query = search_query.strip().lower()
        records = self.report_data.get("records", [])

        for rec in records:
            status = rec.get("status", "")
            filename = rec.get("filename", "")
            rel_dst = rec.get("relative_destination", "") or rec.get(
                "destination_path", ""
            )
            pre_h = rec.get("pre_hash", "") or ""
            post_h = rec.get("post_hash", "") or ""

            if status_filter != "ALL" and status != status_filter:
                continue

            if query:
                match_fn = query in filename.lower()
                match_src = query in rec.get("relative_source", "").lower()
                match_dst = query in rel_dst.lower()
                match_hash = query in pre_h.lower() or query in post_h.lower()
                if not (match_fn or match_src or match_dst or match_hash):
                    continue

            badge = rec.get("status_badge", f"[{status}]")
            pre_trunc = (pre_h[:12] + "...") if len(pre_h) > 12 else (pre_h or "N/A")
            post_trunc = (
                (post_h[:12] + "...") if len(post_h) > 12 else (post_h or "N/A")
            )

            table.add_row(badge, filename, pre_trunc, post_trunc, rel_dst)

        self._populate_failed_table()

    def _populate_failed_table(self) -> None:
        """Populate dedicated Failed Items queue table with error descriptions."""
        table = self.query_one("#failed-items-table", DataTable)
        table.clear(columns=True)
        table.add_columns(
            "Filename",
            "Status",
            "Error Description",
            "Source Path",
            "Destination Path",
        )

        failed_records = self._get_failed_records()

        for rec in failed_records:
            fn = rec.get("filename", "")
            st = rec.get("status_badge", rec.get("status", ""))
            err = rec.get("error") or rec.get("error_description") or "Operation failed"
            src = rec.get("relative_source") or rec.get("source_path", "")
            dst = rec.get("relative_destination") or rec.get("destination_path", "")
            table.add_row(fn, st, err, src, dst)

    def _get_failed_records(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Get list of failed item records from report data."""
        failed = self.report_data.get("failed_items", [])
        if not failed:
            records = self.report_data.get("records", [])
            failed = [
                r
                for r in records
                if r.get("status") in ("MISMATCH_FAIL", "MOVE_FAIL") or r.get("error")
            ]
        return failed

    @on(Input.Changed, "#audit-search-input")
    def on_search_changed(self, event: Input.Changed) -> None:
        """Handle search input filter update."""
        status_val = self.query_one("#audit-status-filter", Select).value
        self._populate_table(search_query=event.value, status_filter=str(status_val))

    @on(Select.Changed, "#audit-status-filter")
    def on_status_changed(self, event: Select.Changed) -> None:
        """Handle status filter dropdown update."""
        search_val = self.query_one("#audit-search-input", Input).value
        self._populate_table(search_query=search_val, status_filter=str(event.value))

    def action_retry_selected(self) -> None:
        """Retry move operation for selected failed item."""
        failed_table = self.query_one("#failed-items-table", DataTable)
        selected_record = None

        if failed_table.cursor_row is not None and failed_table.row_count > 0:
            failed_records = self._get_failed_records()
            if 0 <= failed_table.cursor_row < len(failed_records):
                selected_record = failed_records[failed_table.cursor_row]

        if not selected_record:
            audit_table = self.query_one("#audit-table", DataTable)
            if audit_table.cursor_row is not None and audit_table.row_count > 0:
                records = self.report_data.get("records", [])
                if 0 <= audit_table.cursor_row < len(records):
                    rec = records[audit_table.cursor_row]
                    if rec.get("status") in ("MISMATCH_FAIL", "MOVE_FAIL") or rec.get(
                        "error"
                    ):
                        selected_record = rec

        if not selected_record:
            msg = "No failed item selected to retry."
            self.announce(msg)
            self.notify(msg, severity="warning")
            return

        self._execute_retry([selected_record])

    def action_retry_all(self) -> None:
        """Retry move operations for all failed items in queue."""
        failed_records = self._get_failed_records()
        if not failed_records:
            msg = "No failed items to retry."
            self.announce(msg)
            self.notify(msg, severity="warning")
            return

        self._execute_retry(failed_records)

    def _execute_retry(self, items_to_retry: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
        """Execute mover retry for selected failed items and refresh UI."""
        from app.core.mover import retry_failed_moves

        base_dir = self.report_data.get("base_dir", "")
        retry_res = retry_failed_moves(base_dir, items_to_retry)
        new_audit = retry_res.get("audit_report", {})

        retried_map = {r.get("source_path"): r for r in new_audit.get("records", [])}

        records = self.report_data.get("records", [])
        for idx, rec in enumerate(records):
            src = rec.get("source_path")
            if src in retried_map:
                records[idx] = retried_map[src]

        from app.core.audit_reporter import generate_audit_report

        self.report_data = generate_audit_report(base_dir, records)

        self._populate_table()
        self._update_stats_cards()

        pass_cnt = self.report_data.get("verified_pass_count", 0)
        fail_cnt = self.report_data.get("mismatch_fail_count", 0)
        msg = f"Retried {len(items_to_retry)} item(s). Overall status: {pass_cnt} passed, {fail_cnt} failed."
        self.announce(msg)
        self.notify(msg, severity="information")

    def _update_stats_cards(self) -> None:
        """Update stat card labels with current metrics."""
        total = self.report_data.get("total_files", 0)
        pass_cnt = self.report_data.get("verified_pass_count", 0)
        fail_cnt = self.report_data.get("mismatch_fail_count", 0)
        skip_cnt = self.report_data.get("skipped_count", 0)
        unverified_cnt = self.report_data.get("unverified_count", 0)

        try:
            cards = self.query(".stat-card")
            if len(cards) >= 5:
                cards[0].update(f"Total: {total}")
                cards[1].update(f"[PASS]: {pass_cnt}")
                cards[2].update(f"[FAIL]: {fail_cnt}")
                cards[3].update(f"[SKIPPED]: {skip_cnt}")
                cards[4].update(f"[UNVERIFIED]: {unverified_cnt}")
        except Exception:
            pass

        """Handle Retry Selected button press."""
        self.action_retry_selected()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-retry-all")
    def on_btn_retry_all(self) -> None:
        """Handle Retry All button press."""
        self.action_retry_all()

    def action_export_json(self) -> None:
        """Export audit report to JSON format."""
        self._export_report("json")

    def action_export_csv(self) -> None:
        """Export audit report to CSV format."""
        self._export_report("csv")

    def _export_report(self, fmt: str) -> None:
        """Export report to disk with error handling."""
        base_dir = self.report_data.get("base_dir", ".") or "."
        out_name = f"audit_report.{fmt}"
        out_path = os.path.join(base_dir, out_name)

        try:
            from app.core.audit_reporter import export_audit_report

            final_path = export_audit_report(
                self.report_data, out_path, format_type=fmt, base_dir=base_dir
            )
            msg = f"Audit report successfully exported to {final_path}"
            self.announce(msg)
            self.notify(msg, severity="information")
        except Exception as err:
            err_msg = f"Failed to export audit report: {err}"
            logger.error(err_msg)
            self.announce(err_msg)
            self.notify(err_msg, severity="error")

    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel dialog and dismiss modal."""
        self.announce("Closed verification report dialog.")
        self.dismiss()

    def on_btn_export_json(self) -> None:

        self.action_export_json()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-export-csv")

def action_retry_selected(self) -> None:
    """Retry move operation for selected failed item."""
    failed_table = self.query_one("#failed-items-table", DataTable)
    selected_record = None

    if failed_table.cursor_row is not None and failed_table.row_count > 0:
        failed_records = self._get_failed_records()
        if 0 <= failed_table.cursor_row < len(failed_records):
            selected_record = failed_records[failed_table.cursor_row]

    if not selected_record:
        audit_table = self.query_one("#audit-table", DataTable)
        if audit_table.cursor_row is not None and audit_table.row_count > 0:
            records = self.report_data.get("records", [])
            if 0 <= audit_table.cursor_row < len(records):
                rec = records[audit_table.cursor_row]
                if rec.get("status") in ("MISMATCH_FAIL", "MOVE_FAIL") or rec.get(
                    "error"
                ):
                    selected_record = rec

    if not selected_record:
        msg = "No failed item selected to retry."
        self.announce(msg)
        self.notify(msg, severity="warning")
        return

    self._execute_retry([selected_record])

    """Compose verification audit report modal widgets."""
    with Vertical(classes="audit-modal-box"):
        yield Heading(
            "Post-Sort File Integrity Verification Audit Report",
            level=1,
            classes="audit-title",

class ExportReportModal(

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    ExportReportModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }

        padding: 1 2;

        text-style: bold;

        color: $text-muted;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }

        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    Button:focus, Input:focus, Select:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        default_path: str = "./simulation_report.html",
        default_format: str = "html",
    ):

        self.default_path = default_path
        self.default_format = default_format

        """Compose export report modal widgets."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading(

                value=self.default_path,
                placeholder="Enter output path (e.g. ./report.html)...",
                id="input-export-path",
            )
            inp.tooltip = "Enter path for exported dry-run simulation report"
            yield inp

            fmt_select = Select(
                [("HTML Report (*.html)", "html"), ("JSON Data (*.json)", "json")],
                value=self.default_format,
                id="select-export-format",
                allow_blank=False,
            )
            yield fmt_select

            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_cancel = Button("Cancel", id="btn-cancel", variant="default")
                btn_cancel.tooltip = "Cancel report export action"
                yield btn_cancel
                btn_export = Button("Export Report", id="btn-export", variant="primary")
                btn_export.tooltip = "Export simulation report to disk"
                yield btn_export

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus input field on mount and emit accessibility announcement."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        self.query_one("#input-export-path", Input).focus()
        self.announce("Opened export simulation report dialog.")

    @on(Input.Submitted, "#input-export-path")
    def action_submit_input(self) -> None:
        """Handle input submission event."""
        self.action_export()

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-export")
    def action_export(self) -> None:
        """Confirm report export and dismiss modal with export parameters."""
        path_val = self.query_one("#input-export-path", Input).value.strip()
        if not path_val:
            self.announce("Output path cannot be empty.")
            return
        format_val = self.query_one("#select-export-format", Select).value or "html"
        self.dismiss((path_val, str(format_val)))

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel report export modal."""
        self.dismiss(None)

class ExtractionPreviewModal(A11yMixin, ModalScreen[Optional[int]]):
    """Modal dialog for interactive visual inspection of PDF page extraction decisions."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    ExtractionPreviewModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .preview-modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 84;
        min-width: 40;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .file-path-label {
        color: $text-muted;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .preview-table {
        height: 10;
        margin-top: 1;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        border: solid $primary-lighten-2;
    }
    .threshold-row {
        height: 3;
        align: left middle;
    }
    .narrow-input {
        width: 12;
        margin-right: 1;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, file_path: str, settings: Any) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.file_path = file_path
        self.settings = settings
        self.initial_threshold = getattr(settings, "PDF_TEXT_DENSITY_THRESHOLD", 50)
        self.current_threshold = self.initial_threshold
        self.page_data: list[dict] = []

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose modal dialog children widgets."""
        with Vertical(classes="preview-modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "PDF Extraction Strategy Preview",
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            yield Label(
                f"File: {os.path.basename(self.file_path)}",
                classes="file-path-label",
            )

            yield Label("Density Threshold (chars/page):", classes="field-label")
            with Horizontal(classes="threshold-row"):
                yield Input(
                    value=str(self.current_threshold),
                    id="preview-input-threshold",
                    classes="narrow-input",
                )
                yield DensitySlider(
                    value=self.current_threshold,
                    min_value=0,
                    max_value=500,
                    step=5,
                    id="preview-slider-threshold",
                )

            yield DataTable(id="preview-table", classes="preview-table")
            yield Label("", id="preview-summary-label")

            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_cancel = Button(
                    "Cancel", id="btn-preview-cancel", variant="default"
                )
                btn_cancel.tooltip = "Close preview dialog without saving settings"
                yield btn_cancel
                btn_save = Button(
                    "Save & Apply", id="btn-preview-save", variant="primary"
                )
                btn_save.tooltip = "Save density threshold to settings and apply"
                yield btn_save

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Handle modal mount event and populate initial preview data."""
        self.announce("Opened PDF extraction strategy preview modal.")
        table = self.query_one("#preview-table", DataTable)
        table.add_columns("Page", "Embedded Chars", "Vector Paths", "Predicted Status")

        from app.core.extractor_strategies import PdfExtractor

        extractor = PdfExtractor()
        # Light structural analysis without EasyOCR model passes
        self.page_data = extractor.preview_pdf_density(
            self.file_path, density_threshold=self.current_threshold
        )
        self._update_table()

    def _update_table(self) -> None:
        """Re-evaluate page extraction decisions and update table display."""
        table = self.query_one("#preview-table", DataTable)
        table.clear()
        std_count = 0
        rast_count = 0

        for page in self.page_data:
            char_count = page["char_count"]
            has_vector = page["has_vector"]
            if char_count >= self.current_threshold and not has_vector:
                status_text = Text("STANDARD", style="bold green")
                std_count += 1
            else:
                status_text = Text("RASTERIZED", style="bold yellow")
                rast_count += 1

            vector_str = "Yes" if has_vector else "No"
            table.add_row(
                f"Page {page['page_index']}",
                str(char_count),
                vector_str,
                status_text,
            )

        summary_label = self.query_one("#preview-summary-label", Label)
        summary_label.update(
            f"Total Pages: {len(self.page_data)} | Standard: {std_count} | Rasterized (OCR): {rast_count}"
        )

    @on(DensitySlider.Changed, "#preview-slider-threshold")
    def _on_slider_changed(self, event: DensitySlider.Changed) -> None:
        """Handle slider value changes by updating input and re-evaluating preview table."""
        if self.current_threshold != event.value:
            self.current_threshold = event.value
            try:
                inp = self.query_one("#preview-input-threshold", Input)
                if inp.value != str(event.value):
                    inp.value = str(event.value)
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._update_table()

    @on(Input.Changed, "#preview-input-threshold")
    def _on_input_changed(self, event: Input.Changed) -> None:
        """Handle input text changes by updating slider and re-evaluating preview table."""
        try:
            val = int(event.value.strip())
            if val >= 0 and self.current_threshold != val:
                self.current_threshold = val
                try:
                    slider = self.query_one("#preview-slider-threshold", DensitySlider)
                    if (
                        slider.value != val
                        and slider.min_value <= val <= slider.max_value
                    ):
                        slider.value = val
                except Exception:
                    pass
                self._update_table()
        except Exception:
            pass

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-preview-save")
    def action_save_threshold(self) -> None:
        """Save updated density threshold to settings and dismiss modal."""
        if hasattr(self.settings, "PDF_TEXT_DENSITY_THRESHOLD"):
            self.settings.PDF_TEXT_DENSITY_THRESHOLD = self.current_threshold
        if hasattr(self.settings, "_save"):
            self.settings._save()
        self.announce(f"Saved PDF text density threshold: {self.current_threshold}")
        self.dismiss(self.current_threshold)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-preview-cancel")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel preview dialog and dismiss modal."""
        self.announce("Cancelled PDF extraction preview.")
        self.dismiss(None)

class RuleImportModal(ResponsiveLayoutMixin, A11yMixin, ModalScreen[Optional[Any]]):
    """Modal screen for selecting, inspecting, and merging external rules (Hazel, DropIt & TagSpaces)."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    RuleImportModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 85;
        min-width: 35;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow .modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 95%;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .input-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        height: auto;
    }
    .preview-card {
        margin-top: 1;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        padding: 0 1;
        border: solid $accent;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 12;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .warning-text {
        color: $warning;
        margin-top: 1;
    }
    .status-text {
        color: $accent;
        margin-top: 1;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    Button:focus, Input:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, settings: Any):
        super().__init__()
        self.settings = settings
        self.current_result: Optional[Any] = None

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose rule import modal children."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Import External Rules",
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            yield Label(
                "Select a Hazel .hazelrules, DropIt XML/JSON profile, or TagSpaces taggroup.json file to import:"
            )

            with Horizontal(classes="input-row"):
                yield Input(
                    placeholder="/path/to/rules.hazelrules, profile.xml/json, or taggroup.json",
                    id="input-rule-file-path",
                )
                btn_parse = Button(
                    "Parse File", id="btn-parse-rule-file", variant="primary"
                )
                btn_parse.tooltip = "Parse selected rule file and display preview"
                yield btn_parse

            yield Label(
                "Enter file path and click 'Parse File' to preview extracted rules.",
                id="lbl-import-status",
                classes="status-text",
            )

            with Vertical(id="container-rule-preview", classes="preview-card"):
                yield DataTable(id="dt-imported-keywords")
                yield DataTable(id="dt-imported-policies")
                yield Vertical(id="container-import-warnings")

            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_close = Button("Cancel", id="btn-close-importer", variant="default")
                btn_close.tooltip = "Close import dialog"
                yield btn_close

                btn_merge = Button(
                    "Merge Rules into Settings",
                    id="btn-merge-imported-rules",
                    variant="primary",
                    disabled=True,
                )
                btn_merge.tooltip = "Safely merge extracted rules into settings without overwriting custom rules"
                yield btn_merge

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus initial input field on mount and set up preview tables."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        self.query_one("#input-rule-file-path", Input).focus()
        try:
            dt_kw = self.query_one("#dt-imported-keywords", DataTable)
            dt_kw.add_columns("Keyword", "Target Path")

            dt_pol = self.query_one("#dt-imported-policies", DataTable)
            dt_pol.add_columns(
                "Type", "Expression / Pattern", "Target Path", "Priority"
            )
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.announce("Opened external rule importer modal.")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-parse-rule-file")
    @on(Input.Submitted, "#input-rule-file-path")
    def action_parse_file(self) -> None:
        """Parse external rule package and render preview tables."""
        path_str = self.query_one("#input-rule-file-path", Input).value.strip()
        lbl_status = self.query_one("#lbl-import-status", Label)

        if not path_str:
            lbl_status.update("Please enter a valid rule file path.")
            self.announce("Please enter a valid rule file path.")
            return

        p = Path(path_str)
        if not p.exists():
            lbl_status.update(f"File not found: '{path_str}'")
            self.announce(f"File not found: '{path_str}'")
            return

        try:
            from app.core.rule_importers import get_rule_importer

            importer = get_rule_importer(p)
            self.current_result = importer.parse_file(p)
        except Exception as exc:
            lbl_status.update(f"Error parsing rule package: {exc}")
            self.announce(f"Error parsing rule package: {exc}")
            return

        res = self.current_result
        dt_kw = self.query_one("#dt-imported-keywords", DataTable)
        dt_pol = self.query_one("#dt-imported-policies", DataTable)
        btn_merge = self.query_one("#btn-merge-imported-rules", Button)

        dt_kw.clear()
        dt_pol.clear()

        for kw, target_dir in res.keyword_rules.items():
            dt_kw.add_row(kw, target_dir)

        for pol in res.policies:
            dt_pol.add_row(
                pol.get("type", "keyword"),
                pol.get("expression", ""),
                pol.get("target_path", ""),
                str(pol.get("priority", 75)),
            )

        warn_container = self.query_one("#container-import-warnings", Vertical)
        warn_container.remove_children()
        for warn in res.warnings:
            warn_container.mount(Label(f"⚠️ {warn}", classes="warning-text"))

        total_rules = len(res.keyword_rules) + len(res.policies)
        lbl_status.update(
            f"Parsed {res.source_format}: {len(res.keyword_rules)} keyword rules, "
            f"{len(res.policies)} policies, {len(res.warnings)} warning(s)."
        )

        if total_rules > 0:
            btn_merge.disabled = False
            btn_merge.focus()
        else:
            btn_merge.disabled = True

        self.announce(f"Parsed {res.source_format}: {total_rules} rules extracted.")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-merge-imported-rules")
    def action_merge_rules(self) -> None:
        """Merge parsed rules into settings and close modal."""
        if not self.current_result:
            try:
                self.dismiss(None)
            except Exception:
                pass
            return

        new_kw, new_pol = self.current_result.merge_into_settings(self.settings)
        msg = f"Merged imported rules: {len(self.current_result.keyword_rules)} keyword rules and {len(self.current_result.policies)} policies."
        self.announce(msg)
        try:
            if hasattr(self.app, "notify"):
                self.app.notify(msg)
        except Exception:
            pass

        try:
            self.dismiss(self.current_result)
        except Exception:
            pass

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-close-importer")
    def action_close(self) -> None:
        """Close import dialog."""
        self.announce("Closed external rule importer modal.")
        self.dismiss(None)

    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel on Escape key."""
        self.announce("Closed external rule importer modal.")
        self.dismiss(None)

    BINDINGS = [

            )
            yield Label(
                "Select starter template packs to apply. Template rules merge safely without overwriting custom rules:"
            )

            from app.core.rule_templates import get_starter_templates

            for pack in get_starter_templates():
                with Vertical(classes="template-card"):
                    chk = Checkbox(
                        f"{pack.icon} {pack.title}",
                        value=False,
                        id=f"chk-gallery-{pack.id}",
                    )
                    chk.tooltip = pack.description
                    yield chk
                    yield Label(pack.description, classes="template-desc")

            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_close = Button("Close", id="btn-close-gallery", variant="default")
                btn_close.tooltip = "Close template gallery"
                yield btn_close
                btn_import = Button(
                    "Import External Rules",
                    id="btn-import-rules",
                    variant="primary",
                )
                btn_import.tooltip = "Import Hazel (.hazelrules), DropIt XML/JSON, or TagSpaces taggroup.json rule files"
                yield btn_import
                btn_apply = Button(
                    "Apply Selected Templates",
                    id="btn-apply-templates",
                    variant="primary",
                )
                btn_apply.tooltip = "Merge selected template packs into settings"
                yield btn_apply

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus initial checkbox on mount and emit announcement."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        from app.core.rule_templates import get_starter_templates

        templates = get_starter_templates()
        if templates:
            first_id = templates[0].id
            try:
                self.query_one(f"#chk-gallery-{first_id}", Checkbox).focus()
            except Exception:
                pass
        self.announce("Opened starter rule template gallery.")

    @on(Checkbox.Changed)
    def on_checkbox_changed(self, event: Checkbox.Changed) -> None:
        """Announce starter template gallery checkbox selection state changes."""
        chk_id = getattr(event.checkbox, "id", None) or getattr(
            event.control, "id", None
        )
        if not chk_id:
            return

        prefix = ""
        if chk_id.startswith("chk-gallery-"):
            prefix = "chk-gallery-"
        elif chk_id.startswith("chk-template-"):
            prefix = "chk-template-"
        else:
            return

        pack_id = chk_id[len(prefix) :]
        from app.core.rule_templates import get_starter_templates

        for pack in get_starter_templates():
            if pack.id == pack_id:
                state = "selected" if event.value else "deselected"
                self.announce(f"{pack.title} template pack {state}.")
                break

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-apply-templates")
    def action_apply_templates(self) -> None:
        """Apply selected starter template packs to settings."""
        from app.core.rule_templates import (
            apply_starter_templates,
            get_starter_templates,
        )

        selected_pack_ids = []
        for pack in get_starter_templates():
            try:
                chk = self.query_one(f"#chk-gallery-{pack.id}", Checkbox)
                if chk.value:
                    selected_pack_ids.append(pack.id)
            except Exception:
                pass

        if selected_pack_ids:
            apply_starter_templates(self.settings, selected_pack_ids)
            msg = f"Applied {len(selected_pack_ids)} starter rule template pack(s) to settings."
            self.announce(msg)
            if hasattr(self.app, "notify"):
                self.app.notify(msg)
        else:
            self.announce("No starter template packs were selected.")

        self.dismiss(None)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-import-rules")
    def action_import_rules(self) -> None:
        """Open external rule importer modal."""
        self.app.push_screen(RuleImportModal(self.settings))

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-close-gallery")
    def action_close(self) -> None:
        """Close template gallery dialog."""
        self.announce("Closed starter rule template gallery.")
        self.dismiss(None)

    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel on Escape key."""
        self.announce("Closed starter rule template gallery.")
        self.dismiss(None)

@on(Checkbox.Changed)
def on_checkbox_changed(self, event: Checkbox.Changed) -> None:
    """Announce starter template gallery checkbox selection state changes."""
    chk_id = getattr(event.checkbox, "id", None) or getattr(
        event.control, "id", None
    )
    if not chk_id:
        return

    prefix = ""
    if chk_id.startswith("chk-gallery-"):
        prefix = "chk-gallery-"
    elif chk_id.startswith("chk-template-"):
        prefix = "chk-template-"
    else:
        return

    pack_id = chk_id[len(prefix) :]
    from app.core.rule_templates import get_starter_templates

    for pack in get_starter_templates():
        if pack.id == pack_id:
            state = "selected" if event.value else "deselected"
            self.announce(f"{pack.title} template pack {state}.")
            break
