class HistoryModal(
    ResponsiveLayoutMixin, A11yMixin, ModalScreen[Optional[Dict[str, Any]]]
):
    """Modal dialog for viewing session history records, exporting audit logs, and rolling back sessions."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    HistoryModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 90;
        min-width: 40;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow .modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 95%;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .modal-subtitle {
        color: $text-muted;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .details-box {
        margin-top: 1;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        padding: 1;
        background: $boost;
        border: solid $accent;
        color: $text;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    Button:focus, Input:focus, Select:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        sessions: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
        base_dir: str = "",
    ):
        super().__init__()
        if sessions is None:
            from app.core.session_catalog import list_sessions

            sessions = list_sessions()
        self.sessions = sessions or []
        self.base_dir = base_dir
        self._rollback_in_progress = False

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose history view, export, and rollback modal widgets."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Session History & Rollback Controls [Ctrl+Y]",
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            yield Label(
                "Select a session row to export audit log or perform session rollback:",
                classes="modal-subtitle",
            )

            options = [("All Sessions (Aggregate Audit Log)", "all")]
            for s in self.sessions:
                sid = s.get("session_id", "unknown")
                b_dir = s.get("base_dir") or "N/A"
                status = s.get("status") or "completed"
                step_cnt = s.get("step_count") or s.get("file_count") or 0
                options.append(
                    (
                        f"{sid[:8]}... | {status.upper()} | {step_cnt} file(s) | {b_dir}",
                        sid,
                    )
                )

            if len(options) == 1 and not self.sessions:
                options = [("No historical sessions found", "none")]

            select_sess = Select(
                options,
                value=options[0][1] if options else "none",
                id="select-history-session",
                allow_blank=False,
            )
            select_sess.tooltip = (
                "Select historical session row for audit log export or session rollback"
            )
            yield select_sess

            yield Label("Session Details:", classes="modal-subtitle")
            yield Label(
                "Select a session above to view details.",
                id="lbl-session-details",
                classes="details-box",
            )

            yield Label("Output File Path (Audit Log Export):")
            inp_path = Input(
                value="./audit_log.csv",
                placeholder="Enter export path (e.g. ./audit_log.csv)...",
                id="input-history-path",
            )
            inp_path.tooltip = (
                "Enter target output path for exported session audit log file"
            )
            yield inp_path

            yield Label("Export Format:")
            fmt_select = Select(
                [("CSV Format (*.csv)", "csv"), ("JSON Format (*.json)", "json")],
                value="csv",
                id="select-history-format",
                allow_blank=False,
            )
            fmt_select.tooltip = "Select audit log output format"
            yield fmt_select

            yield Label("", id="lbl-rollback-status")

            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_cancel = Button("Cancel", id="btn-cancel", variant="default")
                btn_cancel.tooltip = "Cancel history dialog"
                yield btn_cancel

                btn_rollback = Button(
                    "Rollback Session",
                    id="btn-rollback-session",
                    variant="warning",
                    disabled=True,
                )
                btn_rollback.tooltip = "Revert file operations for selected session"
                yield btn_rollback

                btn_export = Button(
                    "Export Audit Log", id="btn-export", variant="primary"
                )
                btn_export.tooltip = (
                    "Export audit log file for selected session history row"
                )
                yield btn_export

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus session select widget on mount and emit accessibility announcement."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        select_widget = self.query_one("#select-history-session", Select)
        select_widget.focus()
        self._update_selected_session_view(select_widget.value)
        self.announce("Opened session history export and rollback modal dialog.")

    @on(Select.Changed, "#select-history-session")
    def on_session_changed(self, event: Select.Changed) -> None:
        """Update session details label and button state when session selection changes."""
        self._update_selected_session_view(event.value)

    def _update_selected_session_view(self, session_val: Any) -> None:
        """Update session details label and enable/disable rollback button based on selected session."""
        try:
            lbl_details = self.query_one("#lbl-session-details", Label)
            btn_rollback = self.query_one("#btn-rollback-session", Button)
        except Exception:
            return

        if not session_val or session_val in ("none", "all"):
            lbl_details.update(
                "Aggregate log across all historical sessions selected."
                if session_val == "all"
                else "No session selected."
            )
            btn_rollback.disabled = True
            btn_rollback.tooltip = "Select an individual session to enable rollback"
            return

        target = None
        for s in self.sessions:
            if s.get("session_id") == session_val:
                target = s
                break

        if not target:
            lbl_details.update("Session information unavailable.")
            btn_rollback.disabled = True
            return

        sid = target.get("session_id", "N/A")
        status = target.get("status") or "completed"
        b_dir = target.get("base_dir") or "N/A"
        step_cnt = target.get("step_count") or target.get("file_count") or 0
        ts = target.get("timestamp")
        ts_str = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", time.localtime(ts)) if ts else "N/A"

        details_str = (
            f"Session ID: {sid}\n"
            f"Status: {status.upper()} | Operations/Files: {step_cnt}\n"
            f"Timestamp: {ts_str}\n"
            f"Base Directory: {b_dir}"
        )
        lbl_details.update(details_str)

        if status.lower() == "rolled_back":
            btn_rollback.disabled = True
            btn_rollback.tooltip = "Session has already been rolled back"
        else:
            btn_rollback.disabled = False
            btn_rollback.tooltip = "Revert file operations for selected session"

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-export")
    def action_export_audit(self) -> None:
        """Confirm session audit log export and dismiss modal screen."""
        session_val = self.query_one("#select-history-session", Select).value
        if not session_val or session_val == "none":
            self.announce("No session selected for audit log export.")
            return

        path_val = self.query_one("#input-history-path", Input).value.strip()
        if not path_val:
            self.announce("Output file path cannot be empty.")
            return

        format_val = self.query_one("#select-history-format", Select).value or "csv"

        self.dismiss(
            {
                "session_id": str(session_val),
                "output_path": path_val,
                "format": str(format_val),
            }
        )

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-rollback-session")
    def action_rollback_session(self) -> None:
        """Prompt confirmation and initiate asynchronous session rollback."""
        session_val = self.query_one("#select-history-session", Select).value
        if not session_val or session_val in ("none", "all"):
            self.announce("Please select a specific session to rollback.")
            return

        target_sess = None
        for s in self.sessions:
            if s.get("session_id") == session_val:
                target_sess = s
                break

        if not target_sess or str(target_sess.get("status")).lower() == "rolled_back":
            self.announce("Selected session cannot be rolled back.")
            return

        def handle_confirm_result(result: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
            if not result or not result.get("confirmed"):
                return

            sid = result["session_id"]
            ignore_missing = result.get("ignore_missing", False)

            self.query_one("#btn-rollback-session", Button).disabled = True
            self.query_one("#btn-export", Button).disabled = True
            self.query_one("#btn-cancel", Button).disabled = True
            self._rollback_in_progress = True

            lbl_status = self.query_one("#lbl-rollback-status", Label)
            lbl_status.update(f"⏳ Rolling back session {sid[:8]}... Please wait.")
            self.announce(f"Executing rollback for session {sid[:8]}...")

            self.run_rollback_worker(sid, ignore_missing)

        self.app.push_screen(
            RollbackConfirmModal(session_info=target_sess),
            handle_confirm_result,
        )

    @work(thread=True)
    def run_rollback_worker(self, session_id: str, ignore_missing: bool) -> None:
        """Execute session rollback asynchronously in background worker thread."""
        try:
            from app.core.history import open_session_history

            with open_session_history() as history_mgr:
                restored_count = history_mgr.rollback(
                    session_id, ignore_missing=ignore_missing
                )

            app_obj = getattr(self, "app", None)
            if app_obj and hasattr(app_obj, "call_from_thread"):
                app_obj.call_from_thread(
                    self._on_rollback_success, session_id, restored_count
                )
            else:
                self._on_rollback_success(session_id, restored_count)
        except Exception as err:
            app_obj = getattr(self, "app", None)
            if app_obj and hasattr(app_obj, "call_from_thread"):
                app_obj.call_from_thread(self._on_rollback_failure, session_id, err)
            else:
                self._on_rollback_failure(session_id, err)

    def _on_rollback_success(self, session_id: str, restored_count: int) -> None:
        """Handle successful session rollback completion on main thread."""
        self._rollback_in_progress = False
        from app.core.session_catalog import list_sessions

        self.sessions = list_sessions()
        self._refresh_session_options(selected_sid=session_id)

        lbl_status = self.query_one("#lbl-rollback-status", Label)
        lbl_status.update(
            f"✅ Session successfully rolled back. ({restored_count} operations unwound)"
        )

        msg = f"Session {session_id[:8]}... successfully rolled back ({restored_count} file(s) restored)."
        self.announce(msg)
        try:
            from app.ui.notifications import notify

            notify(msg, type="info")
        except Exception:
            pass

        self.query_one("#btn-cancel", Button).disabled = False
        self.query_one("#btn-export", Button).disabled = False

    def _on_rollback_failure(self, session_id: str, err: Exception) -> None:
        """Handle session rollback failure on main thread."""
        self._rollback_in_progress = False
        lbl_status = self.query_one("#lbl-rollback-status", Label)
        lbl_status.update(f"❌ Rollback failed: {err}")

        msg = f"Rollback failed for session {session_id[:8]}...: {err}"
        self.announce(msg)
        try:
            from app.ui.notifications import notify

            notify(msg, type="error")
        except Exception:
            pass

        self.query_one("#btn-cancel", Button).disabled = False
        self.query_one("#btn-export", Button).disabled = False
        self.query_one("#btn-rollback-session", Button).disabled = False

        self.app.push_screen(
            RollbackErrorModal(title="Rollback Failed", error_message=str(err))
        )

    def _refresh_session_options(self, selected_sid: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
        """Re-populate session select dropdown widget options after state update."""
        select_sess = self.query_one("#select-history-session", Select)
        options = [("All Sessions (Aggregate Audit Log)", "all")]
        for s in self.sessions:
            sid = s.get("session_id", "unknown")
            b_dir = s.get("base_dir") or "N/A"
            status = s.get("status") or "completed"
            step_cnt = s.get("step_count") or s.get("file_count") or 0
            options.append(
                (f"{sid[:8]}... | {status.upper()} | {step_cnt} file(s) | {b_dir}", sid)
            )

        if len(options) == 1 and not self.sessions:
            options = [("No historical sessions found", "none")]

        select_sess.set_options(options)
        if selected_sid:
            select_sess.value = selected_sid
        self._update_selected_session_view(select_sess.value)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel history export modal, unless a rollback is still running."""
        if self._rollback_in_progress:
            self.announce("Rollback in progress. Please wait for it to finish.")
            return
        self.dismiss(None)

    def __init__(self, session_info: Dict[str, Any]):
        super().__init__()
        self.session_info = session_info

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose confirmation modal widgets."""
        sid = self.session_info.get("session_id", "unknown")
        b_dir = self.session_info.get("base_dir") or "N/A"
        step_cnt = (
            self.session_info.get("step_count")
            or self.session_info.get("file_count")
            or 0
        )
        ts = self.session_info.get("timestamp")
        ts_str = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", time.localtime(ts)) if ts else "N/A"

        with Vertical(classes="confirm-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Confirm Session Rollback",
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="confirm-title",
            )
            yield Label(f"Session ID: {sid}", id="lbl-confirm-sid")
            yield Label(f"Base Directory: {b_dir}", id="lbl-confirm-dir")
            yield Label(
                f"Operations / Files to restore: {step_cnt}", id="lbl-confirm-ops"
            )
            yield Label(f"Session Timestamp: {ts_str}", id="lbl-confirm-ts")

            with Vertical(classes="warning-box"):
                yield Label(
                    "⚠️ Warning: Rolling back will restore files to their original locations prior to this session. Any subsequent manual edits or file relocations in target folders may be unwound or overwritten."
                )

            if self.session_info.get("step_count"):
                # Step-ledger sessions always skip files that are no longer
                # at their sorted location, so a force option would do nothing.
                yield Label(
                    "Files that are no longer at their sorted location are skipped.",
                    id="lbl-confirm-missing",
                )
            else:
                yield Checkbox(
                    "Roll back even if some sorted files are missing (they are skipped)",
                    value=False,
                    id="chk-ignore-missing",
                )

            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_cancel = Button(
                    "Cancel", id="btn-cancel-rollback", variant="default"
                )
                yield btn_cancel
                btn_confirm = Button(
                    "Confirm Rollback", id="btn-confirm-rollback", variant="error"
                )
                yield btn_confirm

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus confirm button and announce modal screen."""
        self.query_one("#btn-confirm-rollback", Button).focus()
        self.announce("Opened rollback confirmation modal dialog.")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-confirm-rollback")
    def action_confirm(self) -> None:
        """Confirm rollback action and dismiss modal with parameters."""
        checkboxes = self.query("#chk-ignore-missing").results(Checkbox)
        chk = next(iter(checkboxes), None)
        self.dismiss(
            {
                "confirmed": True,
                "session_id": self.session_info.get("session_id"),
                "ignore_missing": chk.value if chk else False,
            }
        )

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel-rollback")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel rollback confirmation dialog."""
        self.dismiss(None)

class SessionRecoveryModal(
    ResponsiveLayoutMixin, A11yMixin, ModalScreen[Optional[str]]
):
    """Modal dialog for recovering interrupted file sorting sessions."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    SessionRecoveryModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 80;
        min-width: 30;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow .modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 95%;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $error;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    Button:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, session_info: Dict[str, Any]):
        super().__init__()
        self.session_info = session_info

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose session recovery modal children."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Interrupted Session Detected",
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            yield Label(f"Session ID: {self.session_info.get('session_id', 'Unknown')}")
            yield Label(
                f"Target Directory: {self.session_info.get('base_dir', 'Unknown')}"
            )
            yield Label(f"Status: {self.session_info.get('status', 'Unknown')}")
            yield Heading("Select session recovery action:", level=2)

            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_clean = Button("Clean", id="btn-clean", variant="error")
                btn_clean.tooltip = "Discard session files and clean workspace"
                yield btn_clean

                btn_rollback = Button("Rollback", id="btn-rollback", variant="warning")
                btn_rollback.tooltip = (
                    "Rollback partial file moves from interrupted run"
                )
                yield btn_rollback

                btn_help = Button("Help", id="btn-help", variant="default")
                btn_help.tooltip = "Open session recovery troubleshooting guide"
                yield btn_help

                btn_resume = Button("Resume", id="btn-resume", variant="primary")
                btn_resume.tooltip = "Resume pending file moves for interrupted run"
                yield btn_resume

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus resume button on mount and emit screen reader announcement."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        self.query_one("#btn-resume", Button).focus()
        self.announce("Opened interrupted session recovery dialog.")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-resume")
    def action_resume(self) -> None:
        """Confirm resume action."""
        self.announce("Confirmed session resume.")
        self.dismiss("resume")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-rollback")
    def action_rollback(self) -> None:
        """Confirm rollback action."""
        self.announce("Confirmed session rollback.")
        self.dismiss("rollback")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-clean")
    def action_clean(self) -> None:
        """Confirm clean action."""
        self.announce("Confirmed session clean.")
        self.dismiss("clean")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-help")
    def action_help(self) -> None:
        """Open session recovery troubleshooting guide."""
        url = f"{TROUBLESHOOTING_URL}#session-recovery"
        from app.ui.notifications import notify

        notify(f"Opening help link: {url}", type="info", help_url=url)
        self.announce(f"Opened documentation link: {url}")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel recovery dialog."""
        self.announce("Cancelled session recovery dialog.")
        self.dismiss(None)

class SettingsModal(
    ResponsiveLayoutMixin, A11yMixin, ModalScreen[Optional[Dict[str, Any]]]
):
    """Modal dialog for modifying application settings."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    SettingsModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 80;
        min-width: 30;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow .modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 95%;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .field-label {
        margin-top: 1;
        color: $text;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    .switch-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: left middle;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    Button:focus, Input:focus, Select:focus, Switch:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    Button.hidden {
        display: none;
    }
    SettingsModal TabbedContent {
        height: auto;
    }
    SettingsModal TabPane {
        height: auto;
        padding: 0;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, settings):
        super().__init__()
        self.settings = settings
        self.help_url = f"{TROUBLESHOOTING_URL}#settings-configuration"

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose modal dialog children."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Application Settings [Ctrl+O]",
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )

            with TabbedContent(initial="tab-general", id="settings-tabbed-content"):
                with TabPane("General Settings", id="tab-general"):
                    yield Label(
                        "Protected Directories (comma-separated):",
                        classes="field-label",
                    )
                    prot = getattr(self.settings, "PROTECTED_PATHS", [])
                    prot_str = (
                        ", ".join(prot)
                        if isinstance(prot, (list, tuple, set))
                        else str(prot)
                    )
                    inp_prot = Input(
                        value=prot_str,
                        placeholder="/path/1, /path/2",
                        id="input-protected",
                    )
                    inp_prot.tooltip = "Comma-separated protected directories exempt from automated moves"
                    yield inp_prot

                    yield Label(
                        "Ignored Extensions (comma-separated):", classes="field-label"
                    )
                    ign = getattr(self.settings, "IGNORED_EXTENSIONS", [])
                    ign_str = (
                        ", ".join(ign)
                        if isinstance(ign, (list, tuple, set))
                        else str(ign)
                    )
                    inp_ign = Input(
                        value=ign_str,
                        placeholder=".tmp, .bak, .log",
                        id="input-ignored",
                    )
                    inp_ign.tooltip = (
                        "Comma-separated file extensions to ignore during scanning"
                    )
                    yield inp_ign

                    yield Label("Max Folders:", classes="field-label")
                    max_f_str = str(getattr(self.settings, "MAX_FOLDERS", 12))
                    inp_max_f = Input(
                        value=max_f_str, placeholder="12", id="input-max-folders"
                    )
                    inp_max_f.tooltip = (
                        "Maximum subdirectories generated during sorting"
                    )
                    yield inp_max_f

                    yield Label("Worker Concurrency (Threads):", classes="field-label")
                    conc_str = str(getattr(self.settings, "MAX_WORKERS", 4))
                    inp_conc = Input(
                        value=conc_str, placeholder="4", id="input-concurrency"
                    )
                    inp_conc.tooltip = "Worker concurrency thread limit for processing"
                    yield inp_conc

                    yield Label("Conflict Policy:", classes="field-label")
                    conflict_pol = getattr(self.settings, "CONFLICT_POLICY", "rename")
                    conflict_options = [
                        ("Overwrite", "overwrite"),
                        ("Auto-Rename", "rename"),
                        ("Skip", "skip"),
                    ]
                    sel_conflict = Select(
                        options=conflict_options,
                        value=conflict_pol,
                        id="select-conflict-policy",
                    )
                    sel_conflict.tooltip = "Select collision handling strategy for conflicting target files"
                    yield sel_conflict

                with TabPane("AI & Privacy Settings", id="tab-ai-privacy"):
                    yield Heading("Sorting Strategy:", level=2, classes="field-label")
                    strat = getattr(self.settings, "SORTING_STRATEGY", "default")
                    options = [
                        ("Standard Semantic", "default"),
                        ("Generative AI", "generative"),
                    ]
                    from app.core.plugin_registry import PluginRegistry

                    reg = PluginRegistry.get_instance()
                    reg.load_plugins_from_settings(self.settings)
                    options.extend(reg.get_tui_strategy_options())
                    if not any(opt[1] == strat for opt in options):
                        options.append((f"Extension ({strat})", strat))
                    sel_strat = Select(
                        options=options, value=strat, id="select-strategy"
                    )
                    sel_strat.tooltip = (
                        "Select sorting strategy engine for document classification"
                    )
                    yield sel_strat

                    yield Heading(
                        "Compliance & Renaming Toggles:", level=2, classes="field-label"
                    )
                    for sw_cfg in reg.get_tui_switches():
                        sw_key = sw_cfg.get("key", "")
                        sw_id = sw_cfg.get("id", f"switch-{sw_key.lower()}")
                        sw_lbl = sw_cfg.get("label", f" {sw_key}")
                        sw_tip = sw_cfg.get("tooltip", "")
                        sw_val = bool(getattr(self.settings, sw_key, False))
                        yield LabeledSwitch(
                            label=sw_lbl,
                            value=sw_val,
                            switch_id=sw_id,
                            tooltip=sw_tip,
                        )

                    yield LabeledSwitch(
                        label="AI Consent Granted",
                        value=bool(getattr(self.settings, "AI_CONSENT_GRANTED", False)),
                        switch_id="switch-ai-consent",
                        tooltip="Toggle AI consent for semantic document classification and processing",
                    )

                    yield LabeledSwitch(
                        label="AI Contextual Renaming",
                        value=bool(
                            getattr(self.settings, "CONTEXTUAL_RENAMING", False)
                        ),
                        switch_id="switch-contextual-renaming",
                        tooltip="Toggle AI contextual file renaming",
                    )

                    yield LabeledSwitch(
                        label="Speak Status Messages Aloud",
                        value=bool(
                            getattr(self.settings, "SPEAK_ANNOUNCEMENTS", False)
                        ),
                        switch_id="switch-speak-announcements",
                        tooltip="Read each status message aloud with the system speech command (say / spd-say)",
                    )

                    btn_scrub = Button(
                        "Scrub AI Artifacts",
                        id="btn-scrub-artifacts",
                        variant="warning",
                    )
                    btn_scrub.tooltip = "Report vector count and cache footprint, and scrub stored vectors and model files"
                    yield btn_scrub

                    btn_templates = Button(
                        "Starter Rule Template Gallery",
                        id="btn-open-templates",
                        variant="primary",
                    )
                    btn_templates.tooltip = (
                        "View and apply pre-configured starter rule template packs"
                    )
                    yield btn_templates

                with TabPane("Extraction & OCR", id="tab-extraction"):
                    yield Label(
                        "PDF Text Density Threshold (chars/page):",
                        classes="field-label",
                    )
                    density_val = getattr(
                        self.settings, "PDF_TEXT_DENSITY_THRESHOLD", 50
                    )
                    inp_density = Input(
                        value=str(density_val),
                        placeholder="50",
                        id="input-pdf-density-threshold",
                    )
                    inp_density.tooltip = "Pages with fewer embedded characters trigger EasyOCR rasterization fallback"
                    yield inp_density

                    slider_density = DensitySlider(
                        value=int(density_val),
                        min_value=0,
                        max_value=500,
                        step=5,
                        id="slider-pdf-density-threshold",
                    )
                    slider_density.tooltip = "Adjust PDF text density threshold slider"
                    yield slider_density

            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_cancel = Button("Cancel", id="btn-cancel", variant="default")
                btn_cancel.tooltip = "Cancel settings modification and close dialog"
                yield btn_cancel
                btn_model_mgr = Button(
                    "Model Manager", id="btn-model-mgr", variant="primary"
                )
                btn_model_mgr.tooltip = (
                    "Open dedicated interactive model management modal"
                )
                yield btn_model_mgr
                btn_help = Button(
                    "Help", id="btn-help", variant="warning", classes="hidden"
                )
                btn_help.tooltip = "Open settings configuration troubleshooting guide"
                yield btn_help
                btn_save = Button("Save Settings", id="btn-save", variant="primary")
                btn_save.tooltip = "Save modified application settings"
                yield btn_save

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus initial input field on mount and emit announcement."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        self.query_one("#input-protected", Input).focus()
        self.announce("Opened application settings dialog.")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-open-templates")
    def action_open_templates(self) -> None:
        """Open starter rule template gallery modal."""
        self.app.push_screen(TemplateGalleryModal(self.settings))

    @on(DensitySlider.Changed, "#slider-pdf-density-threshold")
    def _on_density_slider_changed(self, event: DensitySlider.Changed) -> None:
        try:
            inp = self.query_one("#input-pdf-density-threshold", Input)
            if inp.value != str(event.value):
                inp.value = str(event.value)
        except Exception:
            pass

    @on(Input.Changed, "#input-pdf-density-threshold")
    def _on_density_input_changed(self, event: Input.Changed) -> None:
        try:
            val = int(event.value.strip())
            slider = self.query_one("#slider-pdf-density-threshold", DensitySlider)
            if slider.value != val and slider.min_value <= val <= slider.max_value:
                slider.value = val
        except Exception:
            pass

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-scrub-artifacts")
    def action_scrub_artifacts(self) -> None:
        """Open Scrub AI Artifacts confirmation modal."""
        db_inst = getattr(self.app, "db", None) if hasattr(self, "app") else None
        v_count = _get_vector_count(db_inst)
        footprint_mb = _get_model_cache_footprint_mb()

        def _on_scrub_modal_result(confirmed: bool) -> None:
            if confirmed:
                self._execute_scrub_and_purge()

        if hasattr(self, "app") and self.app:
            self.app.push_screen(
                ScrubArtifactsModal(v_count, footprint_mb), _on_scrub_modal_result
            )

    @on(Switch.Changed, "#switch-ai-consent")
    def on_ai_consent_changed(self, event: Switch.Changed) -> None:
        """Prompt user confirmation when AI consent switch is toggled off."""
        if not event.value:
            db_inst = getattr(self.app, "db", None) if hasattr(self, "app") else None
            v_count = _get_vector_count(db_inst)
            footprint_mb = _get_model_cache_footprint_mb()

            def _on_revoke_modal_result(confirmed: bool) -> None:
                if confirmed:
                    if self.settings:
                        self.settings.AI_CONSENT_GRANTED = False
                    if (
                        hasattr(self, "app")
                        and hasattr(self.app, "settings")
                        and self.app.settings
                    ):
                        self.app.settings.AI_CONSENT_GRANTED = False
                    self._execute_scrub_and_purge()
                    if hasattr(self, "announce"):
                        self.announce(
                            "AI consent revoked and artifacts scrubbed.",
                            priority="polite",
                        )
                else:
                    event.switch.value = True

            if hasattr(self, "app") and self.app:
                self.app.push_screen(
                    ConsentRevocationModal(v_count, footprint_mb),
                    _on_revoke_modal_result,
                )

    def _execute_scrub_and_purge(self) -> None:
        """Execute memory model unload, database vector clearing, and background model cache purging."""
        try:
            from app.core.shared_registry import SharedModelRegistry

            SharedModelRegistry.get_instance().unload_all_models()
        except Exception:
            pass

        try:
            if hasattr(self, "app") and hasattr(self.app, "db") and self.app.db:
                self.app.db.clear_all_document_vectors()
        except Exception:
            pass

        try:
            from app.core.db import Database

            Database.scrub_all_vectors()
        except Exception:
            pass

        try:
            from app.config import get_app_dir
            from app.core.downloader import DownloadManager

            model_dir = str(get_app_dir() / "model")
            dm = DownloadManager.get_instance()

            def _on_purge_done(success: bool, err: Optional[Exception]):
                if success:
                    if hasattr(self, "announce"):
                        self.announce(
                            "AI artifacts scrubbed and model cache purged successfully.",
                            priority="polite",
                        )
                else:
                    if hasattr(self, "announce"):
                        self.announce(
                            f"Model cache purge failed: {err}", priority="assertive"
                        )

            dm.delete_model_async(model_dir, on_done=_on_purge_done)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error purging model cache: {e}")

        try:
            from app.ui.notifications import notify

            notify(
                "AI artifacts scrubbed and model cache purging started.", type="info"
            )
        except Exception:
            pass
        if hasattr(self, "announce"):
            self.announce("AI artifacts scrubbed and model cache purging started.")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-save")
    def action_save(self) -> None:
        """Save settings and dismiss modal."""
        p_str = self.query_one("#input-protected", Input).value
        p_list = [p.strip() for p in p_str.split(",") if p.strip()]

        i_str = self.query_one("#input-ignored", Input).value
        i_list = [
            i.strip() if i.strip().startswith(".") else f".{i.strip()}"
            for i in i_str.split(",")
            if i.strip()
        ]

        help_url = f"{TROUBLESHOOTING_URL}#settings-configuration"
        try:
            conc_val = self.query_one("#input-concurrency", Input).value.strip()
            conc = int(conc_val)
            if conc <= 0:
                raise ValueError("Worker concurrency must be greater than 0.")
        except ValueError as e:
            self._show_help_button(help_url)
            from app.ui.notifications import notify

            notify(f"Settings error: {e}", type="error", help_url=help_url)
            self.announce(f"Settings error: {e}", help_url=help_url)
            return

        try:
            max_f_val = self.query_one("#input-max-folders", Input).value.strip()
            max_f = int(max_f_val)
            if max_f <= 0:
                raise ValueError("Max folders must be greater than 0.")
        except ValueError as e:
            self._show_help_button(help_url)
            from app.ui.notifications import notify

            notify(f"Settings error: {e}", type="error", help_url=help_url)
            self.announce(f"Settings error: {e}", help_url=help_url)
            return

        try:
            density_val_str = self.query_one(
                "#input-pdf-density-threshold", Input
            ).value.strip()
            pdf_density = int(density_val_str)
            if pdf_density < 0:
                raise ValueError("PDF text density threshold must be non-negative.")
        except ValueError as e:
            self._show_help_button(help_url)
            from app.ui.notifications import notify

            notify(f"Settings error: {e}", type="error", help_url=help_url)
            self.announce(f"Settings error: {e}", help_url=help_url)
            return

        strat = self.query_one("#select-strategy", Select).value
        if strat == Select.BLANK:
            strat = "default"

        try:
            clin_renaming = self.query_one("#switch-clinical-renaming", Switch).value
        except Exception:
            clin_renaming = bool(
                getattr(self.settings, "CLINICAL_SMART_RENAMING", False)
            )
        try:
            ctx_renaming = self.query_one("#switch-contextual-renaming", Switch).value
        except Exception:
            ctx_renaming = bool(getattr(self.settings, "CONTEXTUAL_RENAMING", False))
        try:
            speak = self.query_one("#switch-speak-announcements", Switch).value
        except Exception:
            speak = bool(getattr(self.settings, "SPEAK_ANNOUNCEMENTS", False))
        try:
            ai_consent = self.query_one("#switch-ai-consent", Switch).value
        except Exception:
            ai_consent = bool(getattr(self.settings, "AI_CONSENT_GRANTED", False))

        if (
            ai_consent is False
            and getattr(self.settings, "AI_CONSENT_GRANTED", None) is True
        ):
            self._execute_scrub_and_purge()

        try:
            conflict_pol = self.query_one("#select-conflict-policy", Select).value
            if conflict_pol == Select.BLANK:
                conflict_pol = "rename"
        except Exception:
            conflict_pol = getattr(self.settings, "CONFLICT_POLICY", "rename")

        res = {
            "PROTECTED_PATHS": p_list,
            "IGNORED_EXTENSIONS": i_list,
            "MAX_WORKERS": conc,
            "MAX_FOLDERS": max_f,
            "PDF_TEXT_DENSITY_THRESHOLD": pdf_density,
            "CONFLICT_POLICY": conflict_pol,
            "SORTING_STRATEGY": strat,
            "CLINICAL_SMART_RENAMING": clin_renaming,
            "CONTEXTUAL_RENAMING": ctx_renaming,
            "AI_CONSENT_GRANTED": ai_consent,
            "SPEAK_ANNOUNCEMENTS": speak,
        }
        self.announce("Saved application settings.")
        self.dismiss(res)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-help")
    def action_help(self) -> None:
        """Open settings troubleshooting documentation."""
        url = getattr(
            self,
            "help_url",
            f"{TROUBLESHOOTING_URL}#settings-configuration",
        )
        from app.ui.notifications import notify

        notify(f"Opening help link: {url}", type="info", help_url=url)
        self.announce(f"Opened documentation link: {url}")

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-cancel")
    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel settings modification."""
        self.announce("Cancelled settings modification.")
        self.dismiss(None)

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-model-mgr")
    def action_open_model_manager(self) -> None:
        """Open model manager modal."""
        if hasattr(self, "app") and self.app:
            self.app.push_screen(ModelManagerModal(self.settings))

def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
    """Compose modal dialog children."""
    with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
        yield Heading(
            "Application Settings [Ctrl+O]",
            level=1,
            classes="modal-title",
            id="modal-title",
        )

        with TabbedContent(initial="tab-general", id="settings-tabbed-content"):
            with TabPane("General Settings", id="tab-general"):
                yield Label(
                    "Protected Directories (comma-separated):",
                    classes="field-label",
                )
                prot = getattr(self.settings, "PROTECTED_PATHS", [])
                prot_str = (
                    ", ".join(prot)

                    else str(prot)
                )
                inp_prot = Input(
                    value=prot_str,
                    placeholder="/path/1, /path/2",

                yield Label(

                )
                ign = getattr(self.settings, "IGNORED_EXTENSIONS", [])
                ign_str = (
                    ", ".join(ign)
                    if isinstance(ign, (list, tuple, set))
                    else str(ign)
                )
                inp_ign = Input(
                    value=ign_str,
                    placeholder=".tmp, .bak, .log",

                yield Label("Max Folders:", classes="field-label")

                    and hasattr(self.app, "settings")
                    and self.app.settings

                self._execute_scrub_and_purge()
                if hasattr(self, "announce"):
                    self.announce(
                        "AI consent revoked and artifacts scrubbed.",
                        priority="polite",
                    )
            else:
                event.switch.value = True

        if hasattr(self, "app") and self.app:
            self.app.push_screen(
                ConsentRevocationModal(v_count, footprint_mb),
                _on_revoke_modal_result,
            )

class WizardModal(ResponsiveLayoutMixin, A11yMixin, ModalScreen[None]):
    """Modal dialog for model onboarding wizard."""

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel", "Cancel dialog", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    WizardModal {
        align: center middle;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .modal-box {
        padding: 1 2;
        background: $panel;
        border: thick $primary;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 80;
        min-width: 30;
        height: auto;
        max-height: 90%;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .narrow .modal-box {
        padding: 0 1;
        width: 95%;
    }
    .modal-title {
        text-style: bold;
        color: $accent;
        margin-bottom: 1;
    }
    .field-label {
        margin-top: 1;
        color: $text;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    .switch-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        margin-bottom: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: left middle;
    }
    .button-row {
        margin-top: 1;
        height: 3;
        align: right middle;
    }
    Button:focus, Checkbox:focus, Switch:focus {
        border: heavy $accent;
        text-style: bold;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, settings):
        super().__init__()
        self.settings = settings

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose modal dialog children."""
        with Vertical(classes="modal-box"):
            yield Heading(
                "Model Onboarding Wizard [Ctrl+W]",
                level=1,
                classes="modal-title",
                id="modal-title",
            )
            yield Label("Welcome to Smart AutoSorter AI Pro TUI.")
            yield Label("Enable AI semantic categorization consent below:")

            consent_val = getattr(self.settings, "AI_CONSENT_GRANTED", None)
            if consent_val is None:
                consent_val = False
            yield LabeledSwitch(
                label="AI Consent Granted",
                value=bool(consent_val),
                switch_id="switch-consent",
                tooltip="Toggle AI consent for semantic document classification",
            )

            yield LabeledSwitch(
                label="Generate Sample Documents",
                value=False,
                switch_id="switch-sample-corpus",
                tooltip="Toggle generation of sample document corpus in active workspace",
            )

            yield Heading(
                "Starter Rule Template Packs:", level=2, classes="field-label"
            )
            yield Label(
                "Select pre-built template packs to populate keyword rules & compliance policies:"
            )

            from app.core.rule_templates import get_starter_templates

            for pack in get_starter_templates():
                is_default = pack.id in ("financial_tax", "personal_admin")
                chk = Checkbox(
                    f"{pack.icon} {pack.title}",
                    value=is_default,
                    id=f"chk-template-{pack.id}",
                )
                chk.tooltip = pack.description
                yield chk

            yield Label("Status: Local embedded AI model weights verified.")

            with Horizontal(classes="button-row"):
                btn_finish = Button("Finish & Save", id="btn-finish", variant="primary")
                btn_finish.tooltip = (
                    "Save AI consent setting and complete onboarding wizard"
                )
                yield btn_finish

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Focus switch on mount and emit screen reader announcement."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        try:
            self.query_one("#switch-consent", Switch).focus()
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.announce("Opened model onboarding wizard dialog.")

    @on(Switch.Changed)
    def on_switch_changed(self, event: Switch.Changed) -> None:
        """Announce switch state changes for screen reader accessibility."""
        switch_id = getattr(event.switch, "id", None) or getattr(
            event.control, "id", None
        )
        if not switch_id:
            return

        if switch_id == "switch-consent":
            state = "enabled" if event.value else "disabled"
            self.announce(f"AI consent {state}.")
        elif switch_id == "switch-sample-corpus":
            state = "enabled" if event.value else "disabled"
            self.announce(f"Sample document corpus generation {state}.")

    @on(Checkbox.Changed)
    def on_checkbox_changed(self, event: Checkbox.Changed) -> None:
        """Announce starter template checkbox selection state changes."""
        chk_id = getattr(event.checkbox, "id", None) or getattr(
            event.control, "id", None
        )
        if not chk_id:
            return

        prefix = ""
        if chk_id.startswith("chk-template-"):
            prefix = "chk-template-"
        elif chk_id.startswith("chk-gallery-"):
            prefix = "chk-gallery-"
        else:
            return

        pack_id = chk_id[len(prefix) :]
        from app.core.rule_templates import get_starter_templates

        for pack in get_starter_templates():
            if pack.id == pack_id:
                state = "selected" if event.value else "deselected"
                self.announce(f"{pack.title} template pack {state}.")
                break

    @on(Button.Pressed, "#btn-finish")
    def action_finish(self) -> None:
        """Finish wizard, save consent settings, and apply selected starter rule templates."""
        try:
            consent = self.query_one("#switch-consent", Switch).value
        except Exception:
            consent = False
        self.settings.AI_CONSENT_GRANTED = consent

        from app.core.rule_templates import (
            apply_starter_templates,
            get_starter_templates,
        )

        selected_packs = []
        for pack in get_starter_templates():
            try:
                chk = self.query_one(f"#chk-template-{pack.id}", Checkbox)
                if chk.value:
                    selected_packs.append(pack.id)
            except Exception:
                pass

        if selected_packs:
            apply_starter_templates(self.settings, selected_packs)

        if hasattr(self.settings, "_save"):
            try:
                self.settings._save()
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Error saving consent setting: {e}")
        gen_sample = False
        try:
            gen_sample = self.query_one("#switch-sample-corpus", Switch).value
        except Exception:
            pass

        if gen_sample:
            from app.core.sample_corpus import generate_sample_corpus

            target_dir = getattr(self.app, "base_dir", "") or os.getcwd()
            if hasattr(self.app, "base_dir"):
                self.app.base_dir = target_dir
            try:
                generate_sample_corpus(target_dir, overwrite=True)
                self.announce(f"Generated sample document corpus in '{target_dir}'.")
                if hasattr(self.app, "action_scan_directory"):
                    self.app.action_scan_directory()
            except Exception as exc:
                logger.error(f"Failed to generate sample corpus: {exc}")

        self.announce(
            "Finished model onboarding wizard, saved consent settings, and applied selected starter rule templates."
        )
        self.dismiss(None)

    def action_cancel(self) -> None:
        """Cancel wizard on Escape key press."""
        if hasattr(self.app, "_wizard_dismissed_this_session"):
            self.app._wizard_dismissed_this_session = True
        self.announce("Closed model onboarding wizard dialog.")
        self.dismiss(None)

class NotificationManager:
    """Central dispatcher for environment-aware notifications."""

    _instance: Optional["NotificationManager"] = None
    _lock = threading.RLock()

    def __init__(self):
        self._mode: NotificationMode = NotificationMode.AUTO
        self._active_tui_app: Optional[Any] = None
        self._output_stream = sys.stderr
        self._custom_handlers: list[Callable[..., Any]] = []

    @classmethod
    def get_instance(cls) -> "NotificationManager":
        """Retrieve the singleton NotificationManager instance."""
        if cls._instance is None:
            with cls._lock:
                if cls._instance is None:
                    cls._instance = cls()
        return cls._instance

    @classmethod
    def reset_instance(cls):
        """Reset singleton instance (useful for unit tests)."""
        with cls._lock:
            cls._instance = None

    def set_mode(self, mode: NotificationMode | str) -> None:
        """Set active notification mode explicitly."""
        if isinstance(mode, str):
            mode = NotificationMode(mode.lower())
        self._mode = mode

    def get_mode(self) -> NotificationMode:
        """Get currently configured notification mode."""
        return self._mode

    def register_tui(self, app: Any) -> None:
        """Register active Textual TUI app instance."""
        self._active_tui_app = app

    def unregister_tui(self, app: Any = None) -> None:
        """Unregister active Textual TUI app instance."""
        if app is None or self._active_tui_app is app:
            self._active_tui_app = None

    def set_output_stream(self, stream: Any) -> None:
        """Set output stream for CLI/terminal notifications (defaults to sys.stderr)."""
        self._output_stream = stream

    def register_handler(self, handler: Callable[..., Any]) -> None:
        """Register a custom notification handler callback."""
        if handler not in self._custom_handlers:
            self._custom_handlers.append(handler)

    def detect_mode(self) -> NotificationMode:
        """Detect current active runtime environment mode."""
        if self._mode != NotificationMode.AUTO:
            return self._mode

        tui_app = self._get_active_tui_app()
        if tui_app is not None:
            return NotificationMode.TUI

        return NotificationMode.CLI

    def _get_active_tui_app(self) -> Optional[Any]:
        if self._active_tui_app is not None:
            return self._active_tui_app
        try:
            from textual._context import active_app

            app = active_app.get(None)
            if app is not None:
                return app
        except ImportError:
            logger.debug("Textual active_app context unavailable", exc_info=True)
        return None

    def notify(
        self,
        message: Any,
        type: str = "info",
        caption: Optional[str] = None,
        timeout: Optional[int] = None,
        help_url: Optional[str] = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Dispatch a notification based on the active runtime environment mode.

        Args:
            message: Message text or object to display.
            type: Notification type ('info', 'positive', 'negative', 'warning', 'error').
            caption: Optional subtitle or secondary text.
            timeout: Display timeout in milliseconds or seconds.
            help_url: Optional troubleshooting link for contextual help.
            **kwargs: Additional parameters passed to target UI handler.

        Returns
        -------
            Dict containing event summary details.
        """
        msg_str = _sanitize_notification_text(message) or ""
        caption_str = _sanitize_notification_text(caption)
        mode = self.detect_mode()

        event = {
            "message": msg_str,
            "type": type,
            "caption": caption_str,
            "timeout": timeout,
            "help_url": help_url,
            "mode": mode.value,
            "kwargs": kwargs,
        }

        # Dispatch to custom handlers first
        for handler in list(self._custom_handlers):
            try:
                handler(event)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.debug(
                    f"Error in custom notification handler: {e}", exc_info=True
                )

        if mode == NotificationMode.TUI:
            self._dispatch_tui(
                msg_str,
                type=type,
                caption=caption_str,
                timeout=timeout,
                help_url=help_url,
                **kwargs,
            )
        else:
            self._dispatch_cli(
                msg_str, type=type, caption=caption_str, help_url=help_url, **kwargs
            )

        return event

    def _dispatch_tui(
        self,
        message: str,
        type: str = "info",
        caption: Optional[str] = None,
        timeout: Optional[int] = None,
        help_url: Optional[str] = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        tui_app = self._get_active_tui_app()
        if tui_app is None:
            self._dispatch_cli(
                message, type=type, caption=caption, help_url=help_url, **kwargs
            )
            return

        type_lower = (type or "info").lower()
        if type_lower in ("positive", "success"):
            severity = "information"
        elif type_lower in ("negative", "error"):
            severity = "error"
        elif type_lower in ("warning", "warn"):
            severity = "warning"
        else:
            severity = "information"

        title = caption or "Notification"
        toast_timeout = (
            float(timeout / 1000.0) if timeout and timeout > 100 else (timeout or 5)
        )

        display_msg = f"{message} [Help: {help_url}]" if help_url else message

        def _do_notify():
            toast_ok = False
            try:
                tui_app.notify(
                    display_msg,
                    title=title,
                    severity=severity,
                    timeout=toast_timeout,
                )
                toast_ok = True
            except Exception as ex:
                logger.debug(f"Textual toast notification failed: {ex}", exc_info=True)

            log_ok = False
            try:
                from textual.widgets import Log

                log_widget = tui_app.query_one("#tui-log", Log)
                log_widget.write_line(f"[{type.upper()}] {display_msg}")
                log_ok = True
            except Exception:
                logger.debug("TUI log widget dispatch failed", exc_info=True)

            if not toast_ok and not log_ok:
                raise RuntimeError("Both TUI toast and log widget dispatch failed")

        try:
            if threading.current_thread() is getattr(
                tui_app, "_thread", None
            ) or getattr(tui_app, "is_headless", False):
                _do_notify()
            elif hasattr(tui_app, "call_from_thread"):
                tui_app.call_from_thread(_do_notify)
            else:
                _do_notify()
        except Exception as ex:
            logger.debug(f"TUI dispatch failed: {ex}", exc_info=True)
            self._dispatch_cli(
                message, type=type, caption=caption, help_url=help_url, **kwargs
            )

    def _dispatch_cli(
        self,
        message: str,
        type: str = "info",
        caption: Optional[str] = None,
        help_url: Optional[str] = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        clean_msg = sanitize_secret_patterns(scrub_user_home_paths(message))
        full_msg = f"{caption}: {clean_msg}" if caption else clean_msg
        if help_url:
            full_msg = f"{full_msg} [Help: {help_url}]"

        tag = (type or "info").upper()
        formatted = f"[NOTIFICATION] [{tag}] {full_msg}\n"

        if tag in ("NEGATIVE", "ERROR"):
            logger.error(full_msg)
        elif tag in ("WARNING", "WARN"):
            logger.warning(full_msg)
        else:
            logger.info(full_msg)

        try:
            if self._output_stream and hasattr(self._output_stream, "write"):
                self._output_stream.write(formatted)
                if hasattr(self._output_stream, "flush"):
                    self._output_stream.flush()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"Failed writing notification to stream: {e}", exc_info=True)

    def __init__(
        self,
        settings,
        base_dir: Optional[str] = None,
        source_dirs: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        skip_wizard: bool = False,
        non_interactive: bool = False,
        db: Optional[Any] = None,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.settings = settings
        self.db = db
        if source_dirs:
            self.source_dirs = [
                d if str(d).startswith("/") else os.path.abspath(d)
                for d in source_dirs
                if d
            ]
            self.base_dir = self.source_dirs[0] if self.source_dirs else ""
        elif base_dir and str(base_dir).startswith("/"):
            self.base_dir = str(base_dir)
            self.source_dirs = [self.base_dir]
        elif base_dir:
            self.base_dir = os.path.abspath(base_dir)
            self.source_dirs = [self.base_dir]
        else:
            self.base_dir = ""
            self.source_dirs = []
        self.skip_wizard = skip_wizard
        self.non_interactive = non_interactive
        self.plan: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        self.locked_files: Dict[str, str] = {}
        self._ratings_cache: Dict[str, str] = {}
        self.app_session = None
        self.active_tree_node = None
        self.visual_select_active: bool = False
        self.visual_selected_nodes: list = []
        self._wizard_dismissed_this_session: bool = False
        self.verification_result: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        self.has_critical_errors: bool = False
        self.critical_error_paths: set = set()
        self.warning_paths: set = set()

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        """Compose main dual-pane TUI layout."""
        yield Header(show_clock=True)
        with Horizontal(id="main-dual-pane"):
            with Vertical(id="left-tree-pane"):
                search_input = Input(
                    placeholder="Search tree nodes...",
                    id="tree-search-input",
                )
                search_input.tooltip = (
                    "Real-time search input field to filter preview tree nodes"
                )
                yield search_input
                tree = VimTree("Proposed Organization Plan", id="plan-tree")
                tree.tooltip = (
                    "Interactive tree view of proposed file organization plan"
                )
                yield tree
            with Vertical(id="right-meta-pane"):
                yield Heading(
                    "Side-by-Side Path Comparison", level=2, classes="meta-header"
                )
                path_comp = Static(
                    "Select a file or folder in the tree to compare source and target paths.",
                    id="path-comparison",
                )
                path_comp.tooltip = "Side-by-side split column view comparing source and destination target paths"
                yield path_comp
                yield Heading("Node Metadata Inspector", level=2, classes="meta-header")
                meta_widget = Static(
                    "Select a node in the tree to inspect details.", id="meta-details"
                )
                meta_widget.tooltip = "Metadata inspector panel displaying attributes of selected file or folder"
                yield meta_widget
                yield Heading("Live Execution Log", level=2, classes="meta-header")
                tui_log = Log(id="tui-log", classes="tui-log-area")
                tui_log.tooltip = "Live operation execution log output feed"
                yield tui_log
                btn_exec = Button(
                    "Execute Plan [Ctrl+E]",
                    id="btn-execute",
                    variant="primary",
                    disabled=True,
                )
                btn_exec.tooltip = EXECUTE_NEEDS_SCAN_TOOLTIP
                yield btn_exec
        alert_banner = Static("", id="alert-banner")
        alert_banner.tooltip = (
            "Validation alert banner displaying blocking errors or warnings"
        )
        yield alert_banner
        pb = ProgressBar(total=100, show_percentage=True, id="main-progress-bar")
        pb.tooltip = "Active operation background progress indicator"
        pb.display = False
        yield pb
        initial_status = f"{self._get_ai_status_badge()} Ready. Press [Ctrl+S] to Scan or [Ctrl+B] to select Directory."
        sb = Static(
            initial_status,
            id="status-bar",
        )
        sb.tooltip = "Application status and screen reader announcement bar"
        yield sb
        yield Footer()

    def announce(
        self,
        message: str,
        priority: str = "polite",
        help_url: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> str:
        """Emit screen reader announcement and log to live execution log feed."""
        res = super().announce(message, priority=priority, help_url=help_url)
        try:
            log_w = self.query_one("#tui-log", Log)
            display_msg = f"{res} [Help: {help_url}]" if help_url else res
            log_w.write_line(display_msg)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return res

    def _handle_progress_update(
        self,
        update_or_prog: Any = 0.0,
        stage: Optional[str] = None,
        unit_count: Optional[int] = None,
        unit_type: Optional[str] = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        """Handle progress updates dispatched from worker threads to main UI thread."""
        try:
            pb = self.query_one("#main-progress-bar", ProgressBar)
            pb.display = True

            progress_val = 0.0
            stage_text = stage
            count_val = unit_count

            if hasattr(update_or_prog, "progress"):
                progress_val = getattr(update_or_prog, "progress", 0.0)
                if stage_text is None:
                    stage_text = getattr(update_or_prog, "stage", None)
                if count_val is None:
                    count_val = getattr(update_or_prog, "unit_count", None)
                if unit_type is None:
                    unit_type = getattr(update_or_prog, "unit_type", None)
            elif isinstance(update_or_prog, (int, float)):
                progress_val = float(update_or_prog)
            elif isinstance(update_or_prog, str):
                stage_text = update_or_prog

            # Convert 0.0-1.0 ratio to percentage (0.0-100.0) if needed
            if 0.0 <= progress_val <= 1.0:
                pct = progress_val * 100.0
            else:
                pct = progress_val

            pct = min(100.0, max(0.0, pct))
            pb.progress = pct

            if stage_text:
                status_msg = f"[{pct:.0f}%] {stage_text}"
                if count_val is not None:
                    u_type = unit_type or "items"
                    status_msg = f"[{pct:.0f}%] ({count_val} {u_type}) {stage_text}"
                sb = self.query_one("#status-bar", Static)
                sb.update(f"{self._get_ai_status_badge()} {status_msg}")
                try:
                    log_w = self.query_one("#tui-log", Log)
                    log_w.write_line(status_msg)
                except Exception:
                    pass
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"Error handling progress update: {e}")

    def reset_progress_bar(self) -> None:
        """Reset progress bar to idle state and hide component."""
        try:
            pb = self.query_one("#main-progress-bar", ProgressBar)
            pb.progress = 0.0
            pb.total = 100
            pb.display = False
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _update_layout(self, width: int) -> None:
        """Update container CSS classes based on viewport width breakpoint."""
        try:
            dual_pane = self.query_one("#main-dual-pane")
            if width < 100:
                dual_pane.add_class("narrow")
            else:
                dual_pane.remove_class("narrow")
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _start_hint(self) -> str:
        """Tell a user with no plan yet which key starts the workflow."""
        if self.base_dir:
            return f"No plan yet. Press Ctrl+S to scan {self.base_dir}, or Ctrl+B to choose another folder."
        return "No plan yet. Press Ctrl+B to choose a folder to sort."

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        """Mount event handler."""
        self._update_layout(self.size.width)
        try:
            from app.ui.notifications import NotificationManager

            NotificationManager.get_instance().register_tui(self)
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            from app.config import AppSettings

            AppSettings.add_observer("AI_CONSENT_GRANTED", self._on_ai_consent_changed)
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            tree = self.query_one("#plan-tree", Tree)
            tree.show_root = True
            tree.root.expand()
            tree.focus()
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.announce(f"Ready. {self._start_hint()}")
        self.check_abandoned_sessions()

        env_non_interactive = os.environ.get("NON_INTERACTIVE")
        is_non_interactive_env = bool(
            env_non_interactive
            and env_non_interactive.strip().lower() in ("1", "true", "yes", "on")
        )
        env_consent = os.environ.get("SORTIFY_AI_CONSENT")
        if env_consent is not None:
            env_consent_clean = env_consent.strip().lower()
            if env_consent_clean in ("1", "true", "yes", "on"):
                self.settings.AI_CONSENT_GRANTED = True
            elif env_consent_clean in ("0", "false", "no", "off"):
                self.settings.AI_CONSENT_GRANTED = False

        is_bypass = (
            self.skip_wizard
            or self.non_interactive
            or getattr(self.settings, "_skip_wizard", False)
            or getattr(self.settings, "_non_interactive", False)
            or is_non_interactive_env
        )

        if getattr(self.settings, "AI_CONSENT_GRANTED", None) is None:
            if is_bypass:
                self.settings.AI_CONSENT_GRANTED = False
                if hasattr(self.settings, "_save"):
                    try:
                        self.settings._save()
                    except Exception:
                        pass
            elif not getattr(self, "_wizard_dismissed_this_session", False):
                self.call_after_refresh(self.action_open_wizard)

    def on_unmount(self) -> None:
        """Lifecycle hook called when application is unmounted."""
        try:
            from app.ui.notifications import NotificationManager

            NotificationManager.get_instance().unregister_tui(self)
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            from app.config import AppSettings

            AppSettings.remove_observer(
                "AI_CONSENT_GRANTED", self._on_ai_consent_changed
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

    @work
    async def check_abandoned_sessions(self) -> None:
        """Scan for abandoned sessions on startup and prompt for recovery if detected."""
        try:
            import asyncio

            from app.core.session_catalog import find_abandoned_sessions

            abandoned = await asyncio.to_thread(find_abandoned_sessions)
            if not abandoned:
                return

            session_info = abandoned[0]

            def on_recovery_choice(choice: Optional[str]) -> None:
                if not choice:
                    return
                if choice == "resume":
                    self._do_recovery_resume(session_info)
                elif choice == "rollback":
                    self._do_recovery_rollback(session_info)
                elif choice == "clean":
                    self._do_recovery_clean(session_info)

            self.push_screen(SessionRecoveryModal(session_info), on_recovery_choice)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error checking abandoned sessions: {e}")

    def _do_recovery_resume(self, session_info: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        """Resume interrupted sorting operation."""
        import json

        from app.core.session import AppSession

        base_dir = session_info.get("base_dir") or self.base_dir
        if base_dir:
            self.base_dir = base_dir

        self.app_session = AppSession(
            self.settings, self.base_dir, session_id=session_info.get("session_id")
        )

        plan_path = session_info.get("plan_path")
        if plan_path and os.path.exists(plan_path):
            try:
                with open(plan_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    self.plan = json.load(f)
            except Exception:
                self.plan = self.app_session.generate_sorting_plan()
        else:
            self.plan = self.app_session.generate_sorting_plan()

        self.rebuild_tree()
        self.announce(
            f"Resuming session '{session_info.get('session_id')}'. Executing pending moves..."
        )
        self.action_execute_sort()

    def _do_recovery_rollback(self, session_info: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        """Rollback interrupted sorting operation."""
        from app.core.session_catalog import roll_back_abandoned_session

        session_id = session_info.get("session_id")
        info = {
            **session_info,
            "base_dir": session_info.get("base_dir") or self.base_dir,
        }
        if roll_back_abandoned_session(self.settings, info):
            self.announce(f"Rolled back session '{session_id}'.")
        else:
            self.announce(
                f"Session recovery failed for '{session_id}': write/permission error. Session files and safety storage preserved."
            )

        if self.base_dir:
            self.action_scan_directory()

    def _do_recovery_clean(self, session_info: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        """Leave an abandoned session as it is and stop offering to recover it."""
        from app.core.session_catalog import forget_abandoned_session

        forget_abandoned_session(session_info)
        self.announce(f"Cleaned session files for '{session_info.get('session_id')}'.")

    def _get_ai_status_badge(self) -> str:
        """Return visual AI consent status badge string."""
        consent = getattr(self.settings, "AI_CONSENT_GRANTED", None)
        return "[AI: Active]" if consent is True else "[AI: Disabled]"

    def _on_ai_consent_changed(self, value: Any = None) -> None:
        """Handle AI_CONSENT_GRANTED setting change notification."""
        self.update_status()
        consent_val = (
            value
            if value is not None
            else getattr(self.settings, "AI_CONSENT_GRANTED", None)
        )
        if consent_val is False or consent_val is None:
            try:
                from app.core.shared_registry import SharedModelRegistry

                SharedModelRegistry.get_instance().unload_all_models()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self.announce(
                "AI processing disabled. In-memory AI models unloaded instantly.",
                priority="high",
            )
        elif consent_val is True:
            self.announce("AI processing enabled.", priority="high")

    def update_status(self, text: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
        """Update status bar label with current message and AI consent badge."""
        try:
            if text is not None:
                clean_text = str(text)
                for badge_str in ("[AI: Active]", "[AI: Disabled]"):
                    if clean_text.startswith(badge_str):
                        clean_text = clean_text[len(badge_str) :].lstrip()
                self._current_status_text = clean_text
            elif not hasattr(self, "_current_status_text"):
                self._current_status_text = (
                    "Ready. Press [Ctrl+S] to Scan or [Ctrl+B] to select Directory."
                )

            badge = self._get_ai_status_badge()
            full_text = (
                f"{badge} {self._current_status_text}"
                if getattr(self, "_current_status_text", "")
                else badge
            )
            sb = self.query_one("#status-bar", Static)
            sb.update(full_text)
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _get_active_node(self) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
        try:
            tree = self.query_one("#plan-tree", Tree)
            if tree.cursor_node and tree.cursor_node.data:
                return tree.cursor_node
            if getattr(self, "active_tree_node", None) and self.active_tree_node.data:
                return self.active_tree_node
        except Exception:
            pass
        return None

    def _is_text_control_focused(self, allow_tree_search: bool = False) -> bool:
        """Check if a text input or selection control currently holds focus."""
        focused = self.focused
        if focused is None or not isinstance(focused, (Input, Select)):
            return False
        if allow_tree_search and getattr(focused, "id", None) == "tree-search-input":
            return False
        return True
